TITLE

The Buddha was born with the predestined conditions to reveal the true nature, allowing sentient beings to escape the cycle of delusion and suffering, and realize a clear, happy nature. All the teachings, all the mysterious meanings in the life of the Original Teacher's education, are no exception to that purpose. But, to find a shortcut to quickly escape the path of birth and death, a reasonable method, suitable for living beings in this time, there is only Pure Land. Why? Because in the Dharma Ending Age, practitioners are faced with many obstacles that cause them to turn back. Looking at people: The physical body is often sick and has a short life; The mental nature is karma or deep, the wisdom is dim. In terms of scene: In life, natural disasters often occur; As for religion, there are few wise men leading it, many false practitioners, and full of superstitions and evil! Therefore, in the Great Collection Sutra, the Tathagata mysteriously wrote: In the Dharma Ending Age, there are countless people who practice, but it is difficult for an enlightened person to escape samsara by relying only on the Dharma method of reciting the Buddha's name...

Recently, in China, there is an An Quang Dharma Master who is a virtuous person in the monkhood. He was knowledgeable in both sects and teachings, specializing in using the Buddha Recitation method as a means to benefit himself and others. First, the Dharma Master left the home life at Chung Nam peak, and after a period of time studying in different places, he returned to hide at Pho Da mountain, where the sutra hall of Phap Vo pagoda is located. Although he had spent decades as an ascetic and had little contact with outsiders, the noble man's secret was discovered by visitors, and the clear wind blew from near and far. Knowing the Dharma Master's virtues, monks and laymen from all over admired him; There are people who cross streams and climb mountains to pray for instructions; Some people borrowed information from Hong Nhan to ask about magnets. His manuscripts were collected by lay people into four volumes and printed with the title An Quang Dharma Master Van Sao. At birth, the Dharma Master gave away five million Buddha books and more than one million Buddha statues. The Dharma Master's disciples numbered more than twenty thousand people, many of whom, thanks to His teachings, were born into Ultimate Bliss, and when they were about to die, they all had experiences. In the 29th year of the Republic of China, the Dharma Master foresaw the day he would return to the West, and sat in enlightenment at Linh Nham Tinh Tong Dao Trang, enjoying the age of eighty and sixty monks. During the cremation ceremony, thirty-two teeth were still intact, and many five-colored relics appeared. After the Dharma Master's rebirth, the Buddhists left the home life, moved by the memory of His great virtues, joined together to hold a memorial service and agreed to honor Him as the thirteenth Patriarch of the Pure Land sect.

The Magician's Literature Set, when I first left the home life, I had the pleasure of looking through it. During a recent period of retreat, a favorable situation brought me the opportunity to review again, to help me progress on the path of meditation. Realizing that there were many useful points in it for people reciting Buddha, I selected the necessary passages, translated them into national literature, and took the title Pure Land Poetry. I should have added notes in this book to highlight a few essential points, and explain some confusing points for beginners, but because of poor health, my wish was not fulfilled. I feel ashamed that karma is too deep, I don't see any progress in my practice, I have to focus more on my spirit in contemplation, so when translating the rudimentary words, it fails to express the profound meaning of the Dharma Master, and turns a blind eye to the Buddhist community! Although the content still has many shortcomings, but the destiny is like that, I would like to offer a little stupidity according to my strength! This translation, for me, is only for the purpose of contributing to encouraging each other and the lotus friends on the Ultimate Bliss path.

If this work can help you in some way in understanding as well as practicing meditation, please bring the results of that dedicating merit to adorn Pure Land for the four graces of the three realms and the sentient dharma realm.

noi_dung:
Some Expressions

Among the practices taught by the Buddha, each subject has its own unique rituals, from worship, worship, recitation, repentance, making vows, etc. Like Tantric Buddhism, there is also the establishment of altars and sealing.

As for the Pure Land sect, I see that there are many people who do not know the rituals to practice properly. There are also people who do not understand the meaning of Chinese characters, so when reciting, they only recite according to the usual routine, making it difficult to be sincere and unable to redirect their thoughts according to the text. Thinking that because life keeps passing by, the next person will have less and less understanding of Sino-Vietnamese literature, so at the request of a large number of people, I compiled the Pure Land practice ritual into Vietnamese to help fellow practitioners.

Regarding the Pure Land ritual, there are three levels: upper, middle, lower. In order not to be too simple and avoid trouble, I based on Mr. Tu Van's ritual in Pure Land's Ten Essentials, and translated the ritual according to the average level. Regarding how to recite the name, there are still many ways. According to experience and opportunity, I choose the method of Ten Niem Ky Number.

Regarding the Pure Land ritual, in the past it was divided into five subjects, I wish to combine them into three subjects: Bowing, reciting and making vows dedicating merit. Furthermore, Pure Land practice has specialized practice and concurrent practice; Some specialize in reciting Buddha, some also chant sutras, reciting mantras, repentance or engage in meditation. According to An Quang Dharma Master, those who practice pure karma must take Buddha's recitation as the main part, the other items as secondary parts, the main part of course must be kept more. Regarding chanting sutras and reciting mantras, if used to help recite Buddha and single-mindedly dedicating merit, praying for rebirth, it can also be called specialized practice.

On the method of reciting the name, the difference is actually not in the ritual, but in: The sound is clear or vague, the thoughts are sincere or indifferent and scattered, the recitation is more or less shallow. If a person knows how to practice, then one time of worshiping, one saying of name, the merit will be much better than someone who does not know how to practice. However, without proper dharma rituals, the merit of practicing will be difficult to develop to perfection. And that's why I created this ritual.


The difference between the past and present, living beings' basic preferences are different. I do not dare to call this practice suitable for everyone, nor do I dare to say that this ritual is better than the existing rituals. I just write it down depending on the place of desire.

Afterword

In this book, we see that An Quang Dharma Master, in terms of encouragement, only uses ordinary and truthful words, but the main point is the single word success. People who learn the Dharma know how to set their feet from a place of true peace, and will no longer have distant expectations; If you have a sincere will, it is easy to sympathize with the Buddha. The magic of religion lies there. Therefore, a long time ago, a Patriarch said: 'The ordinary mind is the way.'But, on the path of liberation, although other sects also use the pure, ordinary mind as the basis, they only rely on self-power, the Pure Land sect specifically uses self-power and also focuses on the power of others. For example, in the meditation sect, although studying Buddha's mantras, they only use it to stop the wave of delusion and return to a pure mind; In the Tantric sect such as the Lamaism sect in Tibet, there are also people who specialize in reciting the name of a Buddha, a Bodhisattva or a deity, but they only see it as a mantra, or a supporter. However, if we compare, we see that the Tantric side has an advantage over the meditation side, because the Tantric side, while practicing meditation, knows how to keep the three pure karmas (three corresponding secrets) to eliminate delusions and at the same time use the merit, the power of mantra-words or Buddha's name, to help destroy or karma, to quickly attain Bodhi. But those are the ways of practice of the superior level, moreover, sentient beings from the beginningless life until now have created boundless and boundless karma obstacles. Even if they can practice, it is difficult to hope in one lifetime to destroy all troubles and escape the path of birth and death. And once karma remains, or even a shred of it, it is subject to samsara, and with samsara it is easy to forget the sense of self, and to be drawn into the six paths by the delusional world! Other than that, Pure Land can be practiced at upper, middle, and lower levels; The way to practice is to only use a pure mind as the foundation, then from that place, one's ability to sincerely and earnestly recite the Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the Pure Land. If you have enough faith and vow to recite the name, no matter who has ended all afflictions, even if your karma is as heavy as the ocean and mountains, within one lifetime you will be led by Buddha to the Pure Land. When reciting Buddha with sincerity, there are three powers in it: Buddha's power, Dharma power and the inconceivable merit of one's own mind. The Buddha's power is the Buddha's light that is received and protected by the Buddha. The power of the Dharma is Amitabha's name and is still full of all virtues. Sincerely reciting a single sentence will surely eliminate the heavy sins of birth and death for eighty million kalpas, blessings and wisdom will increase. The merit of our own mind is that our mind has all ten dharma realms. While we recite the Buddha's name sincerely, the evil dharma realm is eliminated, the good dharma realm changes greatly until it reaches maturity, and as a result, when we die, we will be reborn in the intercellular world in the Western world. - Here, we need to distinguish between two ways of reciting Buddha that are similar to Pure Land but do not belong to the Pure Land sect: 


1/ Continuously reciting the Buddha's name hopes to suppress false thoughts and realize the original mind, without seeking rebirth, like the meditation sect. 

2/ Reciting the Buddha's name is like reciting a mantra, hoping for Buddha's support to stay away from demons, eliminate karma, and increase blessings and wisdom in this life, without praying for rebirth, like the Tantric sect. 

Reciting the Buddha's name like that is straying from the path of Tinh Tong, only getting small results but losing great benefits. If one knows how to recite the mantra as if preserving one's life, and only earnestly prays for rebirth in the West, then even though one does not seek to end afflictions, the afflictions disappear on their own, without praying for blessings and wisdom, blessings and wisdom naturally increase, to the point where even without seeking enlightenment, sooner or later one will attain enlightenment; The result in one life will be to escape the cycle of rebirth and attain the status of Non-Return in the treasure-lien realm. Then just sincerely recite the Buddha's prayer for rebirth, there is already enough meditation and Secret in it. That's why Master An Quang often says: 'The Pure Land method dominates meditation, Teachings, and Laws, and is superior to meditation, Teachings, and Laws.' 

The Buddha's Recitation seems simple but has such magical powers, so a class of people who study Buddha because they do not understand it thoroughly, develop a sense of pride, slander, and contempt. Therefore, some people quote the Buddha's recitation to bring back the essence of nature, considering the words in the Pure Land sutras to be symbolic. There is also a class of people with many pagan seeds who spread the six words of Buddha's recitation throughout their body, or combine the Buddha's recitation with the practice of qi circulation to circulate throughout the body, or use the Buddha's recitation to gather fire in the seals. They mistakenly consider it precious, only secretly sharing it in private rooms and not daring to praise it, for fear of spreading the word. That mistake causes many people to have bloated stomachs, blurred vision, headaches, and in the end, there is only harm and no benefit. You should know that the Pure Land dharma was spoken by Shakyamuni Buddha, and all Buddhas in the six directions praised it; Great Bodhisattva and Great Patriarchs such as Manjushri, Samantabhadra, Ma Minh, and Nagarjuna all follow it; The Mahayana Sutras such as Avatamsaka, Dharma Flower, Dai Bao Tich, Maha Prajna all praise it. The pagans, because of wrong views, slander Pure Land, are still not worth mentioning; If Buddhists are arrogant and blasphemous, they will unintentionally slander the Three Jewels and block everyone's path to enlightenment. Why? Because Pure Land is the only and most peaceful door of liberation for sentient beings in the Dharma-ending age; The Buddha himself once had a mystical prophecy.

Above, I do not intentionally differentiate between Pure Land sects, or lack sympathy for those who have gone astray, but rather because I remember the Buddha's deep kindness, I want everyone to share that same benefit. However, on the path, everyone's preferences are different, and country music does not easily resonate with tourists! Reading this book, anyone who loves the Light Dharma Master should follow him and read the song of passing away:

1/Poem Response to Layman Dang Ba Thanh (I - II)

I.Since our meeting until now, six years have passed. Not only has the snow and dew changed, but the fortunes of the country have also changed. The impermanence of life is truly pitiful! Receiving poetry and knowing that lay people do not neglect Pure Karma, I am very happy! But in poetry, it is said that the body and mind are not at peace because of the lack of family life, or are they suffering from illness and not being at peace...?

If the home situation is lacking, it is suggested that lay people should take a step back. Must think: In life, there are still many people who are better than us, but there are not many people who are worse than us; Just pray to avoid hunger and cold, why dream of being rich? If a lay person knows how to be happy with his fate, at peace with his situation, he can still turn his troubles into Bodhi. Why can't he change his sadness into happiness? If you are suffering from illness or illness, you should meditate on the body as the source of suffering, give rise to a feeling of detachment, and try to practice Pure Karma to pray for rebirth in Ultimate Bliss. The Tathagata all used suffering as their teacher to become Buddhism. We must also use pain as medicine to seek liberation from the path of samsara. You should know that ordinary people have enough karma or attachments, if there are no sufferings and illnesses... will inevitably pursue beauty, sound, fame, and profit, and it will be difficult to let go. In such a proud moment, who would turn around and look back, thinking about the future sinking? Master Mencius said: “Whoever is about to take on an important sacred responsibility must first be physically exhausted, mentally miserable, or hungry, thirsty, miserable, or unsuccessful in his work. Only then will that person be able to practice patience, steadfastness, and outstanding talent."So we know that humans are formed largely through adversity, and in that case, we should just be content and accept it. But Master Manh's responsibility is just a title in life, but it also takes such hard work to achieve it; What's more, lowly ordinary people like us want to take on the work of Buddhism and save sentient beings! If you don't get a little crazy due to poverty and illness, it will be difficult for your worldly love and pure karma to be achieved, your mirror and heart will be darkened, many lifetimes will drift in the evil realms, the deadline for liberation in the future is unknown!

The ancients said: “For there is not even a drop of frost that penetrates the cold. Apricot blossoms are easy to smell of!This word is the meaning above.

Lay people should persevere in reciting the Buddha's name to quickly eliminate karma. They should not give birth to negative thoughts and blame heaven and blame others, considering cause and effect to be myths and criticizing the Buddha's teachings for not being effective. We should know that from beginningless time until now, we have caused limitless and boundless evil karma, as the Avatamsaka Sutra says: "Suppose evil karma has a form, the emptiness of the ten directions cannot contain it all."Then the practice is a little negligent, it is not easy to eliminate or hinder it all. Buddha Shakyamuni Buddha and Amitabha, out of pity for living beings, did not have enough strength to end karma, so they opened the Dharma door"Relying on Buddha's power, bring karma to rebirth".That grace is so vast that even heaven, earth, and parents cannot compare it in any way. Therefore, lay people should wholeheartedly repentance, so that they can rely on the Buddha family to make their karma disappear and their body and mind be at peace. As the illness is so pressing that one cannot endure it, then in the morning, in addition to reciting the Buddha, lay people should sincerely recite the name of Avalokitesvara. Because with the original vow of silence and relief from suffering, Bodhisattva manifests in all ten directions; If sentient beings in times of danger can recite and worship, He will help them according to the opportunity, causing them to escape suffering and be happy.

Regarding Buddha Recitation, although simple, it is very broad and deep. The essential thing is to be sincere and sincere, then the path will be connected and true benefit can be achieved in this life. If you are lazy, lazy, and have no fear, even though you will sow the cause of liberation later, the retribution for the crime of disrespect is truly unimaginable! Even if there are a few blessings left over from falling into evil realms and being reborn in the heavens and human realms, it is still difficult to attend the Lien Tri Hai assembly.

Coming to a Buddha statue, we must respect it like a living Buddha and should not consider it as land, wood, paper, or copper. The sutras are the teachers of all Buddhas of the three generations, they are the dharma body of Tathagata's relics, they must also be respected like the Buddha, and should not be considered paper and ink. When faced with a sutra, one must be like a faithful worshiper of the Holy God and a filial child who recites the will. If such karma is not eliminated, what blessings and blessings are not enough? Nowadays, there are still many scholars studying Buddha, but most of them read explanatory texts to provide a source of argument, showing that they are knowledgeable about the teachings; In terms of sincerity, respect, and practice, there are truly few people! I usually think: If you want to receive the true benefits of Buddha's teachings, you must seek reverence. If you have one part of reverence, you will eliminate one part of your karma sins, and add one part of blessings and wisdom. The same goes for two or three parts up to ten parts of your respect. On the contrary, if you despise it more, your sins will increase and your blessings will decrease. Isn't that so scary and sad? When meeting friends and lay people, they should advise each other on this idea. It is a great Dharma gift. The Pure Land Dharma, as understood, is still a very precious thing. Even if there is something unclear, still firmly believe in the Buddha's words. Don't doubt, if you doubt, you will be far away from the Buddha. When you are about to die, it will be difficult to be guided. The ancients said: "The Pure Land Dharma can only be fully understood by Buddha and Buddha, even the Bodhisattva ascendant cannot fully understand it."Like a Great Being who cannot fully understand, should we use our ordinary minds to misjudge things? If you want to research, you should see Pure Land Ten Essentials; This book was compiled by Great Master Nguoi Ich, drawing on the essence of the Pure Land scriptures. It is very opportune and worthy of being ranked first. At the beginning of the book is Amitabha's Essential Commentary, so far on the Amitabha Sutra, only these comments are excellent, they must be followed and should not be despised. Intelligent people today, although they study Buddha's teachings, because they are not close to the wise, most focus on reason and reject practice and cause and effect. They don't know that if the practice of cause and effect is lost, reason also no longer exists. There are also highly talented people whose writing is so psychotic that when it comes to behavior, it is no different from the unintellectual class, and it is all traced back to the rejection of the practice of cause and effect. That bad habit causes many people to make the mistake of following it, that is, using their body to violate the Dharma, an endless sin! When the wise see this, they are even more pitiful and painful! The Dharma Garden of Chau Lam clearly states the cause and effect, the reasons are complete, the retributions are also clear, can make the viewer scared, even in a dark place as well as in front of Buddha, heaven, not daring to give rise to evil thoughts. With this set, the upper, middle, and lower levels will all benefit. They will certainly not go astray or give up on things and follow evil and extravagant habits. Mr. Mong Dong said: “A person who is skillful in speaking of his character is determined not to give up cause and effect; Those who believe deeply in cause and effect must clearly understand their nature, that is natural.His words are an eternal opinion, also a needle piercing the top of the head of those who are crazy about wisdom.

The Ministry of Dharma Garden and places where Buddha Dharma is circulated are all available for sale. Regarding the benefits, after reading it you will clearly understand, lay people should advise all friends to buy it. In the fall, the order was sent to visit Putuo. I brought sincere things to advise each other, but I don't know if he thought my words were practical?

II.Being poetic, looking at it easily makes people happy and beautiful! Once upon a time, Cu Ba Ngoc was fifty years old, but looking back at forty-nine, he saw that he was still wrong. Confucius, when he was nearly seventy, wished to live longer so that he could thoroughly study the I Ching, so as not to make major mistakes. The Saint's learning has truly gone to the point of awakening the mind! Scholars today like to follow the chapter, but few think about the point of mindfulness and sincerity. Therefore, even though I read books all day long but do not understand the Sage's intention, my language and behavior are very far from the place of study, such as light, dark, square, and round, they cannot be merged together. That's not to mention the mistakes of the mind, if they could be counted, how many would they be!

The Buddha Sutras teach ordinary people to practice repentance to end ignorance and attain Bodhi. Therefore, even though Lord Maitreya has reached the Enlightenment throne, he still has to pay homage to the Buddhas of the ten directions day and night, in order to pray for the end of ignorance and complete attainment of the Dharma body, not to mention ordinary people with deep karma power? If you don't know shame or repentance, even though your nature is the same as all Buddhas, it is obscured by karma and cannot be revealed. Like an old precious mirror, not only does it not have light, but its mirror body is also hidden. If you know that a mirror already has light in it, if you process and clean it, the light gradually emits until it is extremely bright, becoming a very precious object in life. You should know that light is available, you don't have to clean it, if you can, even cleaning the stones and tiles will make it shine. You must also know that even though the mirror has enough light, if it is not cleaned, it cannot shine brightly. The nature of sentient beings is the same, although they are the same as the Buddha, if they do not exchange evil for good, and leave behind the mundane and achieve enlightenment, then that inherent virtuous nature cannot be revealed. Using that mind that has all the Buddha nature creates karma of suffering for many lifetimes of being immersed in it, just like a dark house containing treasures, when they can't be used and are damaged, isn't that very painful? The Buddha's Recitation method is the miracle of leaving behind the mundane and enlightening to return to the source. People who are caught up in life's attachments find it difficult to stay in a quiet room and engage in meditation chanting sutras. This method is very convenient. Each person can use the chanting and chanting to dedicating rebirth merits according to their ability. Outside of formal recitation hours, when walking, standing, lying down, sitting, speaking, keeping quiet, moving, quieting, eating, wearing clothes, at all times and in all places, you should recite Buddha's name. But, in a clean place, when being respectful, chanting silently or out loud is fine. If you are in an unclean place (such as a place to urinate or defecate), or when you are not respectful (such as when sleeping or bathing), you should only recite silently. When lying down to rest, if you recite it out loud, you won't be respectful and will get sick over time. Reciting merits silently is the same as reciting them out loud, but needs to be clear, earnest and not distracted.

Lay people know how to reveal repentance, which is very compatible with the Pure Land method, because when the mind is pure, the Buddha realm is pure. But after repentance, everyone must correct their mistakes and make up, otherwise it turns out that empty talk is not really helpful. Even if you want to not be attached to external things, concentrate on reciting Buddha, have one mind, there is no strange dharma, just stick a death word on your head, hang it on your eyebrows, often thinking: “From beginningless time until now, I have caused immeasurable evil karma, no prevent, suppose that karma has a form, the ten directions are empty, cannot contain it. What a lucky fate, now that I have a human body and can listen to the Buddha's Dharma. If I do not wholeheartedly recite the Buddha's name and seek rebirth in the West, when my breath stops, due to old evil karma, it will be difficult to avoid falling into Hell. At that time, he had to endure extreme hardships, like a cauldron of oil in a furnace, a forest of swords and swords, and it took countless lifetimes to complete. When leaving Hell, because karma has not ended, he falls into the realm of Hungry Ghosts, his belly is very large, his throat is as small as a needle, fire often flows out of his mouth, he is hungry and thirsty for many lifetimes, he cannot hear the name of drinking water, and he is never temporarily satisfied. At the end of the Hungry Ghost life, they fall into the Animal realm, or let others ride and transport them, or are sold into the slaughterhouse. When we become human, we are stupid and unwise, easily create karma, difficult to do good, and soon fall again. Old karma has not been paid off yet, new karma is created, continuously reincarnating in six paths through lives as numerous as small dust, vast sea of suffering without knowing where the shore is.If you often think like that, your practice will be single-minded. In the past, when Truong Thien Hoa and Truong Chung Quy were about to die, the appearance of Hell appeared. After reciting Buddha's name for a few hours, they immediately saw Buddha coming to take them to rebirth. Such benefits, throughout a lifetime of Buddha's teachings, among hundreds of thousands of millions of teachings, can only be found in the Buddha's Recitation. I usually think: “The nine realms of sentient beings who depart from this dharma have difficulty achieving enlightenment. All Buddhas in the ten directions have abandoned this method. It is impossible to save all the delusions."If a lay person has a thorough and earnest faith in life and death without a single thought of doubt, then even though he has not yet escaped the evil life, he will not be a person who has stayed long in the Saha world. Although he has not yet reached the Federation, he will be a new guest of the Pure Land. From now on, when you see a good person, you must try to do it right. When you encounter a difficult task, don't give in. Why can't you gradually be late and make a mistake for a while? You will miss it forever? A person with a blood nature would probably not be willing to live as a corpse and run away, die and rot with the plants and trees. So lay people should try.

Again, although reciting the Buddha's name is most precious, but lay people still have parents above, and below have wives and children, so it is true that they should not be too ambitious in seeking wealth, but they also have to take care of their family duties to fulfill them, not to practice and give up everything. If you give up everything and your parents, wife and children are not in need, then it's okay. Otherwise, you're going against life and against religion, you should know that too. As a child, you must advise your parents through practice. If your parents know how to recite the Buddha's name and are born in the West to escape samsara, then filial piety in this world will be unmatched. If someone brings Pure Land Dharma teachings and advises many people to practice and recite them, the merit of teaching will be theirs, and the golden lotus in the future will surely be at the highest level.

2/ Poem in response to Layman Dang Tan An

It's really difficult for me to respond to lay people's requests! Why? Because the aspirations of lay people are big, my knowledge is small, big and small are not the same, so the teachings are difficult to match. However, in the true One Vehicle form, it is impossible to find large or small signs. There, big words are big, small words are small, big and small are still full of the dharma realm. The little I know covers all dharmas in the ten dharma realms. Venerable Thien Dao said: If you want to learn about Abhidharma, all dharmas from ordinary people to Buddha's land should be studied. If you want to learn about Virtue, you should choose a method that is reasonable and appropriate, and try diligently to quickly get real benefits. Otherwise, even after many lifetimes, it will be difficult to escape. That reasonable and suitable Dharma is nothing more than using faith and prayer, reciting the name Buddha to seek rebirth in the West. If you want to learn, you should follow Amitabha Sutra and Pure Land books.

Buddhism is a public dharma among the ten precepts, everyone should practice and everyone can practice. Because they did not clearly see the identity of Buddhism, a group of Confucian scholars blindly argued that: Buddhism abandons morality and harms righteousness! Why do we know they are wrong? Because the Buddha said good things to fathers, good things to children, benevolence to kings, loyalty to servants, to beloved husbands and wives, brothers and sisters in harmony; All good words and actions in life are clearly stated in the Buddha Sutra. So what is the difference between Confucianism and Confucianism? Furthermore, regarding the point of clearly stating the cause and effect of the three generations, it is not mentioned in Confucianism. Coming as things: If we stop or realize the truth, fully Bodhi, and return to the place of no attainment, then Confucianism must be far inferior. It's a pity for those Confucian scholars who haven't seen it yet. If they could see it carefully and understand it deeply, they would surely shed tears of pain, their cries would move the world, regretting that they had despised Buddha's teachings! But using words to blaspheme the Dharma is a small crime, using the body to blaspheme the Dharma is an extremely big crime! Nowadays, there are people who like to talk about Mahayana, claiming that they have attained enlightenment, saying: I am Buddha, why do I need to recite Buddha's name? Affliction is Bodhi, what is the need to get rid of affliction? Lust, anger, and delusion are precepts, concentration, and wisdom. What need is there except to abandon lust, anger, and delusion? Their words are so high above the clouds, their actions are under nine layers of earth! Such people, called unjust members of the Buddha family, are much more serious than those who do not know Buddha's teachings and despise them. For the latter group, discussing the merits of studying Buddha's teachings is not entirely useless, but only serves as a cause to be saved later. As for the crime of using one's body to violate the Dharma, one must suffer in the evil path for countless lifetimes.

Lay people should study the Mahayana sutras to fully understand. As for practice, we must take faith and vows and reciting the name as the right conduct. When you behave normally, or are afraid of doing bad things or reducing blessings, you should read An Si Toan Tho and Phap Uyen Chau Lam to grasp the rules to keep, and not dare to let your thoughts wander anymore. Sometimes I'm afraid that I won't be able to control it in time, so I practice according to the magic of Phu Huu De Quan and can transcend mortals to Sainthood, attain enlightenment or attain enlightenment. Thus, in this country of China, lay people will be the fewest people.

tieu_de: 3/ Poem in response to Layman Cao Thieu Lan (1 - 2)
tom_tat: 1. noi_dung:
3/ Poem in response to Layman Cao Thieu Lan (1 - 2)

1.In the letter sent, it was said that the lay people were reciting the Buddha's thoughts, bowing to the Lotus Sutra, and trying to eliminate their mistakes but were not getting the desired results. They thought they wanted to follow the teachings too much to self-criticize every day. All these things are enough to prove that the recent practice of lay people is sincere for themselves, unlike those who deceive others and flaunt their appearance to seek honor. There's nothing better than that, I'll be happy.

The ritual of chanting and chanting must be dominated by sincerity. If you are extremely respectful, even if you are in an ordinary world, your merits are not yet perfect, but the results are still inconceivable! On the contrary, although chanting is different from dancing and singing, even if expressions of suffering, joy, and sympathy are expressed, they are all disguises because they are not revealed from the bottom of the heart. If you have merit, it is nothing but blessings in the Heavens and Human realms, but that is where you create evil karma, sowing immeasurable suffering in the future. You should show this to your friends and advise each other to truly practice so that the benefits can spread. The method of bowing to sutras established by lay people is still not a problem in principle, but in terms of practice, if one is simply bowing, one must recite: Namo Mahayana Wonderful Dharma Lotus Sutra, Dharma Lotus Buddha Conference, Bodhisattva. After reciting, he bowed down and recited the prayer verse:

“The true nature of Dharma is like nothingness,

The permanent Dharma treasure is inconceivable!

Where in front of the Dharma treasure appears my shadow,

Like the Dharma, we bow wholeheartedly and respectfully.”

Imagine that the entire sutra and all the Buddhas and Bodhisattva in the sutra radiate light to illuminate your body and all sentient beings in the dharma realm. If you bow word by word, you must recite: Namo Mahayana Wonderful Dharma Lotus Sutra (...) from Dharma treasure. Whenever you bow to any word, chant that word, from the word: Like, like, self, text... Until the end of the sutra, they chant like that. But visualization is not easy, if you don't understand the theory clearly or your mind is confused, you are afraid of evil deeds. The essential thing is to use sincerity and reverence as the main thing. If you can visualize it, then visualize it. If not, you should bow with all your heart and sincerity. The merit is also immeasurable. According to the program established by lay people: Prostrate before the sutras, when you bow down, recite the verses, when you stand up, recite the Buddha's name, meditate on the Buddha..., it is better to put the sutras in front of the Buddha making offerings table and then focus on worshiping Amitabha Buddha. Don't think that the merit of thinking of one Buddha is not as great as that of thinking of many Buddhas. You should know that Amitabha Buddha is the body of the dharma precepts, all the merits of all Buddhas in the ten dharma precepts, in one Amitabha Buddha are all complete. For example, in the net of pearls of the Indra heaven, a thousand pearls appear in one pearl, a single pearl casts its shadow over a thousand pearls, each pearl complements the other, with no excess and no shortage. If a Great Monk has been practicing for a long time, there is no need to worry about a wide range of conditions. The more scenes there are, the more focused the mind is. On the contrary, for those who are just learning the Dharma, if there are many conditions, their minds will be confused, and those with deep and shallow wisdom may even suffer from demonic deeds. For that reason, our World-Honored One and the Patriarchs all told us to single-mindedly recite Amitabha Buddha, until we attain Samadhi, then hundreds of thousands of teachings, with immeasurable wonderful meanings, will all be complete. The ancients said: To bathe the ocean means using the water of a hundred rivers; When we arrived at Ham Nguon Palace, why did we ask Truong An? This statement can be called a very accurate symbol for the above reason.

When it comes to putting an end to evil and doing good, honestly examining oneself, there is nothing better than going too far; But if your mind is not focused on devotion, even if you write down your merits and mistakes every day, it will still be empty work. Excessive public records have not been found in this area. According to my understanding, you should only maintain respect at all times, don't let a bad thought arise, and when dealing with others, always maintain loyalty. In this way, even if false thoughts arise at first, you will immediately know them. Once you know them, you will immediately eliminate them. All three karmas will not be drawn into the wrong path. Small people appear gentle on the outside, but are cruel on the inside, thinking that no one knows them; Unexpectedly, even though ordinary people do not know, practitioners attain enlightenment and see and understand clearly. Furthermore, even though the gods and demons have not yet attained enlightenment, thanks to their retribution, they can understand others' minds. What do you say that Sravaka, Pratyekabuddha, Bodhisattva and all Buddhas, the other minds and paths can see throughout the three lifetimes like looking at the palm of that hand? If you don't want to know, it's okay if you don't know. If you know, then heaven, earth, demons, Buddha, and Bodhisattva will all know. Understanding this meaning, even if you are in a dark or deserted place, do not dare to think evil thoughts. If a stubborn person knows the above reason, he will be ashamed of himself. Should he choose a true practitioner? If you want to reduce mistakes, you must remember this point and always be in awe. But this is a wish according to the shallow understanding of life's love, in fact our mind and the ten precepts are one and the same, because we are so ignorant that seeing and knowing are only within ourselves. All Buddhas in the ten directions witnessed the entire mind, all sentient beings in the Dharma world aroused their thoughts, they saw and knew clearly like an image reflected in a mirror. That's because all Buddhas have entered the true, equal nature, self and others are no different.

If a lay person clearly understands this meaning, he or she can be cautious of fear, maintain a respectful heart, and first try to eliminate delusions. Over time, false thoughts will disappear and will no longer arise.

2.Receiving the poem, knowing that recently lay people have been cultivating closely, examining themselves and correcting their mistakes, following in the footsteps of the Sages, not seeking vain fame, I feel very happy! If you want to learn about Buddha, the Patriarchs, and escape birth and death, the first points are: shame, repentance, letting go of anger, doing good, keeping precepts and often reminding oneself. It is necessary to reach the truth and do your best, otherwise it will become a lie within a lie. Therefore, knowing is not difficult, doing is difficult! Many smart people in life, because they said they would do nothing, ended up wasting their lives, wasting their money and going home empty-handed, what a pity! The illustrious delusion is due to not being diligent in maintaining mindfulness. If you keep focusing on one scene, the delusion will change into right wisdom. Therefore, if the ruler is successful, the robbers will all be red-handed. If the ruler is corrupt, even if the confidant is wronged, the family will also be wronged. In the ordinary world's position, who doesn't have good karma? But in normal times, if you take precautions in advance, when you encounter a predestined situation, troubles will not erupt; Even if it arises, you can immediately know it and stop it. There are many scenes that cause afflictions to arise. But the strongest things are money, beauty and unusual affairs. You should know that unjust money is more harmful than poisonous snakes, so you will no longer be greedy when you see wealth. Helping others is building a foundation of merits and blessings for yourself in the future. Knowing that, when someone is in trouble and asks for help, not because you feel sorry for what you don't give, but feel troubled. Regarding beauty, when facing a person as beautiful as a flower, like a jade, or even a prostitute, one should think that they are a sister or a younger sibling, giving rise to a heart of salvation and compassion, and certainly not be moved by lustful thoughts by beauty. In the family, husband and wife must respect each other as guests. They should consider their wives and concubines as people who help each other and for the sake of family continuity, so that they will not be harmed by lust. When encountering a wrong situation, you should have compassion and forgive those who do not know their mistakes, and do not fight over or lose. Thinking again: In my previous life, I once caused hardship and harm to others, and today I have to pay back my debt. If you think like that, you will naturally be happy and not get angry and want to retaliate. However, the above methods are to be applied to beginners. If the Great Being has practiced for a long time, all the afflictions will change into a clear mind, all situations will still not be of the true nature, and the things that harm the benefits will come from the person alone.

When it comes to discussing the Buddha's Recitation method, Faith, Prayer, and Virtue are the main principles. These three items are complete and determine rebirth. As for Faith and Prayer, you should pay attention to it, you must single-mindedly pray for the West, and do not expect to return in your next life as someone who enjoys wealth. Not only does he not want to take on the body of a king in the Heavenly realm, he, even if he takes the body of a high monk who has heard a thousand words, received great teachings, and expanded the dharma to benefit sentient beings, also considers it as the root sin of not giving rise to thoughts of liking (because that is enlightenment, not yet enlightenment, still suffering from samsara and possibly falling). Only then will our faith and vows reach the Buddha, and the Buddha's vows will be able to accept us. You should know that the Ultimate Bliss realm is not only impossible for ordinary people to reach, but also the Hinayana saints themselves cannot reach it, because that place is the immeasurable scene of the Mahayana. Only the minor saints can return to the Mahayana, but if ordinary people do not believe in the Buddha, even if they practice all the sublime virtues and virtues of reciting the name, they will not be able to rebirth. Therefore, faith and prayer are very essential. Mr. Ngai Ich said: “Whether you are born or not depends entirely on whether you have faith or not; The lotus products, high and low, are all based on deep or shallow recitation of names.This is an iron thesis, even if a thousand Buddhas were born, it would not change. With this reason, if lay people firmly accept it, they will have a portion in the Western world.

Like reciting the Buddha's name, it is the most difficult to focus on, you have to remember and recite carefully. The practice of sesshin is nothing more than sincerity and earnestness. If you are not sincere and want to become one, it is very difficult. Even if your thoughts are sincere and your thoughts are not yet pure, you must listen carefully. There is no need to talk about reciting silently or out loud, one must start reciting from the mind, the sound comes from the mouth and then enters the ear (even though reciting silently through the mind still has the appearance of mouth reciting). The mind and mouth are clear, the ears clearly listen to the mind like that, the false thoughts automatically end. If the wave of delusions is too strong, you should use the Ten Niem Ky number magic to focus all your energy on reciting the Buddha's words, then the delusions will be suppressed and have no room to emerge. This magic to capture the mind is very wonderful. In the past, the Pure Land sect's preachers did not mention it because the human capacity at that time was still bright, without using this method, one could still chant the Buddha's name. My An Quang, because my mind is difficult to control, after trying it many times, I realized that it is good. I vow to follow and practice with those who are ignorant in the future to be reborn in Ultimate Bliss.

When reciting Buddha's name, you must remember clearly from one to ten sentences, and after all ten sentences return to one, it keeps rotating like that. But you must recite it within ten sentences, not two or thirty sentences, and you should not recite the rosary, just memorize it with your mind. If you find it difficult to remember to recite ten sentences at once, then divide them into two sections, from one to five, from six to ten. If you still feel weak, divide it into three breaths, from one to three, four to six, seven to ten. Need to pay attention: Reciting, remembering and hearing must be clear so that false thoughts cannot interfere. If you use this spell for a long time, you will have one mind. You should know that the Ten Niem Ky Number magic is the same as Tu Van's Ten Niem magic, the reverberation part is the same, the application part is very different. The practice of reciting the Ten Recitations depends on the length and shortness of a person's breath. It is not possible to discuss how many Buddha verses there are, each breath counts as a recitation. Regarding this magic every morning, you can only use it for ten recitations. If it exceeds that number for a long time, you will get sick. The practice of reciting numbers is to recite one sentence to know one sentence, to recite ten sentences to know ten sentences, from one to ten and then back again, even if you recite it for tens of thousands of sentences each day, you will still remember it like that. Reciting like this not only eliminates delusions, but can also nourish the spirit, because it depends on your strength, whether it is slow or fast, there is no obstacle. Again, compared to the method of reciting the rosary to write down numbers, the practice of reciting the rosary is much more beneficial because reciting the rosary makes the body tired and mentally agitated, while this method relaxes the body and the mind. Only when working, or when it's difficult to sign numbers, you should urgently recite them, wait until you're done and then take the time to sign the numbers. That way, false thoughts will no longer run rampant, and the mind will stay focused on the Buddha's chant.

Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva said: "If you take advantage of all six senses and meditate continuously, you will attain the Three Demonic Grounds. This is the first step."This statement does not need to be discussed with those who have good faculties. If people with dull faculties like us, abandon the Ten Niem Ky Number magic and want to take advantage of the six faculties, connecting with pure recitation, it is extremely difficult! The method of reciting the Buddha's rosary should only be used when walking and standing, but when reciting the rosary, if the rosary is recited, the hands will not be at peace, and over time it may cause illness. Other than that, the Ten Niem Ky Number spell can be used when walking, standing, lying down, or sitting, but when lying down you should only recite it silently. If you speak out loud, you will not be respectful and you will get winded, so remember carefully.

Lay people over the age of fifty, if they want liberation in this life, must focus on Pure Land. The Diamond Sutra and the Lotus Sutra should be temporarily put aside, wait until the principles of Pure Land are clear, chant Buddha with one mind and then it will be good. If I study and practice now, I'm afraid the time is limited, the mental capacity cannot handle it, neither side becomes the other, and both benefits are lost.

tom_tat: The Tathagata was born and preached the Dharma to save living beings. He still wanted all sentient beings to escape life and death and attain the Bodhi path. But because sentient beings have different capacities and cannot completely satisfy Buddha's earthly heart, so...
noi_dung:
4/ Poem to Layman Tran Tich Chau

The Tathagata was born and preached the Dharma to save living beings. He still wanted all sentient beings to escape life and death and attain the Bodhi path. But because sentient beings have different abilities and cannot completely satisfy the Buddha's heart, Tu Nghiem has no choice but to lead them one by one according to opportunity. For those with great capacity, the World-Honored One, because he spoke of Buddha's inheritance, pointed to the nature, causing one to attain Buddhahood in one full life, like the Good Fortune in the Avatamsaka Sutra and the Dragon Lady in the Lotus Sutra. At the second level, he said Bodhisattva, Pratyekabuddha or Sravaka vehicle, causing them to practice and achieve results one after another. At the second level, He spoke about the five precepts and ten virtues, so that he would not fall into the evil path, took on the body of a God or a Human, sowing good seeds one by one, depending on the size of the good roots, later in the dharma of the three vehicles, due to the power of old accumulation, he would develop the practice of practice; Or there are those who follow the Bodhisattva vehicle and practice the six degrees of all virtues, attaining the Dharma body, or there are those who follow the Pratyekabuddha, Sravaka vehicle, realize the twelve causes and conditions and the Four Noble Truths to stop or realize the truth. Although these methods are big, small, fast, slow, they all have to be practiced deeply to be able to escape samsara and attain true nature. If two items, ants, or thoughts have only a thread left, the root of birth and death has not yet been eliminated. Even if the power of concentration and wisdom is deep, it will still follow the same cycle. Like Anagami, he must be born in the Five Imperfect Heavens, going through many lifetimes to attain Arhat. When you reach this position, the root of birth and death will be completely ended. But that is only a small fruit of the Sravaka class, one must also head towards the great path of Bodhi, depending on the original vow to be born in the worlds of the ten directions, extensively practice the six degrees of all virtues, to pray for Buddhism, and to save sentient beings. From there, depending on how deep or slow your meritorious deeds are, you can one by one attain the Ten Pillars, the Ten Virtues, the Ten Dedicating Merit, the Ten Grounds, and then Enlightenment. This person even breaks through one level of ignorance, attains part of the Three Virtues, and then enters the throne of Wonderful Enlightenment and becomes a Buddha.

In a lifetime of Tathagata's teachings, although the methods were immeasurable, the ultimate attainment status did not pass through the above levels. As in the meditation sect, it points directly to the mind, seeing the nature of becoming a Buddha, it is very complete and quickly extinguished; But that is based on the existing dharma body, without going through the cause and effect of cultivating and realizing. If we follow the status of cultivating and realizing, it is no different from the teachings. In this age of the End of Dharma, there are very few good people with knowledge, and poor human instincts. It is difficult to find someone who is enlightened, let alone true enlightenment? The Tathagata knew that it would be difficult for sentient beings to attain liberation if they only relied on their own strength, so in addition to the other dharma doors, he opened a separate Buddha recitation door to seek rebirth in the Pure Land. If one's faith and vows are sincere, even if a person who commits the Five Evils and Ten Evils is about to die, the appearance of Hell appears, and there is a wise man who teaches him to recite the Buddha's name ten or a few sentences, and thanks to the Buddha's magnetic power, he can still be reborn. What's more, is he who practices good dharmas and does not do evil? If you are a person who is diligent in cultivating the holy life and has deep meditation power, your lotus rank will be higher. When you see the Buddha quickly hear the Dharma, you will reach the level of a person who is completely enlightened and enlightened. If you have finished or attained true enlightenment, you should also dedicate yourself to rebirth in order to fully attain the Dharma body and quickly attain Buddhahood. For other methods, if they are small, those with great faculties do not need to practice; if they are large, those with small faculties cannot practice; Only this Pure Land door covers all three senses, includes gathering and dullness, is as sublime as Avalokiteshvara, Worldly One, Manjushri, and Samantabhadra, cannot go beyond, is as low as the Five Rebels, and the Ten Evil Natures of Abhidharma are also included. If the Tathagata does not open this door, sentient beings in the Dharma Ending Age will no longer have hope of escaping the path of birth and death. But although the Pure Land method is so vast, the way to practice is very easy. For that reason, not only do ordinary people find it difficult to believe, but also those in the Second Vehicle are skeptical, even those with Bodhisattva positions still have doubts, except for those who have planted good roots in the Pure Land in their previous lives and Mahayana Bodhisattva levels have reached high levels of attainment of deep faith. Like the Crown Prince when he was just born, although his talent and virtue had not yet been established, thanks to the power of his father, he was more luxurious than the courtiers. He had enough faith to pray to chant the Buddha's name, even though he was an ordinary person, his dual nature was already better than the Second Vehicle, because he knew how to sow his mortal mind into the ocean of enlightenment, secretly unite with the wonderful path, and thanks to the Buddha's power, he quickly reached the level of Non-return.

If we want to talk about Pure Land, if we do not briefly compare the difficulty of self-reliance of other methods with the power of others of this method, then even if we do not doubt the method, we will doubt ourselves. And if there is even a shred of doubt in your heart, it will inevitably cause doubt to become an obstacle. Don't say not to practice, even if you practice, it won't be completely beneficial. Therefore, trust is the first thing you should seek. We must firmly believe that the Saha world is truly miserable, the Ultimate Bliss realm is truly joyful. The suffering in Saha is unpredictable and unimaginable, but there are eight things: Birth, old age, sickness, death, love and separation, resentment and meeting, unsatisfied wishes, five glorious warm years. These eight things, even as rich as a king or as lowly as a beggar, cannot be avoided. The first seven are the courage of the past life, the last one is the cause and suffering of the future life, cause and effect are endlessly linked together, life after life there is no escape. The five skandhas are the five coverings, because form, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness cover the true nature like dark clouds under the sun, not allowing light to appear, and for the six sense objects that arise or cause karma like a burning fire, it is called illustrious. This eighth food is the root of all suffering. People who practice when their meditation power is deep, do not accept the six sense objects, do not give rise to love or hate, from that point of practice, or karma will gradually be eliminated, completely ending the source of birth and death. But that practice is not easy, in the Dharma Ending Age it is very difficult for people to do it, so it is necessary to practice Pure Karma to give birth to Ultimate Bliss, thanks to Buddha's magnetic power to guide it to the West. Having arrived in that realm, transformed into a lotus flower, there is no longer the suffering of birth; pure male appearance, living as long as space, body does not degenerate, old age, sickness, and death no longer heard of names, let alone real? From then on, you and the Holy Order, close to Amitabha, the water birds of the forest and trees perform and speak the Dharma, depending on your nature, listen and practice, until then, even if you don't have any relatives, choose to be an unjust family? In the realm of Ultimate Bliss, when you imagine eating you can eat, when you imagine you can wear clothes, palaces and castles are all naturally manifested jewels, the seven sufferings in the impure realm have changed into seven joys, like the body, it has great supernatural powers, it cannot leave its place of residence, in one thought it can go to all ten directions of the world to do things to pray to the Buddha to save sentient beings; The mind has high eloquent wisdom, knowing all the true forms of all dharmas in one dharma, even though worldly affairs are in accordance with wonderful reason. So the suffering of the five skandhas no longer exists, only enjoying peace and tranquility. That's why the sutra says: "That world is called Ultimate Bliss, because sentient beings in that world do not have suffering, only enjoy joy."In short, the suffering in Saha is indescribable, the joy in Ultimate Bliss is endless. If the layperson completely eliminates doubts and firmly believes in Buddha's words, then it is called deep faith. Should pay attention: Don't let ordinary people's understanding be corrupted and mistakenly think: "So many strange and inconceivable things in the West belong to fables to illustrate mental dharma, not real scenes."If you have that wrong understanding, you will definitely lose the benefits of rebirth Pure Land. This harm is very great, you must be careful.

Knowing that Saha is suffering and Ultimate Bliss is joy, we should make sincere vows to leave Saha and return to Ultimate Bliss. That wish is like a person who has fallen into a dirty cellar and wishes to get out quickly, or like a person in prison who longs for his homeland. The wish must be urgent, because one cannot escape on one's own strength, one must rely on someone with great power to guide them. Sentient beings in the Saha world, in response to unfavorable circumstances, give rise to greed, anger, delusion, causing karma to kill, steal, commit adultery, and pollute their pure minds. This is a deep pit of filth. Having caused evil karma, one must suffer the consequences of suffering, experiencing many lifetimes of samsara in the six realms, which is a long prison term. Regarding his previous life, Amitabha made forty-eight vows to save sentient beings, including one vow: “If any sentient being hears my name and recites it with all their heart ten times, wishing to be reborn in Ultimate Bliss, but is not reborn, I swear I will not become a Buddha.”Even though Father Compassion vows to save sentient beings like that, if sentient beings don't need to be guided, Buddha doesn't know what to do? As if there were people who wholeheartedly confessed their name and wished to leave the Saha world, Buddha would mercifully accept and guide them. Amitabha is very powerful and can save sentient beings from the filth of prison in the negative realms, bring them Ultimate Bliss, and make them enter the Buddha realm, serving as the Tathagata's co-worker. If you want to be born in the West, you must first have deep faith and earnest vows. Without these two things, even if you practice, you will not be able to reach the Buddha, you will only receive blessings from Heaven and Man and sow liberation later. If one's faith and prayers are complete, all people will be reborn without missing one. Mr. Vinh Minh said: "Many people practice, many people return"is only for people with full faith. Once you have deep faith and vows, you must practice reciting the Buddha's name, using faith and vows as the first path, and reciting the Buddha as the right practice. These three items are the essence of the Buddha's Recitation method. If one is missing, rebirth is impossible.

Regarding the practice of reciting the Buddha, it all depends on each person's situation, we cannot accept one set method. Just as the body is at leisure, so from morning to afternoon, tomorrow afternoon, walking, standing, lying down, sitting, speaking, quiet, moving, quiet, dressing, eating, until the time of defecation and urination, all times, all places, so that the Buddha's words never leave my heart. For example, when you take a bath, you are clean, your clothes are neat and you are in a pure place, you can chant silently or out loud. If when sleeping, your body is naked, you defecate, urinate, and the place is unclean, you should only recite it silently; Don't say you shouldn't recite when you're not strictly clean, you're just afraid you won't be able to recite at that time! Although reciting the Buddha is a lifelong work that should not be interrupted, every morning you must pay homage to the Buddha. Before chanting the Amitabha sutras once, pay rebirth three times, then recite the verse.“Amitabha Buddha has a golden body…”After reading the verse, recite it“Namo the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss World, Great Compassion, Amitabha Buddha.”Next recite“Namo Amitabha Buddha”or five hundred sentences, a thousand sentences, the more the better. When reciting, you should circumambulate the Buddha's table. If the place to circumambulate is not convenient, you can kneel, sit, or stand to recite. When the recitation is almost finished, kneel before the Buddha's table and recite Avalokiteshvara, World Chi, and Purity Sea Assembly, each Holy name three times, then read the Pure Land text and vow to dedicate it to rebirth. Reading Pure Land's text is to follow the meaning in the text and develop your mind. Otherwise, it becomes just reading, not really useful. After making vows, recite the Three Refuges, paying homage to the Buddha and leave. This is the morning session, the same in the afternoon. If you want to bow to the Buddha a lot, or after reciting the Buddha, freely bow, then recite the name Bodhisattva nine times, bow nine times and then make vows dedicating merit; Or when the session is over, you can bow as much as you want. Paying homage to the Buddha must be sincere and sincere, not rude or rude; The cushion must not be too high. If it is too high, it will lose respect.

If you have a lot of work and don't have time to spare, you should decide to go early in the morning after rinsing your mouth and washing your face. When there is a Buddha table, go to the Buddha's table and bow three times, then stand up straight, clasp your hands and recite.“Namo Amitabha Buddha”One breath is one thought. Recite for ten breaths, then read the verse“May I recite Buddha's name with you. All are born into Ultimate Bliss. Seeing Buddha escape from birth and death. Like Buddha saves everything.”After reading the verse, paying homage to the Buddha, bowed three times and withdrew. If you do not discuss Buddha, then clasp your hands facing the West and chant in the same way as above. This is the 10 Recitations Master Tu Van Sam established for kings and mandarins, who have too much trouble and do not have enough time to practice. Why do we have to recite it all in one breath? Because sentient beings' minds are scattered and they don't have time to focus on mindfulness, such mindfulness is borrowing the breath of the mind to bring it to oneness. But you have to depend on the length of the breath and don't force it. Pressing will waste the breath; Again, you can only hold ten thoughts, not twenty or thirty. If you do too much, you will be exhausted. Because chanting the Buddha's mind is difficult to rebirth, this spell makes the mind the most concentrated. Although the number of chants is small, the merit is very deep, and it will definitely give birth to Ultimate Bliss. When you are free and in a hurry, you have a method, so when you are not normally free and in a hurry, you should follow the rules of practice.

Those who recite Buddha's name must maintain loyalty in every action, guard against mistakes, know mistakes quickly, and find good deeds fun to do, only then will they be in harmony with Buddha. If not, there will certainly be obstacles in the heart that are not in harmony with the Buddha's mind and will be difficult to understand. And, when worshiping, chanting Mahayana sutras and doing all useful things in life, you must dedicating merit to the West. You should not only bring Buddha's virtue to dedicating merit of rebirth, there are many other merits to dedicating merit of blessings to the world. If so, the mind is not unified, it is very difficult to rebirth. You must know that a person who sincerely recites the Buddha's name, even though he does not ask for blessings in the world, will still live long, be healthy, have a happy home, and have prosperous children and grandchildren. In short, all the blessings reported in this world will be complete. If blessings alone do not dictate merit of rebirth, then on the contrary, blessings report very little, which is harmful to rebirth. The Mahayana Sutras praise the method of reciting the Buddha's name, but the Hinayana Sutras do not mention it at all. People who have not yet mastered the teachings reject the Buddha's concept as Hinayana, which is nonsense, and should not be followed. As for the fortune-telling that lay people talk about, most of it belongs to spirits and demons who rely on the wisdom of the person holding the fortune-telling to write it down. If it talks about worldly affairs, it is partly correct, but about Buddhism, because it is not something they understand, they mistakenly set out wonderful sayings like the following book Vajrayana Directly with the addition of the titles First Heaven, Ancient Buddha, etc. These are very evil words that destroy people's wisdom and right views. If they are spread, they will not bring blessings and will also be a great sin.

tieu_de: 5/ Poem in response to Laypersons in the World of Being
tom_tat: We haven't seen each other for several years, and we miss each other with all our hearts. Last fall, at the behest of Brother Lam Chi Phan to attend the incense experiment and bring poetry to Putuo, I recently learned about the practice of lay people. Heard…
noi_dung:
5/ Poem in response to Laypersons in the World of Being

We haven't seen each other for several years, and we miss each other with all our hearts. Last fall, at the behest of Brother Lam Chi Phan to attend the incense experiment and bring poetry to Putuo, I recently learned about the practice of lay people. I heard that there was unhappiness in the family, the loss of a beloved child, so the lay people felt sad and uneasy that early morning. I wanted to clearly explain the cause and effect, but because the compilation work was too urgent, I only wrote a short poem. On the full moon day today, Master Triet Quyen went up to the mountain to visit. In the story, the story talked about the resentment of lay people, and the heretical theories of some secular people based on that: Doing good brings disaster, practicing is of no benefit... After hearing this, I suddenly felt sad, fearing that the wise will delay their practice in this matter, and the foolish ones will dare to do evil, so without complaining to the cowardly people, I would like to express this right now to express it together.

In the Buddha Sutra it often says: “Retribution is passed through three generations and a person gives birth to a child with four causes.”

Retribution through three lifetimes includes: present retribution, birth retribution and post retribution. The present retribution is that if you do evil or good in this life, you will receive blessings in this life; Like a scholar, he needs to study and become famous. This can be seen with the naked eye. The retribution is to do evil and good in this life, and to receive blessings in the next life; Just like the father who values ​​literary qualities, only then will the children and grandchildren prosper and be glorious (birth is a reward for one's self and life's affairs are difficult to clearly state. I'll just borrow an example to make it easier to understand. Please don't take advantage of words and cause harm). This thing cannot be seen with the physical eye, but the heavenly eye can still see it. The retribution is that if you do evil or good in this life, then in the third, fourth, or thousands of generations, until countless countless eons later, you will receive blessings; like the karma kings of the Thuong and Chau dynasties, actually started from Mr. Tac and Mr. Khiet. The things of three or four lifetimes can still be seen by the heavenly eye, if the things of hundreds of thousands of lifetimes cannot be seen by the heavenly eye, but the spiritual eye of the Shravakas can see clearly. As for the boundless and boundless events of countless kalpas, only the Tathagata with five bright eyes can see clearly before and after. That scene is not even Sravaka's eye realm, let alone the heavenly eye or the physical eye? Knowing the three-life retribution, good deeds will bring blessings, evil deeds will bring disaster, the Holy words will still not be wrong, and rich and poor, rich, poor, poor, long-lived, premature, dead, and poor all have their destiny, where is there any bias? Just like an image is beautiful or ugly, so is a shadow appearing in a mirror. A wise person knows how to change the image, but a foolish person hates the shadow! To still endure adversity is to know how to be happy with one's fate; Don't blame heaven and blame others, only then can you make a living.

Children have four seeds: repay favors, repay resentment, repay debts, collect debts. To repay gratitude is to be a son to his parents in previous lives. To repay the favor, he becomes a son and serves a lifetime of hard work, allowing his parents to be cared for happily when they are alive, and to be buried and worshiped when they die. Until you do things to help the country and its people, make your name famous, so that future generations will respect you and respect your parents like you: Tang Lo Cong, Tran Trung Tuc, Vuong Quy Linh, Su Dai Thanh... In this generation, all good children and grandchildren belong to that category.

Retaliation means that the parents were unkind to their child in the previous life, and the child came to be their child to take revenge. When I was young, I was disobedient, and when I grew up, I caused trouble for my parents; When their parents were alive, they did not provide for them. When they died, they let their shame spread to their relatives. There are even times when children hold important positions of power and do illegal things, causing houses to be destroyed, families to be destroyed, graves to be dug up, chains to be dug up, so that people in later generations will insult others and hate their parents, like Vuong Mang, Cao Cao, Dong Trac, Tan Coi...

Paying debt means that in a previous life, you lacked money from your parents. To repay the debt, you become a child. If you owe a lot, then pay it off until the end of your parents' life. If you owe a little or halfway, then leave. Like a student who has just become famous and then dies, a business that has just gained profit and suddenly dies.

Debt collection means that in a previous life, the parents owed money to the child, and now the child comes to reclaim it. If the debt is small, the parents only spend money on clothing, medicine, education, marriage, and teaching all the things they want to establish in the future, but because the term has expired, the child immediately passes away. If the debt is large, the child may spend it and destroy all of their parents' assets.

Now I see the death warrant as if it was a debt collector, but fortunately the debt was small, so as soon as I grew up, I quickly passed away. So lay people should repentance their previous karma and try their best to practice. Due to these blessings, perhaps one day the layperson will give birth to a precious child who will make the sect shine, right? It seems that Confucius was a Saint whose only son died in middle age, Master Nhan Uyen was a great sage, but his youth was short, Mr. Nguyen Hien was poor, and Master Tu Lo was martyred. Ba Di and Thuc Te starved to death in Thu Duong mountain, while Cu Ba Ngoc was miserable in the country of Ve. Do lay people think that saints and sages are punished by heaven because of cultivating virtue? Or is there a fate in life and death, wealth and wealth? Therefore, lay people should only blame their own virtues for not being enough, and not ask what blessings are for. If so, the fetters will come and disasters will naturally stay away.

In life, people have all eight sufferings, even if they are born in heaven, it is difficult to escape the five signs of decline. Only the world of Ultimate Bliss in the West is pure joy without suffering. Who knows, maybe because the lay people have contributed to spreading the Pure Land dharma, the Holy Spirit took that unblessed child and made a needle of awakening to pierce the top of his head, so that the lay people can clearly see that the three realms are like an unstable house on fire, the sufferings are full of fear, the impermanence of human life is as quick as lightning, when the great drought has come, no one can hold anyone back. All conditioned dharmas are like illusory dreams and bubbles. If we have not yet awakened, we need to practice Pure Karma. Is it any different from wood and stone without emotion? Who has the will to become a mass of flesh that can walk and run, so that one day it will rot with the grass and trees? Can't bear to be content with being in a foolish world, forever elevating the state of Sainthood? When one encounters an urgent reminder like that but does not get excited, when one hears the Dharma but refuses to follow it, is the Buddha supporting sentient beings or are sentient beings supporting the Buddha?

As a wise person, I hope lay people consider...
