tieu_de: 6/ Poetry in response to a brother of a Layman in Vinh Gia
tom_tat: From the height of spring, it didn't take long for summer to begin, the light was so quick, it was so startling! Every time I think of the two, although my faith is sincere, the truth is not clear enough, to the point of leaving the high place to follow the low place...
noi_dung:
6/ Poetry in response to a brother of a Layman in Vinh Gia

From the height of spring, it didn't take long for summer to begin, the light was so quick, it was so startling! Every time I think of the two people, although their belief is sincere, the truth is not clear, to the point that they abandon the high place to follow the low place, not only do they lose their right view, to laugh at the rich, but just like this An Quang, who has a reputation as someone who knows each other, he also feels ashamed! In the letter sent, the layman said: “If I write a book in the future, I will ask the government at any time.”But my eyes are weak, if nothing happens, I definitely won't be able to get close to writing, even if something needs to be done, looking back is like grouping a bunch of words, is there anything worth looking at? However, I'm afraid that I won't disappoint the two of you who have been longing for it, so I would like to briefly prepare some leftover soup and steamed rice. If you don't mind because of the strong smell, then you can temporarily relieve your heart so that you can one by one taste the delicacy of its own nature.

Regarding the article Tu Lia Simplicity, the meaning is very profound and relevant, so you should study it carefully. Please don't take the shallow explanations of a few people as contempt. If so, it would be a shame for Mr. Vinh Minh's great compassion. He was at a loss for words and advice. The reason why the book Reciting Sutras Benefits Depending on the Mind exists is because people in today's world, when receiving and reciting the Sutras, most of them do not have the slightest fear. If you want to gain the truth and benefits of Buddha Dharma, you must look for it in awe; If you are sincere and respectful, you can quickly attain Buddhahood, let alone a low status? The Venerable Thien Dao was originally the reincarnation of Amitabha Buddha and had great spiritual powers and wisdom, but in his teachings of the Pure Land sect, he did not favor the magical place, only appreciating the practical and ordinary. Regarding the specialized and mixed practice points he taught, it is extremely beneficial! Dedicated practice means the body karma specializes in ritual, the verbal karma specializes in confessing (when chanting sutras, if the mind is dedicated to dedicating merit of rebirth, it can also be called dedicated karma), the mind karma specializes in remembering. If that happens, all cultivators will be reborn without exception. Miscellaneous practice includes practicing many other methods that deduce merit in the West. Because the mind is not pure, it is difficult to get benefits. Out of hundreds of thousands of people, only three or four people hope to be reborn. These are golden words that are true and will not change for thousands of years. You should follow these words for your own benefit, and advise everyone. As far as reciting mantras are concerned, they should only be used as an aid to conduct, and should not be performed together with reciting the Buddha's name. Although the reciting mantras are inconceivable, ordinary people's rebirth depends entirely on their sincere faith and vows combined with the power of Amitabha's vows, and the path of interconnection and inspiration. If you don't understand this idea that all dharmas are inconceivable and you can practice any discipline, you will certainly become without meditation, without purity, forever immersed, then who will you turn to? As we consider that we are ordinary people full of karma obstacles, if it were not for the Buddha's preaching power, in this life it would be difficult to escape samsara, we see that the Pure Land Dharma is more powerful than all other Dharmas.

Reciting mantras and chanting sutras are used to plant blessings, wisdom, and eliminate karma, but if you hope to seek supernatural powers, that is leaving the roots behind and not using your mind wisely. If that mind is stubborn, coupled with unclear principles, unstable precepts, reciting Bodhi does not arise, the heart of winning and losing is overwhelming, I'm afraid one day the demons will go crazy! If you want to gain magical powers, you must first attain enlightenment; When you attain enlightenment, magical powers are self-sufficient. If you don't try hard on the path, just seek supernatural powers, don't say you won't get anything, even if you have it, it will become an obstacle to the path. Therefore, all Buddhas and Patriarchs strictly forbade them to practice and study in that way. Because everyday people have such thoughts, I will also mention them here. The two people in the house still have personal orders, so they often explain the Pure Land dharma and its inspirational stories, making people happy and believe in following them. If we don't take this as filial piety, even though it can be the filial piety of life, in the end, what benefit will it bring to our parents? King Vo, who was a Saint, couldn't even save his father, Con Hoa, who caused the three-legged turtle to fall into the cattle race. Seeing this, don't you wake up and urgently pray to bring your spiritual consciousness to attend the Lien Tri meeting, so that you can be close to the Buddha so that you can witness the nature of Infinite Light and Life?

Although layperson Chi Lien's asceticism is good, I'm afraid she doesn't understand the Pure Land principles, or can't let go of all the thoughts of turning women into men and hoping to enjoy blessings in the heavens and humans, then the boundless benefits will be wasted because of the small joys of the world! This should be explained clearly so that her ambition can be more decisive. Furthermore, advising a person to be born in the Pure Land is to achieve one sentient being to become a Buddha, and having become a Buddha, all sentient beings will be saved, and that much merit will be yours. Furthermore, Pure Land practitioners have advised everyone on this method, so why not guide their wives and children so that they can give the family members a great benefit? If a relative already has good roots, what could be better? If not, then we must gradually mold each day closer to the truth. This is called deep compassion. If we abandon this and call it charity, it will only have a name that is not real. What I said is just a brief summary of a few things to give an overview, not enough to be disrespectful, please see clearly the Pure Land Ten Essentials, Pure Land Thanh Hien Luc; Lac Bang Van Loai... I have my own place to turn to, there's no doubt about it anymore.

The suffering in Samsara is endless. Even in times of peace, sentient beings are still crowded in the heat of the heart, but because they have endured it for a long time, they have become accustomed to it, so they do not know it themselves. Recently, China often suffers from war and fire, the suffering is unspeakable! Looking at foreign countries, the great war has been going on for three years, the death toll is too much but the war is still going on, there is no telling when it will end. That tragic scene was caused by the evil karma of sentient beings, which is also the state of the opening sword warrior life; The suffering later, if you think about it, is terrifying! I hope that both of you will develop a great heart and quickly pray for rebirth so that you can soon attain enlightenment and return to save sentient beings in this Saha world. Kinh says: “Bodhisattva fears the cause, living beings fear the effect.”Bodhisattva is afraid of bringing evil consequences, so he should cut off evil causes, sentient beings compete to create evil causes, and then suffer evil consequences. While suffering, we don't know that repentance will cause more evil to counteract, so the injustice and retribution continue endlessly, pitiful but also scary!

Knowing this, not seeking to be born in the West is not yet a man!

tieu_de: 7/ Poem in response to Layman Boc Dai Pham
tom_tat: Seeing the literary painting from afar, I couldn't help but feel ashamed! An Quang was uneducated from a young age, so his knowledge was vague. He had been drifting in a foreign land for a long time, only eating in Pho Da. Today I did not expect that you, a person who deeply understands the heart of Confucianism,...
noi_dung:
7/ Poem in response to Layman Boc Dai Pham

Seeing the literary painting from afar, I couldn't help but feel ashamed! An Quang was uneducated from a young age, so his knowledge was vague. He had been drifting in a foreign land for a long time, only eating in Pho Da. Today, I did not expect that you, a person who deeply understood the mind of Confucianism and Buddha, had consulted on the methods of knowledge and learned the super-massive way of life, and did not consider it rustic to ask questions, but instead of praising him, it made people feel confused and uneasy. I secretly think that you are widely educated and have a high level of understanding, so perhaps you still have doubts about such trivial things. It is probably not out of your own desire to be an example to guide those fellow practitioners. However, you have taken knowing as not knowing, I don't mind taking not knowing as knowing, please answer according to the answer, I don't dare to imitate the old mandarin reviewing the verdict, but rather be the student who submitted the exam notebook. So the following statements, if there are any mistakes, please ask the government.

1. Although reciting the Buddha's name is precious in the mind, one should not abandon reciting it out loud, because the body, mouth, and mind help each other. Even though the mind can remember and think, if the body is not respectful and the mouth does not recite, it will be difficult to benefit. Like people in the world, when carrying heavy objects, they still have to use the language to help, let alone wanting to take the mind to attain Samadhi? Therefore, the Great Collection Sutra says: "If you recite big, you will see a big Buddha; if you recite small, you will see a small Buddha."The ancients also said: "If you recite loudly, you will see the Buddha's body is tall. If you recite it softly, you will see the Buddha's body is small."For ordinary people, the mind is often dull and scattered. If it were not for the strength of body and mouth, it would be difficult to have one mind.

2. The new reality is that there is no more birth and death. In addition, in Buddha, is there any dharma that is not born and died? An Enlightened Bodhisattva breaks the forty-one levels of ignorance and attains the forty-one secret organs, but it is no different from taking, giving up, birth, and death, let alone reciting the Buddha's name for ordinary people? But birth and death, although it is the root of birth and death, is also the root of Bodhi. Whether there is birth and death or not depends only on the person. Taking in all six senses, connecting with pure mindfulness, is to change birth and destruction to the union of sense and dust, to change birth and death to union of worldly sense, to realize the true Buddha nature as if there is no birth and death.

3. “Memorial in the newly reborn Pure Land”belongs to the status of a high-class reborn person. If you accept this definition to seek the Highest Rank, what's better? If you accept to teach the middle and lower level of ability, it will hinder one's advancement to a great extent. Why? Because they consider this Dharma too high, then accept a lowly fate and refuse to practice it. Again, although Buddha's recitation belongs to consciousness, it also includes all consciousnesses. Doesn't the sutra text say: “Taking care of all six senses”that? If the six senses are taken care of, what is the use of the six consciousnesses? That is, transferring the Buddha's recitation into the function of the storehouse consciousness is no different from the uses of the six consciousnesses.

4. Paragraph questioning the item"Recite the Buddha continuously, the knife will not cut"still not surprised; But because you have not distinguished between the limits of Zen Buddhism, the Pure Land, and self and other powers, you have become a mass of doubts. The method of reciting the Buddha's name is to rely on the Buddha's power to go to the three realms and be born in the Pure Land. Now we have neither made a vow nor have faith. If you do not believe in your vow, just reciting the Buddha's name still belongs to your own power, and because you lack faith in your vow, you cannot sympathize with Amitabha's power of preaching. Even if one can eliminate afflictions, views and thoughts, one can still be reborn. If one has not eliminated them, or has not eliminated them completely, the original karma still remains and must be reincarnated. Regarding this, Mr. Ngu To Gioi and Thao Duong Thanh are real evidence. You must know, if you give up your faith and pray and recite Buddha's name, it is no different from the meditation practice of a monk. And if reborn, wouldn't cause and effect be inconsistent? Mr. Random Ich said: “Whether one is born or not depends entirely on one's faith, yes or no; High and low positions are all based on deep and shallow meritorious deeds."is a thesis that certainly does not change. In the Amitabha Sutra, the verse: “One heart is not chaotic”is to rely on the passage of merit y, righteousness, in the previous text to encourage faith, and following the passage: “If any sentient beings hear this sutra, they should make vows to pray to be born in that country.”It means making vows. Furthermore, regarding the point of faith and prayer, the following paragraphs are repeated many times. You guys cut out those paragraphs and just look at the sentences“one heart is not chaotic”Seeing the single-mindedness of having faith in the vow and not believing in the vow as the same, I wonder about:"Reciting the Buddha's name to the point where a knife can't cut it means it's pure, so why can't it be reborn?"

5. In addition to Buddha's recitation, if there are other recitations, it is mixed. There are so many thoughts that it's hard to list them all, just the main ones are: reciting for great enlightenment, great enlightenment, reciting for great attainment, etc. It's not just that making vows is confusing. You should know that the Pure Land dharma takes Faith, Vows, and Virtue as its guiding principles. Virtue is like a chariot, Prayer is like a driver, Faith is like a guide, all three are enough to achieve the success of the chariot. Therefore, Pure Land practitioners must make vows early in the morning. Also, don't think that when you don't recite Buddha, or when making vows, it's cut off, mixed up, and pure recitation fails. Try asking: Has that thought ever experienced scenes of seeing, hearing, wearing clothes, eating meals, and other movements? If so, with these things there are no interruptions or confusion, why do you consider the other things to be chaos? Therefore, even reciting Buddha's name will lead to a state of realm“One thought lasts forever”also not afraid of daily migration. Absolutely nothing, or only the dharma body Bodhisattva can handle it. But even though the Great Beings stay still in one place, they appear in countless bodies in the world of dust, doing countless Buddha things. If there are any disturbances, then surely we don't know how many? All Buddhas and Bodhisattva can reach all ten directions at the same time, but this is just one thing, actually our mind still has all the principles, responding to all things, it's not just like that!

6. According to ancient rituals, making vows is usually made between early morning and evening. But there are also people who, after reciting Buddha's name, immediately declare merit making vows. You have deeply understood the nature and appearance and still think: "Reciting Buddha and praying for birth cannot go together", it seems to the prosecutor that there is no problem and is not yet convinced. Again said: “If I could wear socks, my thoughts would be divided into two: half about Buddha, half about vows, then one person becomes two Buddhas.I would like to ask, in a normal state, do you ever have times when your eyes see colors but your ears still hear sounds and your mind still thinks? If that is so, why do you still doubt this matter? Therefore, you should know that the effects of thoughts are unpredictable; Are the eight consciousnesses not the function of one mind? That didn't become eight Buddhas, why did this become two Buddhas?

7. When you are born, you absolutely do not believe in your vows. When you are about to die, it is difficult to rely on the Buddha's power. Said: “When good and bad karma appear at the same time”, then not only does the Buddha's chant not appear and not cause rebirth, even if it exists, it also cannot be reborn. Why? Because I didn't make vows for rebirth, because I didn't ask Buddha for guidance. Avatamsaka Sutra says: “If evil karma had a form, the emptiness of the ten directions would not be able to contain it.”Ancient virtue said: "There is a lot of karma in the mind, falling into a heavy burden is like being in debt, the strong master pulls it away."Now both good and bad karma appear, because if you do not believe in your vows, you will inevitably be attracted by the force of karma and lose your intention. So you know, relying on your own strength, even if you have a shred of karma, you will not be able to escape birth and death, are there too many choices? Reciting Buddha with one mind without faith, among countless people, or luckily there are a few who are reborn. It is very advisable not to teach that and destroy the Pure Land good roots of all sentient beings in the future. Because if we only rely on the power of mindfulness until karma stops our love and emptiness and attain the patience of non-birth, it will be difficult for us to find a couple in the whole world. If everyone followed this theory and practiced without paying attention to faith and vows, countless sentient beings would be drowned in the ocean of suffering, with no way to escape, because of just one word causing harm. But the person who advocates the above theory is still arrogant and arrogant, thinking that his words are very high; Little did we know that it was crazy talk that would end the Buddha's wisdom and cause sentient beings to go astray and become suspicious! What a pity!

Pure Land teachings must be considered special and should not be compared with ordinary teachings. If the Buddha did not open this door, surely in the Dharma Ending Age no one would escape the path of birth and death! Amitabha's Essential Commentaries of Mr. Ngan Ich, the arguments all reach the extreme. If the lower robes follow and practice, then one day the position of rebirth will be second to none. People in the past who practiced practice were able to attain enlightenment, but on the contrary, people in today's world are rarely clear-minded. Is it because the base is low? Or is it due to respect and contempt that causes this? I read many stories and saw that the great men all respected the sutras and images like the living Buddha. Their awe, even though they were loyal servants and filial children, could not be even a little bit high. Because of their extreme devotion, they were able to attain enlightenment and go straight to the Holy Realm. Let's see the Second Patriarch Than Quang standing in the snow, cutting off his arm to pray for the Dharma in Shaolin, it's enough to see how respectful he is! People today view Buddha statues as dirt and wood, and Buddha scriptures as old paper. Even if they have faith in receiving and upholding them, they are just reading and reciting them through their mouths, there is no real benefit worth discussing! Although this can also sow evil, the crime of contempt is truly unthinkable! You are a well-educated scholar. When promoting Buddha Dharma, please remind us of this so that everyone can benefit. Thus, how happy the dharma and sentient beings will be!

---o0o---

tieu_de: 8/ Poem sent to Layman Ve Cam Chau
tom_tat: (The lay person encountered a fire disaster, his house and belongings were burned, his wife was frightened and seriously ill, so her mind was confused like crazy. An Quang Dharma Master sent this letter advising
noi_dung:
8/ Poem sent to Layman Ve Cam Chau

(The lay person encountered a fire disaster, his house and belongings were burned, his wife was frightened and seriously ill, so her mind was confused like crazy. An Quang Dharma Master sent this letter to advise...)

The Lotus Sutra says: “The three realms are not peaceful, like a house on fire, filled with suffering, very terrifying.”However, many times circumstances also shape people through the following stages: disaster, blessings, adversity, favor, suffering, joy... not certain. For those who are wise, know the power to change, and are skillful in following their fate, what misfortunes, adversities, and sufferings do not turn into blessings, blessings, and joy?

Therefore, a gentleman is often happy according to his share, knows his fate, does not blame heaven and blame others, and no matter what situation he encounters, he is still at ease and calm! There is an ancient saying: "Rich scenes follow wealth, poor situations follow poverty, barbarism follow barbarism, tribulation scenes follow tribulation..."Although lay people have a heart for good things, they do not yet understand the principles of Confucianism and Buddhism, so when they encounter adversity, they become confused and crazy. I would like to give the following for lay people to clearly understand:

In life, it is very wide, thick, high and bright, no more than heaven and earth and the sun and moon. But the sun stands still and then fades, the moon becomes full and then thins, until the high hills become abyss, the sea turns into mulberry fields, life is still the same, changes in prosperity and decline are normal. In the past, who was more virtuous than Confucius, but he had to be besieged in the land of Khuan, deprived of food in the Tran country, traveled to different countries and ended up with nothing, only one son died at the age of fifty, luckily he still had a grandchild to continue his ancestors. One level lower, like Master Nhan Uyen and Nhiem Ba Nguu, have a short life; Master Tu Ha and Ta Ky Minh are blind; Mr. Khuat Nguyen drowned; Master Tu Lo was bruised. Like those who are great saints and sages, they cannot avoid adversity, but because they know how to follow their destiny, they still follow their fate and be happy. These things seemed like no blessings at that time, but their moral example hundreds of years later, from kings to people, who wouldn't admire them? Then what is more blessing? In life, people consider many things, do many things, but only consider the matter of dressing and leaving a career for their children and grandchildren. But eating vegetable soup can last a meal, there's no need for seafood; If you wear it, cloth is enough to cover your body. Should you choose a lot of brocade? As for the children and grandchildren, whether they work in the fields or sell wholesale, they can all support themselves, so why do they have to be hundreds of thousands rich? Besides, in the past, for those who strive for eternal glory for their children and grandchildren, is there anyone like Qin Shi Huang? This tyrant destroyed six kingdoms, burned books and buried his students, gathered all the weapons in the world to cast bells, and wrote his will to make the people stupid and weak so they could not rebel. Unexpectedly, when Tran Thiep stood up, the heroes all rose up, the unification fortune of less than thirteen years suddenly disappeared, and even his descendants were wiped out. That is to give the descendants glory and return to ruin. During the reign of Emperor Hien of the Han Dynasty, Cao Cao borrowed the position of Prime Minister, specializing in authority and power to oppress the king, wanting to make his descendants lords of the country. Unexpectedly, when he died, before his body could be shrouded, Cao Pi rebelled and forced his father's concubine to be his concubine. Cao Cao died and fell into the evil realm, for more than fourteen hundred years, during the reign of Qianlong in the Qing Dynasty, in Suzhou, someone killed a pig. When he was dissected, he saw the words on the lung.“Cao Cao.”A neighbor saw that scene, was very scared, immediately left the home life to practice, his dharma name was Buddha An, focused on thinking Buddha was born in the West. This is recorded in Pure Land Thanh Hien Luc. For example, Cao Cao spent his entire life caring for his children and grandchildren. Although he was made Emperor, within only forty-five years he lost his country. Besides, when he was still on the throne, every year he often fought with the Eastern Ngo and Western Shu countries. How many times did he have peace? From then on, through the dynasties: Jin, Song, Qi, Liang, Chen, Sui, and Five Dynasties: Liang, Tang, Jin, Han, and Chau all did not last long. All in all, the Eastern Jin Dynasty was the most durable, but it only lasted a hundred and three years. Otherwise, it was either two or three years, eight or nine years, or one twenty years, four or fifty years, and then it was destroyed. This is just a few generations of orthodoxy, if we talk about the puppet dynasties of usurpation, the time is even shorter. Many kings and lords of those dynasties, at first, wanted to bring glory to their clan, but when they sought the truth, on the contrary, it caused their descendants to be robbed and killed, losing their lineage.

Lay people should think: Being as luxurious as a son of heaven and rich in the four seas cannot even guarantee the clan to enjoy long-term blessings, let alone ordinary people who, from countless eons until now, have created evil karma as thick as the land and as deep as the sea, but want their houses to always flourish and have blessings? You must know that the things in life are all false, like dreams, illusions, shadows, foam, dew, lightning, like the moon at the bottom of water, flowers in a mirror, like flickering light in the sun, and like the city of the god Gandharva (God's music god, citadels are all illusory), nothing is real. There is only one thought that my nature remains constant, covering all past and present, without change or decay. Although it does not change, it often depends on fate: According to the conditions of pure enlightenment, they can become Sravakas, Pratyekabuddhas, Bodhisattvas, and Buddhas. Because of their deep and shallow merits, their dignity can be high and low; According to the fate of delusion, one gets lost in the realms of Gods, Humans, Asuras, Animals, Hungry Ghosts, and Hell. Due to the severity of blessings, suffering and joy can be short or long. If people don't know Buddha's teachings, then that's fine. Lay people are devoted to Buddhism. Why don't they take advantage of that adverse situation to see life clearly, abandon their delusion and follow enlightenment, and wholeheartedly recite Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West, cross the path of samsara, and ascend to the throne of the Four Saints; Is it a small calamity to enjoy great blessings? The way out is like that, the lay people are still confused and dreamy like they are stupid; If you are often too worried and sad to the point of losing your life, not only will you be doomed to many lifetimes, but your weak wife and orphans will also be helpless, how can you be independent? Like that, lay people want to harm themselves and cause trouble for others. Why is it so dark?

Kinh says: “Bodhisattva fears the cause, living beings fear the effect.”Because he avoids suffering, Bodhisattva puts an end to evil causes, thus his sins are eliminated and his merits are full, until he becomes a Buddha. Living beings often commit evil deeds but want to avoid suffering. Are they like people who are afraid of their own shadow and keep running away from the sun? Many people who have just done a little good hope to receive great blessings, but when faced with adversity, they immediately think: "Doing good causes disaster, there is no cause and effect", then from then on, he retreated from his initial mind and returned to criticizing Buddha's teachings. Those people don't understand“The principle of cause and effect applies to all three generations”and“My mind can change the situation”.What is cause and effect through all three generations? Whether you do good or evil in this life, receive blessings or bring disaster in this life, that is retribution. If you do good or evil in this life, you will receive blessings or disaster in the next life, which is retribution. Doing good or evil in this life, in the third, fourth, or ten, hundred, thousand, forever, until countless, boundless lifetimes later will receive blessings or disaster, called retribution. The consequences are unpredictable sooner or later. Causes must have consequences, that is natural. How can my mind improve the situation? For example, if someone commits evil karma, they will forever fall into Hell and suffer many lifetimes of suffering; That person suddenly feels fear and shame, develops Bodhi, changes evil for good, chants Buddha's sutras, practices self-cultivation and advises others, praying to be reborn in Ultimate Bliss. Due to that repentance, the previous Hell karma was immediately destroyed, changing into light suffering in the present life such as: or being despised by others, or being sick, poor, or encountering unsatisfactory things. After suffering such contempt, that person can escape the path of birth and death and enter the sublime Sainthood. As the Diamond Sutra says: “If there is a person who accepts and upholds this sutra and is despised by others, that person has committed karma in a previous life and is destined to fall into the evil path. Because of being despised in this life, his previous sins will immediately be destroyed, and he will attain Supreme Bodhi.”

This is the meaning: Your mind can change the situation.

When people encounter accidents, if they don't resent heaven, they will blame others. Few people think about repaying karma and repent. Must know: “If you plant melons, you will get melons; if you plant beans, you will get beans.”It's natural that once you've sown thorns, don't expect to reap sticky rice in the harvest. Doing evil and still enjoying blessings means that the previous life has built up a strong foundation of blessings. If you don't do evil, the blessings will be even greater. For example, if a child from a rich family gambles and treats money like trash, but he doesn't immediately get hungry or cold, it's because he has too much wealth. If every day continues like that, even if we have hundreds of thousands of karma, there will definitely be times when people will lose their homes and be destroyed. If you do good and often encounter accidents, it means you planted deep roots of sin in your previous life. If you don't do good, the disaster will be even greater. For example, a person who commits a serious crime has not yet had time to be executed, but he achieves a small merit; Because the merit is small, it cannot be completely pardoned, so the heavy sentence should be changed to a light one. If you continue to make great contributions, not only will you be able to eliminate all previous sins, but you will also be awarded the title of Marquis, worshiping generals, and attain eternal peace.

A man must go beyond common sense and not let external things affect him. Suppose you have a warehouse full of gold and gems, and when an evil enemy comes to rob you, you have to leave home and run away. Don't hold on to your wealth and wait for death. Because gold and jade are precious, but compared to human life, they are still inferior; Since I couldn't keep both, I would rather give up my wealth and preserve my life. As it is now, the assets of lay people have turned into piles of ashes. Worrying about sadness is useless. We should just rely on fate and try our best to recite Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West, so that in our future lives we will completely leave suffering and only enjoy happiness. So because of a disaster, you have achieved Supreme enlightenment, why are you still confused and sad?

I hope that lay people will carefully consider what I said, and they will surely be able to remove their sadness, like a cloudy parrot revealing the clear sky, where disaster finds happiness, changing the heat to coolness and joy. If you continue to accept not being awake, it will be difficult to avoid the disease of hysteria. If once the original mind is lost, evil spirits will rely on it; At that time, even if a thousand Buddhas were born, we still don't know how to save it!

9/ Poem in response to a Layman in Vinh Gia

1. Great Master Van The teaches people from a place of truth when it comes to legislating. If you practice according to that, you will gain thousands of peace, definitely not to the point of having little as enough and being driven crazy by demons. Vuong Canh Tam did not clearly understand the principles of entering the Dharma, so he was quick to proudly write and scold everyone. Although he had the heart to propagate the Dharma, he was actually committing the crime of sabotaging the Dharma. That is also because he is not close to the level of knowledge and considers two diseases: My beating heart, my nightmare. These diseases are all symptoms of evil karma from previous lives. But, although the current situation is good or bad, the change is only up to us. If bad scenes appear, if you focus on Buddha, the bad karma will turn into good, the evil karma of the past life will become the guru in the present. Unfortunately, most people in life are bound by karma and cannot reform, so they end up falling into a well and being followed by falling stones, causing even more suffering!

There are many things that are not the same in other minds. Now, I would like to talk about the minds of enlightened people. Like Great Master Tru Am, no matter what scripture anyone asked, he could recite it clearly, without missing a single word. Why? Because Great Master Karma has no love and emptiness, his heart is like a shining mirror; When someone asked about the scriptures they had read, he immediately looked at the words printed in that person's eighth consciousness and read them clearly. Therefore, the ancients said: "The Dharma was once infected with the spirit of consciousness and constantly imitated the teachings."The above can serve as evidence for us to believe. Because when people read the scriptures, the shadows of those things are imprinted in their minds and are not lost. Because of ignorance, they forget for a long time. Those who have other minds look at that person's mind and reread it clearly depending on the question. For example, when someone asks about scriptures that they have not yet seen, the wise person can look into the minds of others who have already seen them and read them again for them. Above is the act of taking other people's minds to work for your own mind, not that in their hearts there are often many scriptures that have been memorized for a long time and not forgotten. Because they do not understand this reason, many people think it is some strange magic, but in fact it is just a state of karma dissipating intelligence and light, and the heart is empty.

In the conspiracy, there are many ghosts and spirits impersonating fairies, Buddhas, saints, and gods. Lowly demons or when they do not have other minds; High-ranking people know people's hearts, so they can borrow their intellectual intelligence to write poetry. Mr. Ky Van Dat said: “The writing is mostly a lie borrowed from spiritual demons. One day, my brother Dan Nhien and I had an experiment on this. I have a natural talent for poetry but my writing is bad, my brother has good writing but has no literary talent. When I use a pen, my words are clear and my handwriting is sloppy. On the contrary, when it was my brother's turn, his handwriting was beautiful and his vocabulary was mediocre. Another thing, when asked about the secret point in the pseudonymous lectures taken from the ancients, Co said: The years are too long to remember. For those reasons, I know it is false.”So, although demons are spiritual, they can only borrow people's current understanding. As for the things in the mind that exist, where the current knowledge has been forgotten for a long time, or the words and meanings that one does not understand, the devil cannot point them out. Therefore, the ability to understand the mind of a demon spirit, compared to that of an enlightened person, is as far away as the sky. However, because these two things have similarities, I am afraid that lay people will be deceived by the mechanics of writing, so I will explain them here. Let me say one more thing in the Tale of Tong Cao Tang: The Venerable Monk went to Vuong Chu Hau's house to receive his son's dinner. He saw the owner reciting in a high voice and seemed pleased, so he asked what literature he was reading? Chu Hau replied: “This is my PhD notebook.”Giam smiled and said: “Under the cool breeze, is there such tolerance?”Saying this, he took out a book from his pocket and said: “Is this the book you are reading?”Chu Hau saw that it was the essay he did on the exam day, so he said: “This is my autograph that I wrote down later.”Sangha said: “Of course it's not your original work, I still know that.”Chu Hau continued: “But why is there that essay in that bag?”The Master replied: "Not just this article, from the time you read the book until now, to the times when joking, one stroke of a pen or drawing, I have enough in my pocket."Tri Hau was scared and didn't dare to ask anymore. Mr. Tru Am only has the ability to forgive the mind, but has not seen any supernatural powers. Great Master Sang Giam had the ability to understand other minds and also have supernatural powers. He could bring the shadows of scriptures in his store consciousness into physical form and present them to the viewer. In fact, his pocket did not contain such a thing.

Recently, a lot of mechanical pens have opened in Shanghai. The teachings of giving up evil and doing good and the short-sighted samsara cause and effect theories of those forums are all very useful for the world and people's hearts. But some points about heaven and Buddha's teachings are inevitably vague and confused. We are Buddha's disciples, we should not refute that, because it is an obstacle to people's good deeds, but we should also not compliment it, because we will be guilty of using unrealistic speculations, causing confusion in the Buddha's teachings, causing sentient beings to misunderstand. This An Quang considers himself to have many karma obstacles but decides not to dare to follow his emotions and abandon reason, causing mistakes to others. The above words are a guide to follow reason and avoid bad things.

Ten benefits of Buddha recitation, please see chapter“The Triumph of the Ten Assemblies”in the last pages of Pure Land Chi Qui. “dedicated merit”is the mind that thinks, the mouth that utters the words of faith, where to direct one's merits.

This should be done after evening and noon work, when chanting sutras and reciting Buddha's name is finished. Reciting Buddha's name must be from morning until afternoon and should not be interrupted; If in the mind there is always the thought of seeking rebirth, it is also a permanent dedicating merit. The Mahayana Sutras all help sentient beings quickly become Buddhas. Unfortunately, most people read the sutras without sincerity, so they do not receive complete benefits. Chapter“Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva”In book five of the Shurangama Sutra, it is the ultimate teaching of the Pure Land sect. Sentence"The gentleman learns for himself"This means that a gentleman examines himself with every thought to see if he has gone against the path or not? Realm“wake and sleep as one”, can only be done with meticulous diligence. But if you constantly meditate on the Buddha when you are awake, over a long period of time, naturally, even in your dreams, you will rarely have false thoughts.

2. From the end of winter to the middle of March this year, I received four envelopes of letters, food, fabric, and questions and answers from lay brothers and Tu Quan, brought by Master Than. Thus, it is enough to see that lay people are passionate about religion and respect me so much! First of all, I wanted Tu Quan to come, secondly because I was censoring the Van Sao to have people print it, my eyes were a bit weak, so I was late in responding. The poem is from December, it is true to its meaning"Friends help each other", it's just that dedicating An Quang too much makes people even more ashamed!

Humanity has five great precepts: My king, father and son, brothers, husband, wife and friends. But why is there no mention of Teacher in those five cycles? Because the Teacher is the one who accomplishes our moral desires, just like our father, who guides and advises us so that we can become human beings, just like our brothers, Mencius said: “I am your father.”Furthermore, the Teacher often reminds us that he can help us in many ways as well as you, so the Buddha family often calls: “Find the Teacher and ask you.”This An Quang considers himself to be less than virtuous and has no intention of becoming a teacher, only wanting to be in the position of a friend to help and advise each other. But many of you didn't consider it for me, so I lacked the admonishment and wasn't even reminded of it! The layperson hoped that I would attain Samadhi, but was afraid that my hope would be contrary to what I hoped for, so he did not insist on hard work and wrote poems of advice. Since I tied my hair to study until now, I have not met such a helpful person. That gesture made An Quang both touched and ashamed! The words "death penalty" are words used by servants and kings, and by lay people, it is very inappropriate to use them with your teacher. The seal of Quang Su karma was so severe that when he was born just half a year ago, he had eye pain for six months. The suffering during that time was extremely immense, except when eating and sleeping, there was never a moment of screaming and crying. But fortunately, thanks to the good roots of my previous life, I can still see sunlight. When he reached the age of maturity, he studied again under the guidance of old karma, mistakenly drinking poison that slandered Buddha's Dharma from Han Du and Au Duong Tu. Next, concentrate your mind and think that you have made a mistake, immediately feel ashamed, take refuge in the Three Jewels leaving the home life to increase. If at that time it had not been for the power of the Three Jewels to secretly prepare and awaken my awareness, I would have fallen into Avici prison and endured countless sufferings. Would I still be able to talk about self-reliance and the strength of others with those who teach East and West, discussing about self-reliance and the strength of others like today?

The seventh cycle is complete, the Samadhi has not yet been achieved, due to my spiritual weakness but also due to my deep karma. But Buddha did not abandon the heavy burden, please also rely on that little merit to be reborn. The Ten Niem Ky Number method is not the method of counting breaths, only the memorization of points from one to ten is somewhat similar to the method of counting breaths. In Lien Tong Bao Giam, the mistake is to count to hundreds, thousands, ten thousand. Because I'm afraid that lay people won't know and will be harmed, I'll cite it to prove it clearly, so it shouldn't be called the magic of reciting the name. If you want to attain Samadhi, you already have the correct teachings of the Buddha and the Patriarchs, so why do you need to wait for my testimony to follow? The Amitabha Sutra says: “Keep the title, from one day to seven days, with one mind and no chaos.”(This is a ratio that should not be accepted. If the natural nature is Enlightened, one thought will be achieved without confusion, why wait another day? As for the evil nature, even for a lifetime it is difficult to have one mind, let alone seven days?) The Quan Sutra says: “The Dharma body of all Buddhas Tathagata enters the minds of all sentient beings. So when your mind thinks of Buddha, that mind is the thirty-two appearances, eighty beauties depending on shape, that mind thinks of Buddha, that mind is Buddha."The Shurangama Sutra, Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva says: "Reflecting on all six senses, practicing mindfulness one after another, attaining the Three Demons, this is the best."In the verse on choosing the Perfect Root, Venerable Manjushri said: “Listen in, listen to your own nature. The nature of attaining the Supreme Way.”Sutra Forty-Two Chapters teaches: “What is cultivating the mind? If you keep it in one place, nothing will be done."Mr. Mong Dong said: "For the sake of birth and death, develop the heart of Bodhi, take deep vows, and recite the name Buddha."These sixteen words are the outline of the Pure Land sect. If you want to practice Samadhi, why don't you take the Holy Word as the measure, thoroughly follow the above words, and use me as an ordinary person with karma hindrance as a standard? Isn't that contrary?

But, those words did not come without reason. Perhaps because they saw in the book Amitabha Trung Luan clearly describing the realm of Great Master Tinh Nhat, and Vuong Canh Tam said that he had the heart to transmit to him, lay people think that I also have many inconceivable strange scenes, and the secret to transmitting that life? Lay people should consider: Samadhi is translated as right concentration or right feeling, it is the state of illusion that dissolves true reality, quiet and clear, where is there any realm in it? Therefore, the Shurangama Sutra says: “To attain Bodhi is to attain nothing.”Meditation practitioners rely only on their own strength and do not need Buddha's help, so while their practice is effective, false truths attack each other, often many realms are hidden and appear at first. For example, when the heavy rain is about to stop, the clouds disperse, the gloomy sky suddenly reveals light, and suddenly changes unexpectedly. These realms, if one does not have the right spiritual vision, are difficult to distinguish. If you mistake it for truth, you will be driven crazy by demons and cannot be cured. Other than that, the person who recites the Buddha's name uses faith and vows, fervently reciting the names of all virtues, like the sun shining brightly in the middle of nowhere, like walking on a wide straight path, not only do the ghosts and demons disappear, but the false thoughts also quiet down. After all, no matter how pure the power of mindfulness is, the whole mind is the Buddha, the whole Buddha is the mind, the mind of the Buddha is one. I'm afraid people don't understand these reasons and virtues. I still want to praise them to highlight the Buddha's vow to save all sentient beings. Why would I dare to keep them hidden and pass them on exclusively to lay people? If there is a private transmission secret in a hidden place, it means that it is an evil spirit of a pagan religion, not Buddha Dharma. But An Quang really has a magic secret that is only available to him. Now, when requested by lay people, he does not hesitate to reveal it to Buddhists in the world. What is that magic decision? It is sincere and respectful. The whole world knows this, this principle is known to the whole world! Because An Quang wanted to eliminate the deep karma sins and repay the Buddha's kindness, he always paid attention to the spiritual example of the ancient monks, so he learned that sincerity and reverence are the very secret to transcending mortals to become saints and escape the path of samsara. I have often advised these points to predestined people. You should know that being respectful is not just for those who study Buddha, but in all things, if you want to be pure, you must take this as the foundation.

Tu Quan had planted spiritual roots in his previous life, his relatives had worshiped Buddha for several generations. When he was young, he had complete teachings, and when he grew up, he spent twenty years studying and reviewing. Why did he leave the magical place, use the ordinary place, and love my literature to print it like that? You should know that propagating the Dharma is precious where you know the right time. The treatment that is worth using for the diseases of today's people, those who understand Buddhism do not clarify, only talk about mystical methods, most of which are drugs that are not suitable for the disease. Sometimes due to that precious medicine, the disease increases. An Quang is like someone who uses medicine, not only does he not understand the origin of the disease but also does not understand the nature of the medicine. He only takes the Van Ung A Da Da medicine (A Da Da translates as Universal Tri, the medicine to cure all diseases) of his esoteric ancestors. He uses this medicine to drink for many diseases such as deficiency, realness, cold, and heat. If anyone has faith, try it and you will be safe. Even the diseases of Tan Huan and Bien Thuoc were helpless. When I took this medicine, I immediately saw a return to birth and death. Therefore, for those who have the heart to save lives, I do not hesitate to send out advertising cards, so that all patients can receive this medicine. I still know that the remedies of Tan Huan and Bien Thuoc are miraculous, but I do not advise people to use them, because diseases that belong to karma cannot be cured by the power of divine medicine...

Realizing the truth in this life, it is not true that the world is completely empty of people, but I am afraid that lay people do not yet have that good root. If I do not clearly state the reason, or when the layperson is at his highest level but his conduct is not up to par, because he is too delusional about attaining fruition, over time the disease of hysteria and scattering of the mind will arise. At that time, praying for transcendence turns into falling, if you want to skillfully become clumsy, the result will not escape samsara. You must know that only by realizing the second principle, only ordinary people will have enough ability. Just like the person of the Perfect Teaching, in the name of the name, although he has not yet overcome his afflictions, his enlightenment is still the same as that of all Buddhas. If we talk about Buddhism, that realm is called great enlightenment; The teachings are the great opener of enlightenment. But great enlightenment and ultimate solution are not just enlightenment in an imagined way! Nhu Bang Cu Si heard Ma To say: "Wait until you drink a sip of West River water, I will tell you.", immediately forgot the explanation. Venerable Dai Hue Kieu heard meditation master Vien Ngo recite: "The wind blows into the temple, cool air lingers", also. Great Master Tri Jia chanted the Phap Hoa sutras to the sentence: “That is true diligence, called the true dharma of making offerings Tathagata…”In the book Medicine King Ban Su, at first he was completely enlightened, quietly entered concentration, and saw that the Linh Son assembly had not yet dissolved. Such enlightenment is called great thoroughness, great enlightenment, great enlightenment. That is enlightenment, if we talk about attaining enlightenment in its true form, then it is not the work of ordinary people. Mr. Nam Nhac Hue Tu, Master Tri Gia's Dharma Master, is a person with great magical powers and wisdom. When he was about to pass away, someone asked for his testimony and replied: "I originally only prayed for Dong Luan, but because I received them too early, I could only witness Thiet Luan."(Dong Luan means the Ten Pillars, breaking through ignorance, realizing true form, entering the realm of true reward, attaining the Pure Light. The first abiding level can manifest as the Buddha body in one hundred Great Heaven realms to teach and transform sentient beings. The two pillars are a thousand realms, the three pillars are ten thousand, each pillar's number increases tenfold. Thiet Luan means the Ten Faithful. First faith puts an end to delusions, bad faith puts an end to delusions, eight, nine, ten, faith destroys dust, overcomes ignorance. Mr. Nam Nhac appears at the throne of the Ten Faiths, but has not yet realized his true form). Great Master Tri Jia was the incarnation of Shakyamuni Buddha. When he was about to pass away, someone asked: "To what position is the master certified?"Answer: "If I do not receive them, I will surely purify the six faculties. For the sake of harming myself and others, I will only receive the five grades."(The six pure senses are the ten faiths, as the Dharma Merit chapter in the Lotus Sutra said. The five products are the contemplation of conduct, overcoming the five pillars of afflictions but not yet getting rid of delusions). At the time of his death, Great Master Nguoi Ich wrote a verse: “The name and title here is the Buddha eye. Then you know who to trust?(The status of the person who enlightens to the nature of the organ, the place of enlightenment, is the same as the Buddha, but it still cannot overcome views and delusions, let alone eliminate them? People with great enlightenment in the Dharma Ending Age mostly belong to this category. Considering that Mr. Ngu To Gioi later became Su Dongpo, Mr. Thao Duong Thanh became Tang Lo Cong, that's still quite good. Next, Mr. Hai An reincarnated as Mr. Chau Phong Ngu's daughter, and worst of all, the high monk at Nhan Dang mountain in his next life became Tan Coi. Because these people have fully understood the nature of nature but have not yet been able to get rid of troubles, so when they are born, most of them forget their sense of self. Such as Great Master Nguich Ich appears in the title. Thien Thai Tri Gia was in the position of contemplation, and Nam Nhac Hue Tu was in a similar position, seeing the true nature of the Dharma was not easy to realize. In fact, the origin of the three Great Masters is incalculable, but because they are afraid that future generations will not yet confirm that they have attained it, they used their bodies to preach the Dharma, causing the later generations to consider themselves ashamed and abandon their self-centeredness and arrogance. The kindness and virtue shown in this teaching is difficult to repay even if one's body is broken. So lay people should evaluate themselves to see if they can surpass those three Great Masters? It is better to recite the Buddha chanting sutras, build up good roots, and one day be born in the West, depending on where you practice your merits gradually, sooner or later you will attain enlightenment. That is the only way to prove the true nature of people in this life!

Kim Luan Mantra Dharma does not allow questions, only good roots or methods. But the sentient beings of the Dharma Ending Age, regardless of whether they have good roots or not, have decided to specialize in Pure Land cultivation, so don't ask about the Dharma method. If you have good roots, you should try harder to cultivate them, otherwise you will have to work even harder to cultivate them, no need to ask. You should only recite mantras to help cultivate Pure karma, don't rush to practice the Dharma to tire the Holy Buddha. If you often practice the Dharma but your mind is not respectful and sincere, evil deeds will arise. There is only one thing that should be done, but it is not the job of lay people. For example, if someone has the intention to leave the home life, we have not yet attained enlightenment and cannot contemplate that person's base, so we ask for Buddha's compassion to silently advise whether we should accept him or not? Do this to avoid bad things: Scoundrels mix in and disrupt Buddha's teachings. People in today's world are trying to gather disciples and just want to get more. Sometimes when we know clearly that we are low-class people, we rush to accommodate them for fear of losing them, not thinking about our choices. This greed for fame and profit, love of relatives, causes Buddha Dharma to decline to the point where it is difficult to revive!

If you have heavy karma, a lot of greed and anger, a weak body, and a fearful mind, you must single-mindedly recite the Buddha's name. Over time, these symptoms will disappear on their own. In the Pho Mon chapter it says: "Those beings who are lustful, angry, and foolish, if they often reverently recite Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, will be separated from those karmas."Reciting the Buddha's name is the same, but you have to use all your mind, don't have distracting thoughts or doubts, then you can pray for anything. Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva has great karma with the sentient beings of the Saha world. In addition to reciting Buddha's name, he also recites his name. Or, reciting the mantras Shurangama or Great Compassion is also fine.

When it comes to reading the sutras, if you want to become a Dharma Master for their praise, you should first read the main text and then read the notes. If you consider that your spirit is not complete and your understanding is not better than other people's, then focus on reciting Buddha's name, and don't waste your energy and time on unnecessary things. If you want to review the sutras according to your destiny to get more benefits, you must keep the three karma pure, be earnest and sincere, bow to the Buddha and then sit and concentrate for a moment, then read the sutras and recite them out loud or quietly. At that time, you must sit upright as if facing the Buddha listening to the spoken word, do not dare to give rise to a lazy thought, do not discriminate, do not study the meaning, just read straight from beginning to end. Reading the sutras like that, if one has good faculties, one can realize the principle of dual emptiness and realize the true form of the Dharma. Even if one's faculties are dark and slow, blessings and wisdom will be increased and karma obstacles will be eliminated. Duc Luc To said: "Just looking at the Diamond Sutra can enlighten your mind and see your nature", that is to say the above view, that's why it's called just. If we review the sutras like that, we can see that all the Mahayana Sutras can enlighten the mind and see nature, not just the Diamond Sutra? Don't just follow the distinction and find out: What does this sentence mean, what does this paragraph mean? Because that belongs to delusional thinking, it is impossible to secretly unite with Buddha's mind, fully understand the sutras, and be the cause for the destruction of sins to give birth to blessings. Looking at the sutras with a discriminating mind, if you know how to be respectful, you can still sow some good roots. By being lazy and contemptuous, you cannot help but bring good causes to evil results, the suffering will be endless! Ancient people paid great attention to listening to sutras because it was difficult for the mind to make distinctions. Like someone chanting the sutras out loud, a person nearby listens clearly to each sentence, not daring to follow the outside scene, because if they get distracted for a moment, they will be interrupted and the meaning will not be clear. Other than that, people who chant because they have the sutra text to rely on, even if they are not paying attention, they can still read it clearly. The listener only relies on the sound. If the mind is distracted, the connection is lost. Hearing the sutra like that, the merit is the same as the person reciting it with sincere reverence. If the person chanting the sutras is less sincere, the merit cannot compare with the listener.

Nowadays, many people view the Buddha Sutras as old paper, with miscellaneous items mixed and haphazardly placed on the sutra table. When praying, do not wash your hands or rinse your mouth, sometimes shake your body, cross your legs, or even let go of your lower breath, without fear at all. So we don't want to destroy sins and give birth to blessings, but we want demons to destroy Buddha's teachings, proving that praising ourselves is"A person who is all-embracing and tolerant, very compatible with the Mahayana teachings and has no attachments."The Buddhists who truly practice seeing this can only be silent, sad, and secretly shed tears lamenting the prevailing demonic situation, not knowing how to save it! In the past, the Wise Man chanting sutras suddenly became enlightened and quietly entered concentration. If he had a discriminating mind, wouldn't it be like that? An ancient monk described the Lotus Sutra, attentively forgetting all the conditions, and still sat writing until dark. The attendant came in and spoke"It's very dark, how can you still describe the sutra?"He was startled and looked again. It was dark and he couldn't see his hand. When reviewing sutras, meditating, reciting mantras, reciting the Buddha's name, if you are focused like that and work hard for a long time, one day you will gain clear understanding and enlightenment. During the Ming Dynasty, the meditation master Tuyet Kieu Tin, who lived in the city of Ningbo, left the home life in middle age, did not know a word. But thanks to asceticism, diligent research, abstaining from difficult things, doing difficult things, he soon suddenly achieved great enlightenment, the words he spoke were in accordance with meditation. From then on, he gradually learned to read and write, and in no time he suddenly became a wise man of penmanship. Such benefits come from a single-minded mind, without discrimination. Those reviewing the sutras should take this as an example. Meditation Master Tuyet Kieu Tin's Collection of Words was added to the Qing Dynasty's Tripitaka. Monk Dam Tao Am, a master who took refuge with a meditation master, had an inscription with more than a thousand words praising his virtue. So when reviewing the sutras, you should not make distinctions; In this way, false thoughts will naturally subside, and true nature will gradually appear.

If you want to study the sutras to understand the meaning, or make notes, you should set aside a separate time to focus solely on that. Although studying is not as serious as when viewing, it should not be completely disrespectful, just a little more poetic. If karma has not yet been enlightened, the review of the sutras must be the main focus, the research part should only be secondary. Otherwise, we will continue to pursue research year after year, even if we can learn like a cloud parrot displaying the bright moon, opening a door to see green mountains, it will only add to the source of argument on the tip of our lips and tongue, and will it have any effect on birth and death? Then, on the thirtieth day of December, I decided not to use a single bit of it! If you can review the sutras in the same way as above, then the karma of greed, anger, attachment and attachment will gradually disappear, and wisdom will become clear. Otherwise, the truth will not be beneficial, and there is a fear that due to the force of karma from previous lives, it will lead to wrong views. Without cause and effect, the afflictions of lust, killing, stealing, and lying will arise one after another like a burning fire. At that time, sometimes they even considered themselves Mahayana practitioners, so they all didn't hesitate to ask"What does a peaceful mind need observing the precepts"of the Sixth Patriarch, defending himself:“Breaking the precepts without breaking is truly observing the precepts.”On the path of practice there are many dangers, true dharma is very difficult to achieve like that! For that reason, most of the Patriarchs advocate practicing Pure Land, so that thanks to the Buddha's magnetic power, karma can be eliminated, making it undetectable. Therefore, lay people should take reciting the Buddha as their main focus and reviewing sutras as their support. In sutras such as: Flower Adornment, Dharma Flower, Shurangama, Vajra, Nirvana, Perfect Enlightenment, or concentrate on one series or watch them alternately. The method of reviewing the sutras should not be different from what I said. If you are indifferent and do not abstain from fear, you will be bound to lose great benefits by discriminating opinions, and your karma will be infinite!

Previously, I thought that lay people and monks thoroughly believed in the Pure Land method. When I read the layman's essay asking Tu Quan, I saw that he wanted to recite mantras and study precepts. Again said: "Regarding the merit of the secret mantra, in the Pure Land sect there is no such superiority, so I am anxious and don't know if I should follow along or not?"Try to consider what level of foundation you have, why do you want to master all the Dharma methods like that? I'm just afraid that over a long period of time, that chaos and uncertainty can make lay people confused and confused. As for Master Than, he said: “According to Tantra, wherever the power of the mantra goes, even if it is a little bit of dust, the sentient beings there will be liberated. Tinh Tong does not have such benefits!”You must know, although reciting mantras have immeasurable merit, reciting the Buddha does not have inconceivable power? Why don't you watch the paragraph: Sentient beings who commit the Five Evils and Ten Evils, when they are about to die, the appearance of Hell appears, can they recite Buddha's name for a few hours and then be reborn? Also, don't you see that on the Avatamsaka Assembly, the Bodhisattva Bodhisattva Bodhisattva attained the same level as the Buddha, and also gave ten great vows dedicating Western merit to seek that enlightenment? And, if the Pure Land practice is not superior, why do all the Buddhas, Patriarchs, and thousands of sutras and treatises all carefully and thoroughly advise and practice? In fact, all Mahayana dharmas are perfect and wonderful, just because sentient beings have deep and shallow conditions, and have birth and maturity bases, so the benefits are both difficult and easy! Mr. Thien Dao is the incarnation of Amitabha. While teaching about dedicated practice, he was afraid that the practitioner's mind would not be concentrated, so he advised: "Even if the Saints in the four realms, or the Bodhisattva ranks in the positions, conducts, directions, grounds, and patience in the ten directions, all the Buddhas filling the entire emptiness of the dharma realm would appear and radiate light, telling them to abandon the practice of Pure Land, they would teach the supreme method, they still would not dare to obey, because they had already decided to specialize in Pure Land, so they could not withdraw their vows."The Venerable Thien Dao knows in advance what future people will know"Standing on this mountain and looking at that mountain"Then I had no prejudice, so I said that. Those golden words above, those who honored Him as Teacher, still rarely know how to obey, let alone those who have not heard and understood? Such a very reasonable and opportune method was in front of us but we had to ignore it and instead follow the path of dreamy karma consciousness, without meditation, without purity. Isn't that the evil karma of the previous life forcing us? What a pity!

The principle of two emptiness is the emptiness of self and emptiness of dharma. Emptiness is knowing clearly that in the five skandhas, either form or mind (form is the form of the body, form is warm, mind is feelings, thoughts, actions, consciousness) are all born from the harmony of causes and conditions. When causes and conditions are separated, they are lost, there is no real self as the master. The Dharma of emptiness is to penetrate the five skandhas as inherently empty. Tam Kinh says: "Seeing that the five aggregates are empty"this is the meaning. The emptiness of the dharma is the true form. Because of breaking through ignorance, it can be said: “Overcome all suffering.”Again, the dharmakaya is completely separate from appearances: Birth, destruction, cessation, permanence, existence, non-existence, which are the basis of appearances, are very real, so they are called true appearances. It is true that this form is the same for sentient beings as the Buddha, but ordinary people and the Second Vehicle are not able to enjoy it due to ignorance and abandonment. For example, if you have a pearl in your lap, because you don't know it, you have to suffer poverty. Enlightenment is a state of clarity and clarity, like clouds dissolving and the moon appearing, doors opening and mountains revealing, like a person with bright eyes seeing the way home, and like a person who has been poor for a long time suddenly finds a treasure. Attesting to enlightenment is like following the old path, returning home, brushing off your feet and sitting down to rest, and like spending that treasure at will. Enlightenment is for an ordinary person with a great mind, his understanding is the same as Buddha's, and when he attains enlightenment, the first level person does not know where to step back and forth from the second level. Understanding this meaning of enlightenment and realization, naturally does not give rise to arrogance of superiors, nor does it give rise to a retreating mind, but the will to be born in the Pure Land cannot be pulled away even by thousands of buffaloes.

What era is this? The war and fire is at its peak, the North and South are fighting each other, there is chaos inside and out, and in the last three or four years, the number of deaths has reached millions. Never heard of such tragedy before! More complications: Storms, floods, earthquakes, epidemics, continue regularly. As for floods, it occurs in less than a year, sometimes a couple of times. Prices are therefore much more expensive than before. At this time, fortunately to be alive, dare you not try your best to cultivate Pure Karma to pray for rebirth? Are you willing to give up your human body, which is difficult to obtain, dreaming about practicing methods that are not at the right time? If you don't try your best to concentrate on one subject now, if you want to hear this straightforward and profound Dharma one day, I'm afraid I won't have the rare opportunity like today!
