10/ Poem sent to Lady Tu blessings Hien

I have been staying in Putuo for more than twenty years, and have never interacted with lay Buddhists. Recently, when Master Blessings Nghiem came to the mountain to visit, in less than a week, the Master repeatedly came to the place where I lived to talk about the nun's virginity. Every time he mentioned it, he seemed sad and touched. At that time I expressed my opinion: Although the female scholar is commendable for her virginity, she regrets not knowing the way to practice. If I have free time, I will send advice and brief explanations of the principles of Buddha's recitation, so that people can step on the Pure Land path according to their ability. When Nghiem Su heard this, he immediately agreed and made all his requests. That's why I have a letter sent to you today.

Buddha Dharma is a Dharma available in the minds of all sentient beings. Anyone leaving the home life can receive and maintain it. But if a female body has many obstacles, if she leaves her hometown and goes far away, she can easily be bullied by others. So the female monk should only stay at home observing the precepts reciting the Buddha's name, determined to pray for Ultimate Bliss, without having to leave the home life to become a nun. Studying all the scriptures and going to different places to consult with wise masters is the part of men, and it is inconvenient for women to imitate them. Women should only try to cultivate Pure Karma, specialize in reciting the Buddha's name, if they can capture all six senses, continuously practice pure mindfulness, and naturally attain Samadhi in this life. When they are about to die, why worry about not taking up high rank? Even if you have not yet attained Samadhi, you can still participate in the ocean assembly, be close to Amitabha, and then gradually return to your true nature, naturally understanding the boundless ocean of teachings, like a large mirror illuminating all forms. At that time, he freely rode the great vows boat, never left the Restoration, appeared in the Saha world, and with countless means saved sentient beings, causing them to all reach the Federation to attain the Endlessness of Birth. Only then can we overcome the fierce determination to practice today and be worthy of being called a lotus flower born in fire, a woman and a man!

To practice Pure Karma, the basic thing is to be determined to seek rebirth in the West. Therefore, the Pure Land method takes Faith, Prayer, and Virtue as its guiding principles. To believe is to believe that the Saha world has immeasurable suffering, and that the Ultimate Bliss world has endless happiness! There are eight types of suffering in Samadhi: birth, old age, sickness, death, love and separation, resentment and meeting, unsatisfied wishes, and the five glorious warm years. (The five illustrious skandhas are sentient beings who, in relation to form, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness, generate or cause karma like a burning fire). The joy in Ultimate Bliss, when it comes to the body, is born in a lotus flower, never grows old, sick, or dies, and is purely male; You still don't even hear the word evil path, let alone is it real? If we talk about the landscape, then pure gold is used as land, seven treasures are used as ponds, rows of trees reach high into the sky, pavilion in the middle of the sky, and the clothes and clothes that are used, when thought of, are all manifested as satisfactory, not like in this world created by human effort. In the Pure Land, Amitabha Buddha's appearance is boundless. Once he sees the compassion, he immediately realizes the Dharma of Forbearance. Avalokitesvara Buddha and the Pure Sea of ​​Purity release pure light and speak the Dharma at the same time. Therefore, even though ordinary people are full of karma, if they make sincere faith and vows, they will be accepted by the Buddha. Once reborn to the other world, all evil karma and afflictions will disappear, and all wisdom and merit will be complete. Believing like that is called true faith. If you want to know more clearly, you should look carefully at the sutra: Amitabha, Amitayus and Avalokiteshvara. These sutras specialize in the principles of dependent origination of the Pure Land sect, also known as the Pure Land Three Sutras. In addition, most of the Mahayana Sutras talk about Pure Land. Like the Avatamsaka Sutra, when the Tathagata first attained Enlightenment, because the Dharmakaya Mahasmas in the forty-one positions, worthy of their nature, spoke immediately of the mysterious One Vehicle. Finally, when Venerable Thien Tai went to inquire about all sources of knowledge and evidence of all Buddhas, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva spoke the ten great vows, advising Venerable Thien Tai and the many people in the Huagarbha realm to dedicating merit to seek rebirth in the world of Ultimate Bliss, to quickly attain Buddhahood. In the Contemplation Sutra, the chapter Ha Pham Ha Sanh says: "A person who has committed the Five Evils and Ten Evils, done all kinds of bad deeds, and when he is about to die, the appearance of Hell appears, and is advised by a wise man to recite the Buddha's name. He obeys and recites for less than ten sentences, then he sees the Buddha reaching out his hand to lead rebirth."The Great Collection Sutra teaches: "In the Dharma Ending Age, there are millions of people practicing, but few people are enlightened. Only by relying on Buddha's Recitation can one escape samsara."Then we know that the Buddha recitation method is the path of fellow practitioners of the higher saints and lower mortals. With this method, both foolish and wise people can follow it. The method of practice is easy but highly successful. It uses little effort but has quick results. Because the Pure Land discipline specializes in Buddha's power, the benefits are very great, surpassing all conventional teachings. The ancients said: "Practicing other disciplines is like an ant crawling up a high mountain, reciting the Buddha's name for rebirth is like a sailboat sailing on the wind and water."This statement can be called a very accurate and clear comparison.

If you want to study, you should read the Essential Commentary on the Amitabha Sutra by Great Master Nguoi Ich. This series describes the truth to the extreme, is a very good and very accurate commentary, standing at the top since the Buddha spoke that sutra until now, even if the Ancient Buddha reappeared in the world and re-interpreted it, it would not be better. Therefore, female scholars should not despise it, they must completely believe it. Regarding the Infinite Life Sutra, there is an annotation by Dharma Master Huiyuan of the Sui Dynasty, the meaning is very clear. In the Infinite Life Sutra, there is a set of Four Commentaries by Venerable Thien Dao. Mr. Thien Dao wanted to benefit all three senses, so he mainly promoted appearance. After the chapter on Thuong Sanh Thuong Sanh, he clearly pointed out the superiority and inferiority of the two paths of specialized and mixed practice, and told us to have steadfast faith. Even if Shakyamuni Buddha or the Buddhas incarnate taught us to abandon the Pure Land practice and practice other dharmas, we would not change our aspirations. The above words can be called the guideline of those who practice Pure karma. As for the set of Contemplation Sutras So Dieu Tong Sao of the Thien Thai sect, the meaning is too complete and mysterious. People with middle and lower capacities will benefit, but still not as good as the set of Four Cards and Commentaries that benefit all three senses. Once you know the meanings above, you need to follow them with confidence. If you understand it yourself, you can believe it. Even if you don't understand it, you can still believe it. You must know that the Pure Land dharma was spoken by the Buddha's golden mouth, and do not give rise to doubts with the incomprehensible speculations of ordinary emotions. Believing like that is called true faith.

Having firmly believed, you need to make vows to leave the Saha world like a prisoner hoping to get out of prison, vow to be born in Ultimate Bliss like a traveler missing his hometown. If you have not been born in the Pure Land, even if someone offers you the throne of the Heavenly King, it will still be considered a fateful fate, without a single thought of liking. Until: In the next life, I changed my body from female to male. When I left the home life when I was young, I heard a thousand understandings and received great blessings. I should also consider it as a circular path of practice. I did not give birth to any wishes. I only wanted to be guided by the Buddha to the West when I died. When you are reborn, you will definitely escape the cycle of birth and death, transcend the mortal realm, enter the Holy realm, be in the realm of Non-return, and attain the fruit of No Birth. Only then can we look back and realize that the throne in the Heavens and Human realms, until the rebirth of leaving the home life increases, is the hardship of many lifetimes, not knowing how long it will take to achieve liberation. Then compare and see that these things, for your lotus quality today, are no different from fire and the bright sun and ants crawling up Thai Son mountain! Therefore, people who practice Pure Land Decision should not pray for blessings in the realms of God or Man, and in the next life return to leaving the home life to increase. If there is even the slightest bit of those thoughts, it means they are not deeply believed in, and are not separated from Amitabha's oath, and are not inspired and guided by the Buddha. How pitiful! What a pity! Would you be willing to perform an inconceivable virtue and seek the fruit of unsatisfactory happiness so that when you enjoy all the blessings, you will fall, follow the flow or karma, and suffer endless suffering? If you put poison in the dew, that delicious substance will kill people; Practicing Pure Land without using your mind wisely will cause the same harm! Therefore, we must completely eliminate such erroneous thoughts in order to fully enjoy the benefits of the Pure Land practice.

If you have deep faith and earnest vows, you need to adhere to the six words of the holy name“Namo Amitabha Buddha.”Regardless of when walking, standing, sitting, lying down, speaking, keeping quiet, moving, staying still, wearing clothes, eating, until defecating and urinating, keep those six words firmly in your mind (or recite four words as well). We must try to make every thought present, the whole Buddha is the mind, the Buddha's mind is one, the thought reaches the extreme, forgetting all worldly feelings. At that time, if the mind is empty, the Buddha will appear, and in this life one can physically attain Buddha Recitation Samadhi, until one's death and be reborn in the High Rank. Practicing like that can be called using up all your abilities. Even in daily work, even the slightest good deeds and merit chanting sutras paying homage to the Buddha all bring dedicating merit rebirth. Thus, all practices are supporting actions of Pure Land, like gathering sand and dust into soil, gathering rivers into sea, the depth and breadth will be infinite. It is also necessary to develop Bodhi, vow to save sentient beings, and practice dedicating the merits of the four graces of the three realms and sentient beings in the dharma realm. That is to widely connect the dharma with all sentient beings, like fire adding oil, rice to rain, making your Mahayana virtues quickly achieve. If you don't know this meaning, then you will have an ordinary person's view of self-interest. The Second Vehicle, although cultivating good conduct, will have very low results. Although in chanting the Buddha's name, one should not hesitate at all times and places, but one must always maintain awe, one must respect the Buddha statue like a living Buddha, read the Buddha's Sutras and the words of the Patriarchs like the Buddha, and the Patriarchs preached the Dharma before him, not daring to have the slightest contempt or doubt. When you normally recite Buddha's name either silently or out loud as you like, but when lying down, sleeping, urinating, bathing, washing your feet, and passing by unclean places, you must recite silently. If you make a sound, it means you are not respectful. You should know that reciting merit silently is the same as reciting merit out loud. I often say: If you want to gain real benefits in Buddha Dharma, you must look for reverence. If you have a part of reverence, you will eliminate part of your karma and add a part of blessings and wisdom; There are ten parts of respect, ten parts of sin karma, and ten parts of blessings and wisdom. If you are not respectful, even though you will sow evil, the evil consequences of the sin of disrespect are truly unimaginable! People in today's world are guilty of this disease while reading the Buddha Sutra, so with predestined people, I often repeat it over and over again.

Reciting the Buddha's name requires capturing the thoughts that arise from the mind, the sound that comes out of the mouth, each sentence and each word clearly and clearly. You have to listen carefully and imprint Buddha's words into your mind. If you take advantage of the ear sense, then the other senses will no longer let you run outside, only then can you quickly achieve one-pointedness and undisturbedness. Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva said: "If you take advantage of all six senses, meditate continuously, you will attain the Three Demons, this is the best."this is the idea. Lord Manjushri said: “Listen in, listen to your own nature. The nature of attaining the Supreme Way", also has the same meaning as above. You should not allow reciting the name to be superficial, then practice the following: Contemplation, Contemplation, Reality. Of the four Buddhist chants, only reciting the name is very suitable. If you keep your mind undisturbed, the true nature and truth will be fully revealed, and the strange scene of the West will appear clearly. Therefore, in reciting the name, one can realize the true form, without needing to contemplate to see the West; A dharma reciting the name is the magic door to the path, the direct shortcut to Bodhi fruition. Most people in today's world do not understand the teachings of Contemplation. If they practice according to Contemplation and True Form, they may be influenced by demons. So it's better to choose a practice that's easy to practice, and you'll also feel the miraculous results. Don't study well and become clumsy. If you pray for rebirth, you'll end up falling, which would be a pity!

The Ten Essentials of the Pure Land book was written by Great Master Nguich Ich, who used Vajra eyes to select reasonable passages from the Pure Land scriptures and is worthy of being ranked first. Pure Land Sage Records records the vows in causes and merits in results of Amitabha Buddha and the Bodhisattvas: Avalokiteshvara, Shizhi, Manjushri, Samantabhadra, Ma Ming, Nagarjuna. Next, it records the self-cultivation and teaching of the Patriarchs and wise men, such as Hue Vien and Tri Jia, along with the rebirth stories of the four groups and the kings, officers, officers, concubines, women, criminals, and animals. There are essential statements included, giving the viewer a place to rely and no longer have any doubts. Reading this book, you can take the ancients as your Teacher and try to practice Pure Karma, which is even closer than consulting with wise people. The Long Tho Pure Land Literature series classifies religious subjects, is full of clear advice, makes people stop doubting and have faith, and is a very good book to guide beginners. The above three things and the Infinite Life Sutra, the Contemplation of the Four Commentary Sutras, add up to five, I previously told Master Blessings Nghiem to please send it to me, I wonder if you can have it? If not, please reply, I will send it to you from the post office. With these books, you can know all the Pure Land sects, even if you don't read all the sutras, it won't hurt you! If you do not understand the Pure Land method, even if you have a deep understanding of the three Sutras and fully understand your own mind, if you want to escape the cycle of birth and death, you will still have to go through countless eons to fulfill your original vow. Reciting the Buddha's name is like A Da Da medicine that cures all diseases. If you don't know about such a wonderful method, isn't it very painful? Knowing without cultivating, and cultivating without dedicated effort, is even more regrettable!

There are many obstacles for a woman leaving the house, not to mention the difficulty of using her, which is even more inconvenient. If you are a male leaving the home life to become a monk, you must enter the meditation hall to learn the rules and regulations of the temple, then travel abroad without any problems. Otherwise, all ten directions will be involved and there will be no place to stay. Ordination for women, like those who have enough wealth and can control themselves, should also go to the temple to ask for ordination. Otherwise, if they have enough money, why should it be fixed like that? All you need is a sincere heart, before the Buddha's repentance table for seven days, and swear to receive ordination. After repentance on the seventh day, he knelt before the Buddha and chanted: “Disciples are blessings. Hien vows to take the five precepts and fulfill Upadādi. (Upa Di translates as Close Servant, fullness means keeping all five precepts). I vow not to kill, not to steal, not to commit adultery, (if married, say no to adultery), not to lie, not to drink alcohol.Saying this three times means attaining the precepts. The essential thing is to wholeheartedly accept and uphold it, then the merit is no better or worse than praying to the Sangha for ordination. Do not doubt that taking precepts like that is not in accordance with the Dharma. You must know that the above method is based on the Holy teachings of the Tathagata in the Brahma Net Sutra. In Putuo, there is no ordination in the fall, only from the first week of January to the nineteenth of February. But I really hope that you will stay in the Pure Karma monastery and not come here from all the snow and fog. If you are still attached to not changing your mind, then you don't know what's good or bad, you've harmed your own purity, and you've betrayed this old monk's sincerity. I want the Female Scholar in this life to achieve the path of karma. I definitely have no intention of hindering dharma conditions. Please think carefully and you will understand. As for not being able to leave the home life, the desire to commit suicide, although the desire is strong, that thought is really crazy. In the midst of this Dharma Ending era, there are very few true practitioners. How many people are highly virtuous and qualified to be teachers and guides for people? The nun only knew that leaving the home life as a nun was liberation, but she did not understand many of the obstacles of nuns. And, don't think that committing suicide is a way to free yourself from life? Once dead, the consciousness will be guided by karma to be reincarnated, but I'm afraid that due to that resentful mind, it will fall into the animal world, wanting to return to a woman's body is also a difficult task to achieve. Even if one were to take on the body of a woman, or a man, or the body of a king in the human or heavenly realms, is there any guarantee that one would still encounter the Buddha Dharma to practice? And how is it certain that in the Buddha Dharma, we are pleased to meet the Pure Land method, which is a present-day Dharma that transcends the cycle of birth and death? And, when reciting the Buddha, you must do so that outside the mind there is no Buddha, outside the Buddha there is no mind, the mind and mouth are as one, keep reciting like that, absolutely have no wish to pray for rebirth. If you follow this method and recite, you will be born in the High Rank. This is based on the words of Zen master Triet Ngo.

2. If Prayer and Behavior are together, then while reciting and praying, the voice and mind must be as earnest as a child falling into the water to ask for help from his mother. These are the words of meditation master Ngoc Phong. Again, Great Master Kien Mat also said: "The six words of the holy name, in each thought is enough for the mind to love and be bored", along with Mr. Ngoc Phong's theory is still the same.

Comparing the above two aspects, the first theory seems to lack urgency while reciting Buddha, Great Master Ngai Ich said: "Praying for birth in Pure Land depends entirely on faith and prayer. According to the second theory, while reciting the Buddha's name, you still keep the word of prayer in your mind, fearing that even if your heart is not chaotic, it will be difficult to be pure. Everyone has greed, anger, and delusion, but if you know that it is a disease, its power is not so great. If the homeowner knows it is a thief and chases it away immediately, then the house will be peaceful and the property will be preserved. On the contrary, if we peacefully consider it as a family member, then is it any different from accepting the enemy as our child? How can our money not be lost?

Reciting the Buddha's name cannot be urgent, because one does not know that the Saha world is miserable and the Ultimate Bliss domain is peaceful. When you develop this mind, like an electrically powered machine, it has very strong and quick energy, eliminates karma and adds blessings and blessings, and normal merit and good roots cannot be compared.

If you are very mindful, all afflictions will naturally be reduced. Therefore, even though a true cultivator is in a world of hardship, he is constantly diligent in training, causing his karma to gradually be destroyed. noi_dung:
15/ Poems Responding to Hidden Lyrics

Recently, Hai Thi Dao Nhon in Gia Hung sent me your envelope. After reading it, I know that you have long practiced cultivating the Immortals, and that your knowledge is very profound. Now I want to ask about the Pure Land method, which is the ultimate dharma in Buddhism. It can be said that a person from a previous life has deeply planted good roots in Buddha's teachings, so he does not accept the advice of God Ha Ba, but knows how to think and search in the sea of ​​teachings for complete liberation. But you are familiar with Hai Thi Dao Nhon, why don't you ask him, instead of leaving a high place to find a low place, lest you betray your expectations? Hai Thi was originally a sectarian, including practicing Pure meditation, which was the great boat of vows in that sea of birth and death. Because he was so humble, he named himself after the word corpse. In fact, if in the sea of life and death he encountered that corpse, he would quickly reach enlightenment and safely return to his homeland. Wouldn't that be better than asking An Quang, who uses the Sangha and has little understanding of the dharma? But you thought you were asking the wrong question, so I would like to respond based on my own perspective, or maybe I can clear up some of your doubts?

I think that in Buddhism and Immortality, they still have the same origin, but in terms of sects, they are actually far apart. Buddhism teaches people to first practice the practice of contemplation on the Four Foundations of Mindfulness, contemplating that the body is unclean, feelings are suffering, the mind is impermanence and dharma is not self. When you know that the body, feelings, mind, and dharmas are impure, suffering, impermanence, and non-self, all are false like dreams and illusions, then the true nature will manifest itself. The Taoist teachings at the time of the original teachings did not focus specifically on cultivating one lucky energy to seek eternal life, but later practitioners mistakenly considered that to be the true teachings. Buddhism covers all dharmas, not only clearly promoting the issues of body, mind, and life, but also the small things of worldly truth such as filial piety, kindness, loyalty, trust, propriety, righteousness, integrity, and shame, are also not overlooked. Regarding the practice of single qi, the Buddha Dharma does not mention a single word, and there is another prohibition. Because the Fairy side makes people preserve their body and mind to make it real, the Buddha side clearly points out that the body and mind are inherently false, subject to birth and death, and are not the true mind. The simple practice is not not not useful, but it can only make people live long and endure until the Immortal state to be born in heaven. If we talk about liberating samsara, it is still a dream. You know that the Immortals have a number of lives and the Buddha's lifespan is unlimited, so in this old age, you must concentrate on practicing the Pure Land dharma. Studying meditation and teachings should be simplified, because these dharmas are vast and profound and not easy to study. Even if you reach the extreme, you must return to Buddha's Mindfulness to be able to solve life and death in this life. As for all the sutras about Pure Land, you must urgently look for them, practice accordingly, and firmly believe in the words of the Buddha and the Patriarchs. You should not rush into doubt because of what you do not understand. If you can have both faith and vows, you will naturally be guided to the West by Buddha's power. Once reborn, you will be close to Amitabha, you and the assembly, gradually attain the fruit of No Birth, and ascend to the throne of Bo Xu. At that time, looking back at becoming an Immortal and being a dependent of the Heavenly Emperor, compared to the current position, the difference is as far away as the abyss of the sky!

The book Mong Dong Ngu Luc and the theories of Banh Thieu Thang that you mentioned are probably plagiarized and edited by the practitioner, not true in the original poem. Because there are people in the monastic practice who think that sitting on luck is meditation, that's why we say it"Reciting the Buddha's name is similar to meditation, only slightly different from the Dharma."Sentence“only slightly different from the Dharma”, was added by the Taoist side. Except for this sentence, although the meaning of the whole text is not too wrong, it is still vague. There is absolutely no such text in Mong Dong Ngu Luc. That's because the practitioner stole the text and wrote it down. In fact, they themselves don't understand it anymore. But now there is no need to explain it clearly, please read the book Mong Dong Ngu Luc and you will know for yourself. To the point where they quote the words of layperson Banh Nhi Lam, they also agree with the above, but the mistakes are even more numerous. Paragraph says: “The four words Amitabha Buddha are easy to recite. As long as each recitation is connected without confusion, the energy can circulate in unison. At that time, the spirit and energy gathered together in one place will become a Sariputra after a long time, and after a while, it will become a Bodhi pearl and become a Buddha.Above is using Buddha chanting as a practice practice. Layperson Nhi Lam decided not to say those words. That's because the right eye has not yet opened, so it turns right into evil. In the Hue Mang Sutra and Immortal Buddha Hiep Tong books written by them, the mistakes are even more numerous. Those evil and puppet people quote other people's words and change the beginning and the end to prove their theory. Their crime of contempt for justice, slandering their predecessors, and bewitching people is truly beyond description! Those people only seek vain fame for a while, not knowing that in the future they will have to endure many hardships, so the Tathagata calls them pitiable people!

Coming to the discussion about magic“reflection”, although not too much of a problem, but the question"two eyes staring at the fingertips"Probably misquoted"eyes fixed on the tip of the nose."Or when that is the method established by Nhi Lam lay people, but clasping hands for a long time can not help but make you tired. How can it be better than contemplating the white light at the tip of the nose to be more free and happy? Because for beginners, mindfulness is the most difficult to focus on. If you often meditate at the tip of your nose, your mind will no longer chase after external scenes. This is the short-sighted contemplation of a beginner. The book Mong Dong Ngu Luc was printed by the layman Tien Y Am with passages dedicated to the Pure Land in the collection Mong Dong Di Tap, and circulated in the south, to help the demands of those who had long wanted that book but had not been able to find it. The complete collection in Beijing is enough, the only thing in the south is the summary version by Tien Y Am. That book Ngu Luc has exquisite words and is a work that stands at the top since Mr. Ngau Ich and Tinh Am later. With this book, if you can go to the end, believe without doubt, you will definitely feel the golden lotus blooming in the treasured pond, and when you die there, you will become a new guest in the Western world. The book Amitabha Essentials is the guideline of Pure Karma practitioners. This sutra is at the beginning of the Pure Land Ten Essentials. The Pure Land Ten Essentials are a part of the very reasonable teachings collected by Mr. Ngai Ich in the Pure Land scriptures, including ten types, so they are called the Ten Essentials. The great master placed the Amitabha Essentials book in front as a sign of respect for the sutra.

Xa Loi, originally in Sanskrit, translated: The body or spirit bone is the crystallization of the power of cultivating precepts, concentration and wisdom, and is not formed by practicing spiritual energy. That is also the manifestation of a practitioner reaching the state of mind with the Buddha. But relics are not just flesh, bones, and hair transformed during immolation, but their appearance can occur in many different cases. As in ancient times, a high monk was bathing and suddenly received relics. When meditation master Tuyet Nham Kham shaved his head, his hair turned into a string of relics. There was a person who single-mindedly recited the Buddha's name, and relics came out of his mouth. A carver engraved Long Tho Pure Land, Xa Loi appears in the tree. There was a female devotee who embroidered Buddha and sutras and received relics under the needle. There were people who had come back from a long trip, feeling pity and offering prayers before the statue, and where the statue suddenly appeared, relics appeared. meditation master Truong Khanh Nhan, when he passed away and was burned, at a time when the sky was windy, the smoke flew thirty or forty miles away. Wherever the smoke reached, there were relics. More than four stones were collected. Then we know that the relics are manifested by the force of the Tao, but the practitioners do not understand clearly, mistakenly thinking that they are formed by refining spiritual energy. Because they see the famous generals in Buddha's teachings, refuse to understand the root cause, and quickly bring the wrong association into their practice. I have only heard of Bodhi attainment to become a Buddha. I have never trained my spirit, before becoming a Sariputra, and then becoming a Bodhi Chau before becoming a Buddha! The nature and life of the monastic practitioners are all the way of cultivating attachments to consciousness and body. They do not understand that reason, so they criticize Buddhism for only cultivating nature and not cultivating life, not knowing that their actions are the destruction of Buddhism. Regarding this matter, please look at the passage on the Four Foundations of Mindfulness in the Buddha Sutra and it will become clear to you.

Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara, a long time ago, became Buddha, whose name is Dharma Insight. Because of his deep compassion, even though he was in the eternal realm, he transformed into three realms: Real Report, Convenience, Co-Residence; Although he often serves Amitabha, he still appears everywhere in the form of Buddha, Bodhisattva, Sravaka, Pratyekabuddha, and even the body of the six paths in the ten precepts. He does all the beneficial things, and whatever body worthy sentient beings can use to be saved, He appears in that body and speaks the Dharma. Non Putuo is the place where Bodhisattva is fulfilled. Because he wanted to give sentient beings a place to express their sincerity, Lord Avalokitesvara passed away on this mountain. Isn't Bodhisattva only in Putuo and not in other places? Like there is only one moon in the sky whose shadow is cast across thousands of rivers and lakes, from the ocean to dew drops, wherever there is clear water, the moon appears. But if the water is cloudy, the moon's shadow will be dim. Our nature is like water. If sentient beings single-mindedly recite Avalokitesvara and Bodhisattva, they will use all kinds of positive, negative, hidden, and obvious ways to bring about benefits. On the contrary, if you are not single-minded, your mind will be cloudy, and of course it is difficult to hope for salvation from Him. This meaning is very profound, please see the paragraph“Putu Son Chi”, in my Van Sao series, it will be clear. When Bodhisattva was still in the cause, by contemplating the nature of hearing, he attained Perfection. When he was on the fruition, by contemplating the voices of living beings calling their names and seeking salvation, he was called Avalokitesvara. Again, Bodhisattva's Dharma is vast and endless, depending on the nature of all living beings, it teaches all dharmas to educate, does not establish any particular sect, so his dharma is called Universal Gate.

The above is short-sighted, because you have not researched it, so it is unclear. I also answered according to the question, in fact it is not Pure Land, a teaching that can bring you complete benefits. But if I say it clearly here, I'm afraid it will be a waste of paper and ink. You should request the Infinite Life Sutra, the Infinite Life Contemplation Sutra, the Pure Land Ten Essentials, the Pure Land Holy Sage Luc, and the Complete Enlightenment Luc to see how the truth of practice is realized, it says everything.

16/ Response Poem to Layman Pham Co Nong

Pure Land Dharma practice takes Faith, Prayer, and Virtue as its main principles; Only when faith and prayer are deep, conduct can be diligent. When disasters are urgent, be diligent and sincere, when normally do not work, be lazy and slow, it is a practice without determination, and it is also a common disease of ordinary people. But living in the current situation, for example, if a person lies still on a large pile of firewood, under the fire that has already burned even though the body has not yet been burned, in a moment the fire and smoke will be obscure, there is no way to escape. If you continue to ignore it day after day, not focusing on asking for help from Buddha's recitation, your understanding will be very shallow!

In Buddha Dharma, cultivating other disciplines must necessarily reach the point where the conduct of initiation is truly beneficial, not just the visualization method of the Pure Land sect. A person who practices meditation takes a meaningless first line as the guardian deity, puts all his mind into it, often studies without regard to the day, waits until he has completely eliminated his views on internal and external scenes, then it is called great complete enlightenment. Isn't that a wonderful practice? Duc Luc To said: “Just looking at the Diamond Sutra can reveal one's true nature.”Isn't that a wonderful practice? The word arising here must be understood to mean extreme. Only with extreme strength can one forget the whole body and mind of the world and be completely silent. If the effort is not extreme, even though you meditate, there is still this and that, it is all the work of ordinary emotions, it is all discrimination and understanding, where can there be real benefit? That's why when ancient people practiced meditation, their brains were like dry trees. Therefore, the teachings spread widely and were still admired by future generations. That benefit all comes from one extreme word alone.

People today like to talk and rarely practice. Cultivating Pure Karma must include reasoning, and matters should be even more specialized. Why? Because one who understands the truth, everything is reasonable, and all day long practice is the practice of wisdom. People who do not understand the principle, when they hear about the principle, feel that the meaning is mysterious, and it fits with their laziness and dislike of trouble, so they immediately accept the principle and give up. Who would have thought that when you give up, your reason will become nothing! I hope you will advise everyone with your practice and reason, your merit will be great!

noi_dung:
17/ Response Poem to Layman Ngo Hi Chan

The Buddhist concept of meditation wishes to have four dharmas: reciting the name, Contemplation, Contemplation and Reality. All in all, only the method of reciting the name photography is very broad, making it easy to practice and not trigger evil deeds. If you want to meditate, you must carefully read the Quan Sutra and clearly understand the reasons: That is, the mind is the Buddha, the pure mind of the Buddha appears, all scenes are idealistic, so do not be attached... It is clear that the scene does not come from the outside and does not give rise to attachments, then the scene is more mysterious and the mind is more pure. If so, wouldn't the benefits of visualization be small and trivial?

On the contrary, if the contemplation of the scene is not pure, the path has not been clearly understood, and if the mind is only in a hurry to see the scene, then the whole thing is false, not being able to sympathize with the Buddha, and also being the cause of evil deeds. Because of the urgent desire to see the scene, the mind becomes more and more restless, causing the unjust family many lifetimes ago to take that opportunity to manifest the realm to make the practitioner confused. At the beginning, my mind was not true, I did not know that it was a ghostly scene, so I was excited and excited, my thoughts were not at peace. Because of that, demons immediately rely on it to make the confused mind lose its nature. At that time, even if Buddha appeared, I would not know how to save him!

Therefore, lay people should consider their own abilities and not be too greedy for lofty things, thus wanting to gain benefits instead of causing harm. Venerable Thien Dao said: "The consciousness of living beings in the End of Dharma era is disordered, if they focus their coarse minds on the scene and the mystery, it will be difficult for them to succeed."Therefore, the Buddha took pity on him and opened a door to recite the name, for fear that someone would not use their mind wisely and get lost in a demonic realm. Practicing the magic of reciting the name is very easy, just hold one thought together and you will be reborn. Again, sincerity and earnestness are also a wonderful method to cure delusions and demons.

Lay people should consider carefully, and try their best to practice!

---o0o---

noi_dung:
18/ Poem Responding to Lay People Save Tri Khong

I just received a poem, knowing that you will be healthy after a long illness, so I am very happy! The greatness of living, the rapid impermanence, although it is scary to hear about, is not as painful as having personally experienced those moments close to that scene. So you should develop great Bodhi, advise your situation to relatives, friends, and predestined people, then the benefits will be wide.

In the poem it says: It's because you're rushing to recite the Buddha's name that you're rushing. That's because you're not using your mind well. Reciting the Buddha's name depends on your ability, either silently or out loud, big or small, it's okay. Why do you keep reciting loudly, causing you to feel sick like that? Although your serious illness is caused by trauma, it is actually due to the power of karma discovered from countless eons until now. Because you recite the Buddha's name diligently, you can turn the consequences into present consequences, change the heavy consequences into light ones. Don't become discouraged or doubtful because of that. That one illness has wiped out countless lifetimes of crimes that should have fallen into the three realms. Only then do we know that the Buddha's strength is difficult to think about, and Buddha's grace is difficult to repay, so we feel joy, shame, and even more faith. From now on, one must diligently practice and advise others with Pure Land, so that all beginners can be reborn in Ultimate Bliss. That is not to thank the Buddha for using his illness to awaken him and remove his sin obstacles.

There is no need to come to Non Pho Da, because it costs a lot to travel back and forth. Reciting Buddha at home is easy and easy, and you don't waste money on your health. Would that be more convenient?

noi_dung:
19/ Poems Responding to Layman Chau Tri Mau (1 - 3)

1.Having received the poem, knowing that you have gained faith and want to take refuge in the Buddha's Dharma. However, taking refuge in the Three Jewels means stopping evil, doing good deeds, trying to keep morality, and having faith in praying to be born in the West. You must also have compassion for living beings, do not kill, and preserve six or ten sons. If you can't be frugal all your life, don't be too greedy about eating and drinking. This is not contrary to Buddha's compassion. Your name is Chau Moc, so now I give the dharma name Tri Mau. Because the mind is like a tree, because the fire of afflictions burns it, the tree withers. If there is wisdom, afflictions do not arise, and the tree of mind nature is naturally lush and green.

If you want to accept the five precepts, you should first examine your mind to see if you can keep them without breaking them. Then ask the layperson Hoa Tam about how to take the precepts before the Buddha and he will show you. Having turned to the Buddha Dharma, we must carefully examine our Texts and follow them in practice so that we will not be bewitched by ordinary people, making us wish for blessings in the next life, or hope to become an Immortal and then practice the magic of cultivating one's destiny. If you can comprehend the meaning in the Van Sao, even hundreds of thousands of pagans will not be able to shake your mind. Don't think that this collection doesn't have enough evidence, you must know that the words in it are all narrated according to the meaning of the Buddha Sutra, or the sayings of the Patriarchs and Wise Men, and are not written by ourselves.

You should consider carefully, the benefits will be many.

2.Your will is very weak and your mind is too high. Even though you say you obey me, you are actually following your own bias. In Pure Land, trust is the root. Believe it or not, anyone who commits the Five Evils and Ten Evils can be reborn; If your faith is not firm, the person who is a scholar of the sect will still have karma and no fate. Since you are not an expert in religion, you can rely on your own strength to eliminate karma to avoid birth and death, and you do not believe in Buddha's power and the inconceivable merits of your own nature, then how can you achieve liberation? You must know, if you have enough faith and deep prayer to return to the West, no one can be reborn. Reciting Buddha is a quick way to escape samsara; With the advancement of this subject, you still don't know, yet you are excited to study the Awakening of Faith! Although the Essay on Arising Faith is the essence of Buddha's teachings, it is difficult to bring benefit to people with poor instincts and beginners. Even if you study the Awakening of Faith and understand it thoroughly without any doubts, when you apply it, you must follow the Buddha's mantra to pray for birth to be stable. If we talk about understanding, there are also the meanings of dharma, meditation, and teachings that are very mysterious, how can you fully understand them all? Your heart is so high, but you don't know how to limit the height of your strength! You think to yourself"If you have a lowly nature, it is difficult for you to wish to be born in the West. Just pray that you will not fall into the third level and you will be happy.", who knows that if you don't get rebirth, you will fall into evil in the future? That concept is not in accordance with Buddha's teachings, and goes against my advice, which is called: "Obey the practice, single-mindedly reciting Buddha", what is it?

Now your karma position is mediocre, your character is not yet noble, your determination like that really makes people lamentable and laughable? You should completely stop hoping to become a great man, then focus on studying the Pure Land scriptures and review the poems I sent to Cao Thieu Lan and Tu Nu in Van Sao, and practice accordingly. Don't promote rebirth because of your inferior nature, leaving it on the outside. You must use Buddha's mantra as the guardian angel, grasp it firmly at all times and don't let it go. Again, thoughts and actions must be kept in accordance with the principles: Stop evil deeds and do good deeds. In addition, if you have extra strength, don't hesitate to recite the sutras and mantras. You should use sincerity as the root, and don't rush to understand the meaning. If you are in a hurry to understand and don't focus on sincere recitation, even if you understand, it won't be very helpful, let alone is it difficult to understand? Even with the dharma subjects, meditation, teachings, and lifelong research, it is difficult to grasp the place of rebirth. Even if it is possible, you still have to completely cut it off or karma can escape samsara. Speaking of this, I'm afraid it's just a dream that won't come true! My Ministry of Literature, you haven't read it carefully, so the words that come out are high enough to reach the blue clouds, low enough to reach the bottom of the deep sea. In it, we always mention the scriptures that should be read, how to read them, and the difficulty of gaining benefits from the dharma subjects, meditation, and teachings. The reason for the difficulty is because the Pure Land method relies on Buddha's magnetic power, other methods only use their own strength. The other subjects are all common teachings, like scholars in life who, because of their talent and virtue, become high or low officials. Pure Land is a special teaching, as the newly born Crown Prince is more noble than the courtiers. Therefore, the two sides cannot be compared, but ordinary people still have many karma obstacles, so shouldn't they be cautious in choosing a method to practice?

You have admitted that your abilities are weak and that your human life is limited, so why do you still follow your own high ambitions? I don't force you to do that. If you can become a great scholar, it will be an honor for Buddhism. I'm afraid that if you don't complete it, you won't be confident in Pure Land, and both will be ruined. Even if you cultivate a little merit in this life, in your next life you will definitely fall into the circle of blessings of the world. Think about it: How many rich people don't create karma? Today, the country's fortunes are in danger and the people are suffering, all due to the blessings and blessings of previous generations who practiced without wisdom. When you are lost in the next life, how can you ensure that you are not deluded and do not fall into evil realms? If you are not born in the West, it is still possible to not fall in one lifetime, but two lifetimes without falling is very rare!

3.Buddha taught many sutras and mantras, no one can recite them all. So the ancients only chose the essential things to do the daily routine. Early on, chant Shurangama, Great Compassion, Ten Mantras, and Heart Sutra, then recite Buddha dedicating Western merits. In the evening, chant the Amitabha sutras, write Dai repentance, Mong Son, then chant Buddha dedicating merit. Nowadays, pagodas are less elaborate, tomorrow they will only recite the Shurangama and Heart Sutra; Some days chanting sutras of Amitabha, Mong Son literature, every other day chanting sutras of Dai repentance, Mong Son. You said there are a lot of daily rituals and chants in the Sutra and Mantras, which are appendixes to the two sessions. Lay people can follow the meditation schedule, or create their own. Like morning and night chanting the Amitabha sutras, chanting rebirth, reciting Buddha; Or early chanting the Great Compassion Mantra, reciting the Buddha's name, chanting the Amitabha Sutras in the evening, rebirth mantra, reciting the Buddha's name, or reciting the Diamond Sutra. But regardless of reciting sutras and mantras, one must recite Buddha's dedicating merits to comply with the principle of practicing Pure karma.

What you expressed, although well-intentioned, actually had no intention, just followed changing circumstances. Which sutra, which mantra, does not praise outstanding merit? According to your concept, chanting this sutra will destroy that sutra, reciting this mantra will necessarily let go of that mantra, give up all thoughts of regret, chanting and reciting with all your strength will not be able to handle it. So can we be called a true practitioner who understands the truth? Broadly speaking, if you meet a meditation monk who praises the practice of meditation, Mr. Pure Land, also imitate them in practicing meditation; to other subjects such as: Thien Thai, Tantric, Phap Tuong, Sage Thu, every time you meet a knowledgeable person who proposes, you will definitely lose your intention to leave here and follow there. I don't know what level of your nature you are, but you want to understand all dharmas like that? I'm just afraid that your karma is deep and shallow, when you can't become a great in-law, you also abandon the Buddha rebirth method of Pure Land, so that when you die, if you don't go to the cauldron of oil and fire, you will end up in the belly of a horse and a donkey! Suppose we are lucky enough to not lose our human body, but because in this life we have merit in cultivating but lack right wisdom, that person will receive blessings of delusion, then create evil karma, when impermanence comes, we will also go straight to the three paths. Even if you want to hear the names of heaven, earth, father, mother, let alone know the Pure Land dharma? How do you understand my Van Sao? You must know, if you recite Amitabha Buddha to the extreme, you will still be able to become a Buddha. Do you think that chanting Amitabha sutras and reciting Buddha's name cannot destroy karma? Buddha Dharma is like money, it depends on the person who uses it wisely; You have money, what can't you do? If you can specialize in one dharma, what wish will not come true? The choice is that you have to insist on reciting this mantra and chanting that sutras to get such merit, but can't you also get other merits? If you follow my words well, you will naturally understand one thing clearly; Otherwise, no matter how much you talk, your mind won't have any intention, what's the use?

Ordinary people are in delusion, their faith is unstable, so there are often things when practicing when creating karma, at first they believe and then they doubt. That's also because in the beginning the teacher didn't know how to do it. If he first taught me the short-sighted cause and effect step by step, there wouldn't be such a contrary delusion! But even though past sins are very serious, if we wholeheartedly repentance and make amends, according to true understanding, determined to practice Pure Karma, benefiting ourselves and others, then the sin hindrances will disappear and our mind will become clear. So the sutra says: "In life there are two heroes, one is the one who has not committed a crime, the other is the one who has committed a crime and knows how to repentance."A word of repentance must be expressed from the bottom of the heart. If you do not truly repent, no matter how much you say, it will be redundant. For example, if a person reads the medicine but refuses to take it, how can he be cured? If you can follow the treatment method and use medicine, the disease will definitely be eliminated and your body and mind will be at peace. Just worry about those who are determined and cannot endure, resulting in the situation of being exposed to the sun for ten days in the cold, and then it's just an empty name, with no real benefit!

noi_dung:
20/ Response Poem for Layman Uong Vo Moc

Vo Moc I have been reciting Buddha for ten years, only then have I learned a little about the interesting meaning. I think that the method of teaching about Buddha's Recitation by Linh Phong, Mong Dong and the Venerable Master's Van Sao is mostly a means to establish the ignorant and rural people. Like us, who understand words and think and explore, if we keep using that method, we probably won't be born in the Pure Land! According to my opinion, those who recite Buddha's name to pray for rebirth must first know: “Who is that Buddha chanting?”Because if you can see your master, then reciting Buddha will have a place to be used and rebirth can take hold! Not only does reciting the Buddha's name need to be like that, but chanting sutras reciting mantras must follow this path. When people today talk about reciting Buddha's name, they say: You have to recite until you are old and your heart is like death before you can be reborn. They don't know, if they don't know clearly“Who is that Buddha chanting?”, then how can we meditate on old age and a dead heart? So, suppose you recite ten thousand verses every day and night, what does it have to do with birth and death? Someone said: "The ancients mostly focused on reciting the name, not researching Buddha's words."Vo Moc I said: "That is the work of the ancients after studying and researching, beginners should not imitate it."People reciting Buddha's name in this day and age, out of nine out of ten, do not understand that intention. How pitiful! I am often at a loss for advice, but some lay people consider me to have wrong views. The meaning of the Buddha Dharma is so dark, I feel so sad and sad!

Now, I would like to express my feelings, respectfully ask the Venerable Master for confirmation and hope to further explain that meaning. That is the happiness of all sentient beings, not just for Vo Moc!”

See clearly the meaning in the poem, how much praise! You have a very good heart, wanting to let everyone see your original nature, so that you can be born in the upper lotus level. Quan Kinh said: "Read and recite the Mahayana, understand the first meaning, develop Bodhi, and advise practitioners", is that your original intention?

However, speaking of the Dharma must be in accordance with the opportunity. If you do not consider the basis and mistakenly give the Dharma medicine, then you are like someone who uses medicine to kill someone. You should know that the source of the two sects of meditation, Pure, is the same, but the way of practice is different, the meditation side takes the original nature as the sect, the Pure side uses faith, vows, reciting the Buddha's name to seek rebirth as the main tenets. Assuming that people in this world are of superior ability, your words would be extremely beneficial. But in retrospect, there are very few people with high capacity, there are too many middle and lower people. If you don't teach how to send messages and pray for birth, but tell them to study and recite Buddha's verses, that is a great harm. Because if you seek enlightenment and gain enlightenment, it is still an honor, but you also have to make a strong vow to pray for rebirth. It's like investigating unsuccessfully, but always holding notions in your mind"If you don't know who that Buddha is, you can't be reborn", it is difficult to sympathize with the Buddha and receive guidance. People who know"reciting Buddha who is that", is the one who has attained enlightenment and seen the true nature. In this life, how many people can seek help to the point of great enlightenment? Don't tell anyone, you've never been to that position. Why know? Because if you had come, you would never have dared to say the words: "Mr. Linh Phong, Mong Dong set up to teach the stupid and rural people who don't know who recites the Buddha's name, it is not called old reciting, the heart is like dead even if every day and night recites ten thousand verses, it has nothing to do with birth and death, and the ancients specialized in reciting the name after studying it, beginners should not imitate it."

In fact, your heart really wants for yourself and others to benefit, but your words, you yourself, are wrong, causing others to go astray. From now on, please don't say those words anymore, otherwise, Tathagata's vast Dharma method of helping all sentient beings will be deeply buried by you, closed, and not be opened. That mistake is the same as the crime of disrespecting the Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha, you should be careful! In your understanding, because you are not skillful in relying on your base and advising everyone to practice the Dharma, it becomes biased and erroneous. You guys don't know, but let me understand the true meaning of the Buddha Dharma, please confirm it. 'Even though Quang is weak, how dare he make the mistake of promising to accept praise and help, so that he and his subordinates will fall into the sin of disrespecting the Three Jewels? As if this monk's words are not correct, please leave it up to each person to go their own way. „n Quang does not dare to force others to abandon their opinions to follow his cowardly will. It's just that you asked me, so I had no choice but to frankly offer up that little piece of nonsense.

Thank you very much for your thoughtful consideration.

tieu_de: 21/ Poem in response to a Layman in Ningbo

noi_dung:
21/ Poem in response to a Layman in Ningbo

Having read the poem, I know that lay people diligently counteract the practice, but it is not effective. That's also because lay people don't care about life and death, they just give"The dharma door transcends mortals to become Holy, eliminates karma, and achieves pure mindfulness"work outside. The reason why it's not really effective is right there! Must often consider: “The human body is difficult to attain, the Buddha Dharma is difficult to hear, and the Pure Land discipline is very difficult to find. Now that I am fortunate enough to be in the body of a husband and have the blessings of meeting the Pure Land, how dare I allow my limited days and hours to let my beauty, sound, reputation, and profit all be destroyed? Are you willing to endure an empty life and die in vain, and then still be immersed in the six paths, not knowing when you can escape from that?"You have to put the word death on your head. When you encounter scenes that you should not be attached to, you immediately know that they are a cauldron of fire to make you suffer. Then you will definitely not be like a caterpillar flying into a lamp to burn yourself. When you encounter something worth doing, you will think that it is a boat of mercy to save suffering. You will no longer be hesitant in doing benevolence or be lazy in your spiritual practice. In this way, the mundane world can also be a predestined person to enter the Dharma. Doesn't it mean that giving up everything in life is cultivating mindfulness? If the mind has intention and does not follow the circumstances, then worldly labor is liberation. That's why the Diamond Sutra always advises against staying in form; Even though we develop the mind to save all sentient beings, we do not see ourselves as the one who saves, and the sentient beings as the ones who are saved. Even though we attain enlightenment, we do not see the sign of a recipient of the fruit of No Residual Nirvana. That is the person who truly practices Bodhisattva. On the contrary, even if one saves sentient beings or cultivates countless merits, it cannot conform to the true form of the One Vehicle, because one does not understand that sentient beings are Buddhas. In the nature of equality, one mistakenly gives rise to discrimination, causing unconditioned benefits to turn into conditioned blessings. So how can we escape the bondage of wealth, fame and fortune?

People have duties in life, but in addition to their duties, don't add anything useless. You should spend that time chanting the Buddha's sutras according to your ability, determined to seek rebirth in the West. For all good deeds, either by giving money, or by using words to support, otherwise by generating joy, there is also merit. And we must bring these dedicating merits to help with rebirth. Like a boat moving downstream and rowing again, wouldn't that mean it would return to the dock faster? December 30th is the last day of the year. If you don't prepare in advance, how can you avoid creditors? The moment of death is the thirtieth day of the twelfth month of one's life. If one does not have enough self-respect, faith, and vows, and still has evil karma, greed, anger, and passion, then unjust creditors from countless lifetimes to the present will come to demand and entice them. Not to mention that those who do not know the Pure Land dharma must give up following karma and receive birth, that is, those who know but do not sincerely practice, are also drawn by karma into the six paths, suffering samsara in their lives and lives. If you want to pray for the weak path to escape suffering, only the thought of fear of death and death leads to falling into the evil path, then chanting the Buddha's name is pure, the lotus level is achieved, and all mundane situations cannot rob you of mindfulness.

Tam Kinh says: "Seeing that the five aggregates are empty, overcoming all suffering."The five aggregates cover the body, mind and external environment. If we see that it is empty, then it is from the five aggregates that we leave the five aggregates. Which place is not the method of great liberation, the realm of great Nirvana?

---o0o---

noi_dung:
22/ Tien Kieu Music Response Poetry

If you want to be truly beneficial in this life, you must follow the Pure Land dharma, believe and pray to recite the Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West, and you will definitely escape the path of birth and death. If not, then don't say that those who do not have true teachings of Buddhism cannot achieve liberation, even if they can, they will still be defeated! Because the true transmission is great enlightenment, not real realization. I have just recovered from samsara, enlightenment is still within that cycle. To practice other methods, one must stop or attain enlightenment to escape birth and death. As for the Pure Land discipline, one only needs to believe deeply, pray earnestly, recite the name Buddha, stop evil deeds, do good deeds, including cultivating both the right supports, and decide to rebirth. Furthermore, in terms of dignity, they also have the upper hand. Not only are those with pure virtue determined to be reborn, but those who have committed the Five Evils and Ten Evils, when they are about to die, they will wake up, be extremely ashamed, and be afraid, even reciting the Buddha for a few sentences until they die, will also be determined to be reborn. Because the Buddha has great compassion, he specializes in saving sentient beings as his duty. If anyone knows how to return with just one thought, they will immediately be accepted. That's called“Relying on Buddha's power, bring karma to rebirth.”

People in the End of Dharma world, if they practice other disciplines and do not follow the Pure Land, will only receive blessings in the Heavens and Human realms and sow liberation in lives far, far away. Because sentient beings in this life do not have the strength to end karma, the root of birth and death still remains. So how can we avoid sprouting the dream of birth and death again?

---o0o---

tieu_de: 23/ Poem Responding to Layman Truong Van Loi
tom_tat: The book Introduction to Buddhism Questions and Answers can guide beginners, making them gradually go deeper into Buddhist teachings and develop true faith. If you print it out and give it as a gift to create dharma connections, what greater merit could there be? These books discuss…
noi_dung:
23/ Poem Responding to Layman Truong Van Loi

The book Introduction to Buddhism Questions and Answers can guide beginners, making them gradually go deeper into Buddhist teachings and develop true faith. If you print it out and give it as a gift to create dharma connections, what greater merit could there be? These books extensively discuss the principles of Buddhism. Although they mention the Pure Land dharma, they actually do not fully reveal the meaning of this sect. If you have faith, you should read the Pure Land scriptures. If you don't have enough means to review a lot, you can read carefully a book of Kinh Trung Kinh Huu Kinh. This book collects the essential meanings of the Pure Land sect, divided into clear categories, very beneficial for beginners. If viewed, one can go straight to the mystery of Buddha's recitation, saving the effort of studying other Pure Land scriptures.

Buddha Dharma is up to each person. You should definitely not adhere to conventional rules, which will go against your foundation and cause you to lose great benefits: a life of escape. So, according to your own nature, arrange your own religious rituals. The rebirth mantra by Pham Van is very good to learn, but don't be tempted to discriminate against the traditional way of chanting as incorrect. If you have that notion, you will have more doubts about all the mantras in the Tripitaka, and then mistakenly believe that those articles do not agree with the Buddha's wishes. You should know that in the past, when the virtuous people translated the Sutras, it was not an empty task. Don't see that the new way of translating is different and quickly look down on the old way. Over the past thousand years, people who recite mantras according to the old translation have benefited greatly. Is it true that these people do not understand Brahmanical texts? So you should still study, but don't have the notion of superiority, inferiority, lowness, or superiority, then the natural benefits are inconceivable!

Reciting mantras is similar to reciting the first dialogue. Taking part in the first line, because it cannot be explained, one can end the distinction between ordinary feelings and realize the true nature of heaven. Reciting mantras because you don't know the meaning, just chant with all your heart, so karma obstacles are eliminated, blessings are immense. These benefits cannot be thought about or measured. The ritual of paying homage to the Buddha is not convenient to set up specifically for those who have urgent matters. You should only be sincere, confess your name with your mouth, and bow your body, as if the Buddha was present in front of you. Living in a life of impurity, living beings compete and kill each other. Without a protective talisman, it would be difficult to escape disaster. That talisman is the sincere worship of Amitabha Buddha. Again, the Venerable Avalokitesvara prayed deeply and compassionately, looking for the voice to save suffering, depending on the opportunity, he immediately responded. In addition to paying homage to the Buddha in the morning, he should also pay homage to the Buddha. He will definitely receive blessings in silence. He can turn disaster into blessings, misfortune turns into good fortune without even knowing it himself.

The above are the words of a country man in a foreign country who performed a spell to save his life for his soulmate. If we say "for the whole world", it's not impossible, it's just that people won't accept the practice method, then what can we do?

---o0o---

noi_dung:
24/ Poem to Layman Ta Dung Thoat

In your hometown, you learned about the Buddhist recitation method because Lam Gioi Sanh requested the Pure Land scriptures to bring back to spread. If in previous lives the lay people did not cultivate good roots for that method, then how could they take the ancient example as a teacher, and after hearing it, immediately develop faith and vows, practice it themselves, and advise others? Newly opened communes must have certain rules and be careful about allowing women to participate. If you want to eliminate that nature, you must first clearly realize that all dharmas in life are suffering, emptiness, impermanence, non-self, or impurity, then the three fires of greed, anger, and delusion will gradually be extinguished. If it cannot be stopped, we must use honesty, compassion, patience, and forgiveness to treat it. People leaving the home life also follow the same order when they are leaving the home life: the novice, bhikkhu and Bodhisattva precepts. Therefore, the few uneducated and uncultivated monks outside are all people who have received the three great precepts. I'm afraid the Sangha in your area doesn't understand this, saying that saving people from the home life is a very good thing, allowing scoundrels to mix into Buddha's door to destroy the Dharma, so they don't fear jealousy and speak frankly.

Pure Land is the most mysterious and complete Dharma in the Tathagata's teachings. To receive poetry and know that this precious place still has the Dharma of Confucianism and Buddha, you guys are doing your best to take charge, I am very happy! As for my compliments, they really lift a blade of grass from a high building, show off their ankles more than pearls, are used too politely in real life, making people feel so ashamed! „N Quang is still a tolerant monk, always taking leftover soup and steamed rice from rich people's houses to feed himself. If anyone doesn't think it smells bad, he also shares it with each other. But layperson Tu Huat Nhu said that the food was useful for hungry people, so he printed and circulated the words of this rustic person several times. Although the idea was somewhat feasible, the literature was not worth looking at. No wonder my Van Sao ignored your green eyes, I really feel extremely embarrassed! In it, the points: Right mind, devotion, used to counteract the external search and fearlessness of people in today's world, is also somewhat beneficial for beginners. But, if one who is knowledgeable in Buddhism understands the visible teachings, one cannot help but wonder. However, if you vomit all the hard-to-digest foods of the Religion, then the leftover soup from the steamed rice can also nourish your vitality. Wait until your health recovers, then use the delicacy to be truly beneficial.

About the methods: Law, Teachings, meditation, Purity, whichever is suitable, please read carefully the article Pure Land Quyet Nghi Luan in my Van Sao and you will clearly understand. Even though the great practitioner practices meditation and Purity, he must take Pure Land as his master. If ordinary people do not need to study all the profound scriptures, they should only do good and eliminate evil, chanting Buddha with all their hearts and praying to the West. That type of person still lives according to the world by cultivating the path of the world. Although it seems normal and not strange, the benefits are inconceivable! Because ignorant country people only use their sincere hearts to believe in Buddha's memory, they can secretly harmonize with the Buddha's teachings and sympathize with Buddha's wisdom. People who understand the teachings, their minds are often calculating and calculating, so they spend their entire day in a circle of discrimination, compared to the sincerity of those ignorant people. Therefore, ignorant countrymen who recite Buddha's name can easily benefit. Even a great scholar can easily let go of everything; On the contrary, if you only speculate about the meaning, not only is it not useful, you may become sick, or if you do not think it is right, you will fall into the sect of extravagance.

Meditation is not a predestined opportunity for people in today's world. Even if they study it, they will only have an understanding of the written word, and will definitely not be able to reveal their true nature. Why? Because there is a lack of good knowledge to guide and instruct, students do not know what meditation is. Most people call it meditation, but it is actually a misunderstanding. In the essay“Zong and Religion should not be confused”and“Pure Land Quyet Nghi”, I have shown an outline of the above. People in today's world, regardless of their ability, must maintain morality, maintain respect, firmly believe in cause and effect, do good deeds, and meditate on Buddha to seek rebirth in the West. Cause and effect is a great furnace to heat mortals to refine Saints in the worldly and transcendental Dharma. If we don't first study cause and effect, after understanding Buddhism, I'm afraid we will still make mistakes on this issue, and if we make mistakes, we will inevitably fall into ruin. Therefore, don't think cause and effect are superficial and look down on them. Ordinary people, because of their narrow minds, do not fully understand the places that talk about cause and effect in the sutras. In fact, the Tathagata who have achieved Enlightenment and the sentient beings who have fallen into the three stages are no exception to that principle. We should use short-sighted dharma in life as a means to enter the wonderful path, like the gods: Van Xuong Sound Quality, Supreme Touch for example. If you read these books carefully and practice them, everyone can escape the path of reincarnation, or at least become a good person. Although reciting the Buddha's name is important for rebirth, when reciting it to the extreme, one can realize the true mind. It is not completely unhelpful for the present life. In the past, Zen Master Minh Giao Tung recited the Holy name of Avalokitesvara ten thousand verses every day. Later on, he knew all the scriptures in life without reading them. You should read Pure Land Ten Essentials, Pure Land Thanh Hien Luc, you will know that reciting Buddha is miraculous. About this, my Van Sao often talks about it. Your Majesty said: "Reciting Buddha's name does not bring benefits in the present life", that's because I haven't studied the scriptures of Tinh Tong. As for my book Van Sao, perhaps you guys read it like a horseman checking the lights, not bothering to learn more.

As for the precepts, not only in terms of appearance, but not maintaining respect is also an offense. Cause and effect are the core pillars of the law. If you do not know or are ignorant of this principle, you are violating the law or making a mistake. People who recite Buddha's name, if they keep their thoughts in accordance with the right principles, then in one practice include all of: Law, Teaching, Purity, meditation. You should know that practicing all other methods must be completely stopped or karma will no longer exist in order to achieve liberation. As for the Pure Land discipline, if the person who eliminates all afflictions is reborn, he or she will quickly attain Dharma body. Those with heavy karma, when returning to Ultimate Bliss, will also have ascended to the Holy realm. Comparing the two aspects, one side uses all their own strength, the other side relies on Buddha's power, the difference between superiority and inferiority is as far away as the abyss and the sky. There are many intelligent people who, every time they read interesting books about the Zen sect, immediately consider themselves to be Zen guests and want to become masters. That class does not know what meditation and purity are, and makes the mistake of being arrogant. Those who have such views should definitely not imitate them. If we follow this, escaping from birth and death, I'm afraid it will be difficult to aspire to go through a life like dust.

Please review my book Van Sao carefully and you will understand.
