tieu_de: 26/ Response poem to Layman Ma Khe Tay (1 - 3)
tom_tat: 1. The Buddha recitation session should be set up according to each person's own suitable place. According to the rituals in the Buddhist Recitation Hall of today's temples, before chanting the Amitabha sutras, recite the three rebirth mantras, then recite the verse praising the Buddha,...
noi_dung:
26/ Response poem to Layman Ma Khe Tay (1 - 3)

1.The Buddha recitation session should be set up according to each person's own appropriate place. According to the rituals in the Buddhist Recitation Hall of today's temples, before chanting the Amitabha sutras, recite the three rebirth mantras, then read the verse praising the Buddha, and at the end of the chant, continue reciting.“Namo the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss World, Great Compassion Amitabha Buddha”, then stand up and walk around Buddha's table to recite. The circumambulation must be from East to South, West to North, that is called compliance, it is rejoicing and only then can there be merit. In Tay Vuc, circumambulation is highly respected. Our country also uses this ritual, along with worshiping, to show respect. If you go from East to North, West to South, it means the opposite, there is sin, this should be known. Walk around reciting the Buddha's name for a while, then sit down and recite it silently, hoping for a moment to recite it out loud again. When you're almost finished, kneel and recite ten sentences to Buddha, Avalokitesvara, Theravada, Purity Sea, each holy name three times, then read the vow text, chant the Three Refuges, then bow to the Buddha and leave. If the person is shaking, if the place is narrow and difficult to move around, then kneeling, standing, or sitting to recite is also fine. In short, you must arbitrarily decide according to the situation, spirit, and health of the individual. If you ask someone else to create the formula for you, you will not be able to complete it.

"Reciting but not reciting, not reciting but reciting", is the realm of the person who has recited to the level where the Buddha's mind is compatible. At that time, even though I often recite the Buddha's name, there is no sign of the thought arising in my heart. Even though my heart does not give rise to my thoughts, I still constantly confess my thoughts, or remember my thoughts. (The corresponding time has not yet arrived. If you don't start your mind and recite, you won't be able to recite). Not reciting here, do not mistake it as not reciting Buddha, because that is only for the absolute state of starting the mind to reciting, in fact, each sentence of Buddha's name is still connected without interruption. That realm is not easy, don't get it wrong. Although visualization is good, you need to know that the Buddha statue you see belongs to the present mind; If you mistake it for an external scene, the ghost may go crazy. The ideal is that although the Buddha statue is clear, it does not have an obstructive appearance. It really exists. If you perceive it like that, it will become a ghost scene. When reciting Buddha's name, whether your eyes are open or closed, it depends on your preference... Maintaining the Holy name of Avalokitesvara is very beneficial, everyone should practice like that. When working, one cannot maintain pure mindfulness because one has not yet reached the state of one mind without chaos. Thus, it is difficult to avoid separation, because one mind cannot have two uses. So often concentrate your mind and look inside.

Everyone has to keep their duties, like you have a grandmother, parents, a wife and a younger brother below, the karma position is leisurely and easy to practice. In that situation, it's not really worth the effort, why would you want to leave the home life? Are you sure that when you leave the home life, you will have such a good opportunity to concentrate on practicing? You should know, leaving the home life is the duty of the person leaving the home life, not to give up all work? Like An Quang here seems like a carefree person, but he is also busy most of the year, with no time to concentrate on reciting Buddha, let alone others? So practice according to your ability, don't think about anything outside of your duty.

That is happiness for you, but also what I wish for.

2.Practitioners need peace of mind to rest and rest. Your name is Tinh Am, why don't you consider your name and remember its meaning? You keep creating more work to make everyone bored, but you yourself are burdened with the evidence: Bloating, dizziness, headaches? If you don't know how to respect yourself, you will inevitably vomit blood, in the light of which you will become disabled, in the worst case, your life will be incomplete. That makes people sarcastically say that if you study Buddha and practice, not only will it not benefit you, but you will also be harmed! Then, for the same reason, an ignorant person slandered him, saying: That is the harm of Buddha Dharma. They find all kinds of ways to prevent others from cultivating and destroy their good roots. Few people understand that the mistake is because you don't really practice according to Buddha's teachings. So you must know good and bad, try to fulfill your duty as a practitioner, and gain understanding in silence. Your illness was all caused by yourself. If you don't examine yourself, who do you ask?

So you should quickly correct your mistakes and meditate on Buddha. The scriptures should also be temporarily suspended and not read. Just follow my advice and you will recover within a few months. If that's not the case, then I beg your pardon, teacher and student, if we meet another day we will be just like passersby!

3.Name is the appearance of truth. Even if you really have a name, you still don't take it as an honor, because it belongs to your duty. Not really famous, already a lot of shame, let alone want to publish it in the newspaper to arouse the eyes and ears of visitors from all over? If that were done, everyone would be suspicious and discuss it, and it would certainly become a real case of identity theft in life. You only know one, not two, so I have to explain it clearly several times. With Buddha Dharma, although you have deep faith, you like to show off, make connections, and travel; That is a big obstacle to practice. Besides, you're only in your twenties, and you've made so many friends. Later, when you master Buddhism, you probably won't have any free time every day. Be quiet and quiet, the benefits will be immense!

We must try to be cautious and self-controlled!

noi_dung:
27/ Poem in Response to a Layman in Dong Giang

Lust is a common disease of people. Not only the middle and lower classes are fascinated by it, but if the people of high capacity do not abstain from fear and preserve it, it will also be difficult for them to avoid bringing harm. In the past, how many talented men had the talent to become saints, only to be unable to break through that barrier and become cowardly and unsmiling people! Countless sentient beings also fell into the three realms because of that. In the Shurangama Sutra, the Buddha told Ananda: “If living beings in the six realms of worlds can stop lust, they will no longer be revolving in the cycle of life and death. You practice Samadhi in order to escape from the world. If you do not eliminate lust, liberation is impossible."For those who study the Dharma, the important issue is life and death. If we don't get rid of that disease quickly, how can we leave the suffering of samsara? Even though the method of reciting the Buddha's name is karma rebirth, if you have a strong attachment to lust, you will definitely be separated from the Buddha, and the path of induction will be difficult to communicate with. To end that disaster, there is nothing better than seeing all women, thinking they are relatives, unjust and dirty.

What does it mean to feel familiar? When I see an old woman, I think she's my mother, older than me, I think she's my sister, younger than me, I think she's my sister, and even younger, I think she's my child. Even though people's desires are strong, they definitely do not dare to have unrighteous thoughts towards their mothers, sisters, brothers and children. That is to use morality to prevent desire from arising.

What is it like to be unjust? People, as usual, when they see beauty, they immediately fall in love. Because of that deluded mind, he fell into evil paths for many lifetimes and suffered without being able to escape. Then the charming and beautiful appearance, compared to tigers, wolves, hissing snakes and other poisons, is a hundred thousand times more harmful! Isn't it too foolish to still be attached to such a huge injustice?

What do you think is dirty? Beauty is just a thin outer layer of skin. If you peel off that layer of skin, it will be full of bones, flesh, blood, pus, phlegm, drool, dirt, and a foul smell that no one wants to see! Those undesirable things, just because they are hidden by a thin skin, make the wrong person fall in love with them. Like a beautiful vase containing dirty things, no one picks it up to look at it. The skin of a beauty is no different from that beautiful vase, inside it is more filthy than feces. Should we only love the outside, completely forget the inside, and mistakenly give birth to false thoughts? If you don't guard against fear and control that habit, you will be deceived by the fragile beauty. That arrow will be stuck deep in your bones. How can you pull it out on your own? It's like that in normal times, but if you want to not fall into the womb after death, that's impossible. But when you enter a human fetus, you're fine, but when you enter an animal's womb, what happens? Try to think carefully about this, your mind will naturally be filled with fear! However, if you want to avoid being infected when you see a scene, you must first often think of the above three things, then when facing the scene, you will not be shaken. Otherwise, even if you don't see the scene, your mind will still dream constantly, and it will still be bound by the habit of lust. Therefore, when it comes to female form, we must thoroughly consider and wipe away the contaminated habits of lust to have some freedom.

Every day, in addition to their duties, lay people try to concentrate on reciting the Buddha's name and wholeheartedly repent and repent of their karma from time immemorial until now. Thus, over time there will be inconceivable benefits that you don't even know about. The Lotus Sutra says: “If there are any sentient beings who have a lot of sexual desire, they will always reverently recite Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, and they will be free from sexual desire.”, even a lot of anger and ignorance. Then you know, if you sincerely recite Amitabha's holy name, you will also be able to eliminate three things: greed, anger, passion. Furthermore, now is a time of many hardships, outside of reciting Buddha's name, you should also recite the Holy name of Avalokiteshvara. In this way, there will be a very mysterious transformation in silence, to avoid the situation when complete karma appears and there is no way to escape. Must look for books: By observing sexual precepts, cause and effect, retribution, and staying away from wandering friends, only then can one's conduct be righteous, stable, and pure karma can be achieved.

Try! Try!

noi_dung:
28/ Poem in response to two lay people Ngan Nhu and Dat Nhu

Looking at the poem, I see two people expressing sadness because of the constraints of life, not knowing how to achieve liberation. Everyone has duties and responsibilities, although there are many things to do, but if the mind is calm and does not change according to the situation, then even when busy, one can achieve liberation and comfort. That situation is like a mirror reflecting the image, the image comes without hindrance, the image goes without attachment. If you don't understand this meaning, even if you give up everything in life, your mind will still be troubled and restless. People who study Buddha know how to follow their destiny and fulfill their duties, so even though they come into contact with countless conditions, they still enjoy being outside the scenery every day. That's the meaning"If one heart does not dwell, all situations are at ease"so.

As for chanting the Buddha's name, it is very necessary to escape the cycle of life and death. Because of that, the suffering of self-born Samsara is discouraged, and the joy of Ultimate Bliss is naturally loved. So in one thought, both vows are fulfilled. Add to that a sincere and earnest heart like a child missing his mother, then the power of Buddha, the power of Dharma and the power of merit and faith in his mind, the three dharmas are complete. That force is like the sun in the sky, even if there is thick snow and frost, it will soon disintegrate on its own. People who have just recited the Buddha's name have not yet reached Samadhi, so how can they avoid having false thoughts? But if you know how to bring your mind inward and not follow false scenes, it is already very precious! For example, if there are two opposing battles, you need to keep your fortress strong, don't let the opposing side invade, in case the enemy troops come over and immediately attack. At that time, the Right Enlightenment soldiers must be surrounded on all four sides, so that the enemy has no way to escape and must surrender. The important thing is that the commander must always be alert and not be lazy or lethargic. If you commit those two mistakes, not only will you not be able to destroy the enemy, but you will be destroyed by the enemy. Therefore, if a person recites the Buddha's name and does not know how to capture the mind, the more he recites it, the more delusions will arise. If you can control your mind, your false thoughts will gradually weaken until they disappear. So the ancients had a verse:

“Learning the way is like keeping a forbidden city,

Guard against six enemies every day, be diligent at night.

Generals, soldiers, and commanders all follow orders,

Don't use any sword to hurt the country."

tom_tat: The fire in Wenzhou sounds tragic! The disaster of heaven and water really does not know what is the end! That suffering is enough evidence for the verse: "The three realms are not at peace, like a house on fire" in the Lotus Sutra, and is also a very good reminder...
noi_dung:
29/ Poem Responding to Layman Bao Master Hien

The fire in Wenzhou sounds tragic! The disaster of heaven and water really does not know what is the end! That suffering is enough evidence for the verse: “The three realms are not at peace, like a house on fire.”in the Lotus Sutra, and is also a very important reminder for faith, prayer, and reciting the Buddha's name to seek rebirth in Ultimate Bliss.

Reciting the Buddha is not consistent, because it is not earnest about life and death samsara. If you think you are being burned by water and fire with no one to save you, or are at the moment of death and about to fall into Hell, then your mind is self-centered and there is no need to find any miraculous methods. Therefore, in the sutras it is often said: “Thinking about the suffering in Hell, one should develop the heart of Bodhi.”This is a very essential teaching of the enlightened One, World-Honored One, it's a pity that people don't really think about it. The suffering in Hell is comparable to the disaster of water and fire, it is unimaginably more urgent, infinitely more painful! When you think of fire and water, you are afraid. When you think of Hell, you are indifferent. That means a person with poor intelligence cannot clearly observe suffering. If you were to see that scene with your own eyes, your hair would suddenly stand on end, your bones would vibrate, you wouldn't be able to control yourself.

tieu_de: 30/ Poem Responding to Great Master Phap Hai
tom_tat: For more than ten years now, the court has been looking for teachers to study religion to benefit themselves and others, which is commendable. Now let go of all fates, single-mindedly recite the Buddha's name, use enlightenment as the cause of practice, and perhaps attain Samadhi...
noi_dung:
30/ Poem Responding to Great Master Phap Hai

For more than ten years now, the court has been looking for teachers to study religion to benefit themselves and others, which is commendable. Now let go of all conditions, single-mindedly recite Buddha's name, take enlightenment as the cause of practice, and perhaps attain Samadhi and attain high rank. If the court is determined, then your wish will certainly be fulfilled. But although many people recite Buddha's name, very few attain Samadhi. Because they have not yet let go of all the conditions of holding one thought, it is difficult for their mind and Buddha to merge. Your Majesty, since you have truly kept your body and mind clean, is it possible that you have no place to gain? But in the poem about a few points: "Reveal your heart and see your nature, escape life and death, and the evidence of enlightenment will come to your hand", need to make some distinctions.

If you practice according to common teachings, even if you are able to see your true nature, you are still far from escaping samsara of life and death, because that realm belongs to enlightenment, not realization. There are very few people in this world who are enlightened, let alone attain enlightenment? When you attain enlightenment, your karma will be completely exhausted, the root of birth and death will be ended, and you will no longer feel the fruit of samsara. A Sotapanna was born in heaven seven times, returned to the human world seven times, and only after consuming two things, views and thoughts, attained Arhat. Mr. Thien Thai appears at the fifth level, Mr. Nam Nhac at the 10th position; Those Great Masters still hide their true virtues, claiming to only have internal and external status. Isn't it easy to say that they can attain enlightenment? But this is a convention according to common teachings to discuss the difficulty of attaining enlightenment in this life. If we follow the Pure Land discipline, which is a special dharma established by the Tathagata, then from the level of Enlightenment below to the level of serious sinners, Abhidharma, if they have enough faith and vows, will be born into Ultimate Bliss under the Buddha's power. Once reborn, all enlightenment and enlightenment are as easy as gathering grass. On a slightly different note, the court specializes in reciting Buddha's thoughts, does not mention rebirth at the time of death, but says that it can be firmly grasped by evidence of enlightenment. Saying that it is okay to attain enlightenment, why say: by hand? If it comes to you, then there's no need to discuss it. What if it doesn't come? Judging by the meaning in those words, it seems that the court only recites the Buddha's name and does not make a sincere wish to pray for Ultimate Bliss. That is the way of using Buddha's name as the first dialogue of a meditation monk, which is not in accordance with the principles of Faith and Prayer in the Pure Land discipline. Reciting the Buddha's name without faith is compared to practicing meditation. Although the first line has greater merit, if karma is still present, liberation will not be achieved. Because they don't believe in their vows, they can't rely on the Buddha's power to help them. It's still a common self-help method, and it's very difficult to attain enlightenment. Do not consider the faith in praying for rebirth to be inferior, because on the Avatamsaka Assembly, the two beings in the Huagarbha realm all use the ten great vows to determine the merit of rebirth. Furthermore, the Bodhisattva and Patriarchs of the Pure Land sect all told us to have faith and pray to be born in Ultimate Bliss. Why did Your Highness set up a separate communal house that did not follow the Holy Rules of the Buddha and Patriarch? And, people who have been reciting Buddha all month, all year, all their life, should they not practice the Rites and Prayers? Among the ten great vows of kings, Le Kinh is at the top, the court should do whatever is possible, and definitely should not abandon paying homage to the Buddha. If you do not pay homage to the Buddha, it will be difficult to sympathize, because the body loves peace and stability, and will lack the support conditions to fully develop one's devotion. According to Thien Dao's specialized practice, the body specializes in bowing, the mouth specializes in calling, the mind specializes in thoughts, and the thoughts are extremely natural in addition to the non-Buddha mind, the Buddha mind is the same.

That enlightenment and the ways of cultivating self-reliance are incomparable. Regarding this, the ancients gave an example of a lowly person who relied on King Luan's precious wheel and could travel around the four continents in one day. Therefore, Your Majesty should not take the very special method of reciting the Buddha's name and follow the self-reliant path of ordinary contemplation. Even though An Quang was cowardly and stupid, he did not dare to promise to accept that job. If the court can use a pure heart and not be contaminated by any impurities, develop the three minds and recite the Buddha's name, then in this life the body will attain Samadhi, and after death will be reborn in the High Rank. Thus, An Quang asked to join hands first to congratulate.

A fool can do a thousand things and use only one thing. I hope the Court will reconsider.

---o0o---

tieu_de: 31/ Poem Responding to Layman Hoang Ham Chi
tom_tat: When I received the poem, I was extremely happy! Mrs. Sun had many good roots in her previous life, so she asked you to help her be reborn, and told her children and grandchildren in the family to recite Buddha's name for a long time to follow up. So not only…
noi_dung:
31/ Poem Responding to Layman Hoang Ham Chi

When I received the poem, I was extremely happy! Mrs. Sun had many good roots in her previous life, so she asked you to help her be reborn, and told her children and grandchildren in the family to recite Buddha's name for a long time to follow up. In this way, not only will the dead benefit, but many of those who support them will also plant good roots. That is called true mercy, different from the delusional habit of people in the world, when unfortunate relatives immediately kill living beings to make offerings, causing the dead person's spirit to be trapped in a dark place. Lady Sun's work is perfect like that, but as for Lady Thai, who is eighty-three years old, you should advise people to have faith and pray to recite the Buddha's name. But for people of advanced age, their practice is in the beginning stages, their body and mind are weak, and they are afraid they won't be able to chant all day. In the past, I wanted to set out a method to support mindfulness in the present moment for such people, but I couldn't think of it. One day, when I saw the Governor of Vuong Duyet Son bring his mother and many relatives up the mountain to worship, I suddenly found a very good way to help me recite. I have already described that method to Vuong Tran Thu, and now I would like to express it to you all:

Your relatives, as for men, all have their own karma positions. As for women, such as daughters-in-law, daughters, and nannies, there is nothing very important. You should tell those people to take turns staying by Lady Thai Lady's side, loudly reciting Buddha's name for half an hour at a time. Every day, keep alternating like that, don't let the chanting stop. It's still good for the Thai lady to recite along, otherwise she just advises the photographer to listen carefully, then it's okay to never leave the Buddha. Those who assist in reciting do not waste much effort, because each day only a few times is enough, and they can sow the good cause of liberation. You should borrow that method to fulfill your filial piety. Even if the Thai lady lives to be over a hundred years old, if she continues to do so, the benefits are inconceivable. And, when meeting people who have faith in wanting to achieve rebirth for their parents, they should advise them on this method. Your Majesty is busy with national affairs and cannot set a time to recite to help, but if you have any free time, you should recite once to set an example and make your diligent descendants happy.

In my opinion, doing so has many conveniences. This method should be written as an additional article at the end of the book Van Sao, so that those with filial piety will not be left complaining: "If you want to repay a debt of gratitude, the heavens will have no end!"

---o0o---

tieu_de: 32/ Poems Responding to Layman Ha Hue Chieu
tom_tat: Knowing poetry, knowing that you have very deep roots and pure conduct, that's why you have those strange scenes. But most people in today's world love fame, and if they get half a share, it's worth talking about hundreds of thousands of shares. As in…
noi_dung:
32/ Poems Responding to Layman Ha Hue Chieu

Knowing poetry, knowing that you have very deep roots and pure conduct, that's why you have those strange scenes. But most people in today's world love fame, and if they get half a share, it's worth talking about hundreds of thousands of shares. As in the record of that layman, his realms were all arbitrarily drawn and different from the truth. You did not lie, but I am afraid that if you have that habit, you will make many mistakes! The Buddha listed the sin of lying among the five basic precepts, precisely to prevent that evil. As for ordinary things, if you don't see or hear, the crime is still light. If you intentionally want to build a long-term construction in the middle of nowhere, lying about miraculous realms, saying that you have not yet attained it, that is great falsehood, this crime is hundreds of thousands of times worse than killing, stealing, and committing adultery. If the person who commits the offense does not repent, he will definitely fall into Avici hell, because those words make sentient beings mistaken and can destroy the Buddha Dharma. So you need to be careful with the scenes you have seen, and not say one more or less thing. If you add or subtract, it means you are at fault, because a wise person has not yet realized the other's mind and path, and only uses words as evidence to judge. Showing such realms to intellectuals to determine the truth, falsehood, rightness, and evilness is not a mistake. If it were not for the sake of proving one's resolve, the desire to boast would also be at fault. Again, you should only reveal it to a wise person asking for proof. In addition, you should not tell anyone. If you reveal it, it will be harmful, because later you will no longer be able to see that realm. This is the first relationship of practitioners, which Thai Buddhism often talks about. That's why people who recite Buddha's name in this day and age are often influenced by demons, because they use a delusional mind to hope for strange scenes. Don't say that the scene is a demon, even if there is a beautiful landscape, if you are happy and greedy, it will still be damaged, not to mention is it really a beautiful landscape? If a person has the ability to nourish and completely stop the mind from wandering, when seeing the realms, there is no joy, greed, fear, or doubt, then even if he encounters a demonic scene, he will still benefit. What can we say about a miraculous scene? The reason it is like that is because it is not subject to demonic transformation so it can progress further. I rarely talk about the above things to people, but now because you have this matter, I have to explain it clearly.

First, you bow to the Buddha and suddenly see the statue of Guan Yin Bodhisattva appearing, which is not correct. If this is indeed the Buddha scene, then it is not unreasonable to think: "Statues and Sutras are not compatible", immediately invisible. But therefore the more earnest your faith, the better the karma. But you should not always want to see the image, just sincerely worship. That way you won't have to worry about other risks.

When you are about to sleep, you see a white light in front of your eyes and when paying homage to the Buddha, you see the image of the Buddha standing in the middle of nowhere. Although it belongs to a good scene, you should not be greedy in advance and wish for it, because if so, later that scene will no longer appear. Looking at your nature, it seems like you practiced meditation in your previous life, so you often have those characteristics. During the Ming Dynasty, Mr. Ngu Thuan Hi meditated at Thien Muc Mountain, the death chamber of ancient meditation master Cao Phong Dieu, for a long time knew the past and future, and often foretold the rains, suns and disasters and blessings of people. When Master Lien Tri heard about it, he sent a letter strongly condemning it, saying it was a ghost net. Thuan Hi woke up and could no longer predict the future. Therefore, those who study the Dharma must pay attention to big things, otherwise they will definitely be harmed by small things. Not to mention those realms, even if you have the five penetrations, you still have to put them aside to be able to completely attain enlightenment. If you are greedy first, it will be difficult to progress, or sometimes you will retreat, this is something you need to know.

You dream of entering Buddha's temple, remember two sutras, also belong to a good scene. But the meaning of those two sentences is very clear and not difficult. “Returning the false medicine enlightenment. Returning to true enlightenment is always empty.”(Remove the false along the path of sense. Regarding true enlightenment (permanent emptiness), it means: Because sentient beings mistakenly believe that all things in life are real, they wander in the path of samsara. If you can observe and know that things are inherently empty, then you will immediately escape the path of delusion, follow the path of enlightenment, return to your nature, and realize the true nature, true emptiness, true reality. Those two sentences have not been found anywhere. It is also possible that they are sentences that have been memorized from previous generations, not necessarily the actual scriptures. If you want to distinguish between a demonic realm or a Holy realm, you must review whether that scene is consistent with the teachings in the sutras? And as the result is the Holy Realm, when people see it, their minds are immediately pure, without delusions and attachments; If it is a demonic realm, the mind will be confused and not be pure. Again, the Buddha's light, although bright, does not hurt the eyes. If that were not true, it would be a ghost in disguise. When Buddha appears, use logic: "All conditioned appearances are false"If you decant it, it will appear more clearly. If a ghost appears in disguise, using that principle to clarify it, it will disappear. This is a very solid motto for experiencing true authenticity. At night, you see white light and a clear scene in the middle of nothingness because of the pure mind appearing. Why should you think that the appearance of the Dharma realm is clear and non-dual? If you think like that, you are abusing the Saints, which is no less a sin. If a person who practices Pure karma does not take the realms as his wish, he will not have many manifestations. If your mind is dedicated to seeing the scene, all the realms that appear will be complicated. At that time, if you do not use your mind wisely, or if you are harmed, you must remember this carefully.

Pure Land Dharma uses Faith, Prayer, and Virtue as its main principles. If you have faith and vow, no matter how great or small your deeds are, you will be reborn. If you don't believe in your vow, even if you practice to the point of forgetting all your faculties and completely escaping the world, it's still difficult to hope for Ultimate Bliss. Because, if you realize the truth of that scene and can use your own strength to escape birth and death, then there is no need to discuss it. Just the effort to eliminate false attachments shows that principle, but it has not been truly realized, of course it is difficult to rebirth when there is a lack of Faith. Those who practice meditation, when discussing Pure Land, all abandon their faith and vow to return to the Zen sect. If you practice according to that, you can also become enlightened, but when it comes to escaping from birth and death, I'm afraid the dream will not come true, because karma has not yet been eliminated. You should know that ordinary people can return to Pure Land because of their faith and prayer to the Buddha, so they rely on the magnetic force to receive karma rebirth. If you don't make a vow and recite the Buddha's words to bring it back to your mind, how can you feel the Buddha? The path of inspiration is not compatible, all sentient beings and the Buddha are separate, using the horizontal gate as the dharma of emanation, the benefits are shallow but the losses are deep. The benefit is that by following what the Zen monks say, you can also attain enlightenment; loss means abandoning one's faith and not being able to receive rebirth. Therefore, people who truly practice Pure Land cannot use the teachings of meditation practitioners, because the methods and principles are different.

So you should consider carefully. If you don't think my words are right, then just ask the wise man, or maybe it will be according to your will. Regarding that matter, this An Quang still has no attachments.

33/ Response Poem to Australian Layman Tri Lang

Regarding the matter of blessings Tuan, if from the time he is alive until his death, the truth is exactly as you said, then he will decide to be reborn. In normal times, blessings Tuan clearly recognized that the physical body is illusory, which was very beneficial. Because women often love fake bodies and love to compete with makeup, but now they don't have that thought, so naturally it's easy to be compatible with Pure Land. When dying, being weak and suffering from illness, that is karma hindrance for many lifetimes. Due to diligent practice of Pure karma, one should discover it in order to turn the consequences into present retributions, changing heavy consequences into light ones, that's all. You said: Because of diligent practice, the body becomes weaker and weaker day by day. Those words are not correct, and they are also at fault, causing people with shallow faith to become lazy and delay their practice. You must know that the person reciting Buddha's decision can eliminate karma obstacles. If karma appears, it will be an evil retribution that will result in falling into the three realms and becoming the current suffering to pay for it. Diamond Sutra says: People who accept and uphold this sutra, because they are despised, can end the suffering of many lifetimes in the three paths. Then, thanks to the blessings Tuan is about to be born in the West, he should appear in that small suffering to eliminate the evil karma from countless eons until now. It is truly a great honor. You should not follow ignorant people who say: Because of cultivating, he became sick and died. People who chant Buddha's name in normal times have sincere faith and vows, and no one cannot be reborn. Blessings Tuan was clearly mindful when he was about to die. There were signs of asking and paying respects. After death, his body was soft, clean, and beautiful as if alive. So why should he look at the shallow practice and doubt? According to Amitabha's prayer, even one's mind can be saved in ten recitations. What's more, blessings. If you have been diligently practicing for three years, what doubts are there? Only those with low will, although they often recite Buddha's name, do not pray for rebirth, they only hope for blessings from humans and heaven; Even if that person practices all his life, he will only enjoy blessings in the next life. If a person has true faith and knows how to use his faith to pray to the Buddha, and is determined to receive the power of compassion and acceptance, the path of mutual connection, he will rely on the Buddha's power to cause karma to be born in Ultimate Bliss. So why do we need to ask whether we see the Buddha or not to be able to judge?

It is very good for people who recite Buddha's name before dying to be able to bathe and change their clothes. If you can't do it yourself, outsiders should definitely not replace the preparations for bathing and changing clothes, because it can make it difficult for the dying person to endure the pain to the point of losing mindfulness. You should not feel sad because of the blessings that Tuan did not have time to wear the robe and sit cross-legged. You must know that at that time, you should only chant Buddha in unison to help, and definitely not suggest anything else. If one side likes to show off, it will inevitably lead to falling into a well and being followed by falling stones, which is very harmful to rebirth. This must be remembered carefully.

The command is already old, if I do not clearly explain the above mistake, I am afraid that next time you will use your filial piety to hinder your mother's rebirth, causing people who have been suffering from samsara for many lifetimes to not be liberated. So you should only respect the truth, don't show off external appearances. The meaning of your record is quite concise, there is no need to ask someone to write it down to spread it, because it also belongs to the frivolous things of the world. You should only encourage yourself and your relatives to try to recite Buddha's name so that you can be reborn in the West. In the morning and afternoon during the two sessions, we also read the name of Tuan's blessings dedicating merit in one room, to fulfill the meaning of Teacher and Disciple. blessings Tuan rebirth this time, it can be called not living in vain and dying in vain, very honored! As for following the will, using crushed bones to donate to the water tribe is also a good thing, but be more careful. The bones must be ground into chalk; Use a small silk sieve to sift and make it like a puree. If you grind it lightly, then mix it with flour to make it, you're afraid it will choke if you feed it to small fish. I'm afraid you won't do it properly, so I have to warn you in advance.

---o0o---

tieu_de: 34/ Poem Responding to a Layman
tom_tat: Diseases and demons are both caused by karma. You just earnestly recite Buddha's name, your illness will naturally heal, and ghosts will stay away. If your thoughts are not sincere, or if you start thinking about sexual immorality, then your mind will sink into...
noi_dung:
34/ Poem Responding to a Layman

Diseases and demons are both caused by karma. You just earnestly recite Buddha's name, your illness will naturally heal, and ghosts will stay away. If your thoughts are not sincere, or if you have unrighteous thoughts of adultery, your mind will sink into darkness, and it will be difficult to avoid being disturbed by demons. After each moment of reciting Buddha's name, you should dedicating the merit and praying for all the wronged people in previous lives to be reborn in a good world thanks to that merit. Besides that, don't think about anything else. If the devil shouts and disturbs you, don't be afraid; Do not disturb or create a happy mind, just sincerely recite the Buddha's name. In this way, karma obstacles will naturally be eliminated and blessings will increase.

When it comes to reviewing the sutras, we should not imitate the careless and disrespectful habits of people in this world, but should consider it as the Buddha, the Patriarch, the Holy Sage has come, for it to be truly beneficial. If you can keep it like that, your heart will be clear and righteous, and those demons and evil spirits will no longer have a place to live. If your mind is already evil and is bound to attract evil beings, you cannot make the demons stay away without disturbing you.

Regarding other minds, although ghosts and spirits exist, they are small, narrow and shallow. If one is a karma with no love or emptiness, then the heart is like a bright mirror on a stage, all forms are clearly visible. You do not only think of Buddha but want to understand the truth of that matter, but you do not know that it is sowing the seed of a demon! Like a precious mirror, the reason it has the ability to shine far and near is because its body is clear and free from a speck of dust. Your heart is obscured by karma, but if you want to be of such use, it is like a mirror that is blurred and covered with dust, how can it give off light? Even if there is, it is still demon light, not real light.

But okay, let's leave that aside. With your current situation, you must single-mindedly recite the Buddha's name as if you were in danger from water and fire, as if you were saving your head from a fire, then all evil karma will be destroyed.

---o0o---

tieu_de: 35/ Poems Responding to Layman Chau Manh Do (1 - 10)
tom_tat: 1. Since your body is already old, you cannot yet truly recognize and practice the Pure Land dharma. So often bring the suffering in the six realms of samsara, the joy in the realm of Ultimate Bliss and the very easy things of ups and downs, to the downfall, and explain them to...
noi_dung:
35/ Poems Responding to Layman Chau Manh Do (1 - 10)

1.Since your body is already old, you cannot yet truly recognize and practice the Pure Land dharma. Therefore, we often teach the suffering in the six realms of Samsara, the joy in the realm of Ultimate Bliss, and the very easy truths of ups and downs to the listeners. If you can't return to the West, don't say you don't have enough hope in the human world. Even if you are born in heaven and enjoy lasting happiness, once the power of the blessings is over, you will still return to fall into the human world and the three evil paths and suffer. If you don't know Buddha's teachings, that's fine. Now that you understand Buddha's teachings, why should you give that great benefit to others? And how can we resign ourselves to forever sinking in the sea of samsara suffering, not looking forward to the day of liberation? You should often preach like that, perhaps you can make the order to develop the good roots of previous lives, to believe and practice. Bodhisattva comes into the world to save sentient beings according to opportunity, first guided by desire, then brought to Buddha's wisdom. If you can try to cultivate filial piety and guide the Pure Land dharma among your relatives and all those who are predestined to be good friends in Lien Tri, then how great will your merit be?

2.When people are sick or encounter dangerous accidents, they often do not know how to recite Buddha's name to do good things, and instead make the mistake of wanting to ask for help from demons and gods. Therefore, killing lives causes more karma, which is very pitiful! Suffering and other disasters are mostly caused by karma from previous lives; If you chant Buddha, repentance, and do good, your sins will be eliminated and your illness will quickly get better. Those types of demons are still in the sea of karma, so how can they make people spend their karma? Even if the true gods have great power, compared to the divine power of Buddha, Bodhisattva is no different than the fire of a firefly compared to the light of the sun! Buddhists who refuse to rely on Buddha and Bodhisattva and turn to demons and gods for help are wrong views.

All sentient beings are parents in the past and all Buddhas in the future, so we should mercifully protect them. Do not follow the wrong custom, kill with intent, and then say: You need to have good food to take care of your parents. This is filial piety. People who do not understand Buddha's teachings and do not know the principles of samsara are confused and confused and do not say anything. If a person has heard the Buddha's teachings, but still kills his parents in the previous life to take care of his parents in this life and uses flesh and blood as a funeral necessity, not only is he not filial, but he is also disobedient. Therefore, knowledgeable people, when they hear the true meaning of Buddhism, refuse to follow the dharma in the world, because that temporary dharma established by following the world's delusions is not the principle that understands the cause and effect of the three lifetimes of the Tathagata. If you want to understand more deeply, read these articles“precepts”In my book Van Sao, it will become clear.

3.When people recite Buddha's name when they are sick, they must wholeheartedly wait for death. If their lifespan has not ended, they will be at peace. Because when you let go of your whole body and recite Buddha's name, the karma obstruction will be eliminated very quickly, and the karma will naturally be cured. If you don't let go of all the conditions and just hope to get well soon, just like the illness won't go away, then the part of rebirth will be lost, because there is no wish for rebirth. If you don't clearly understand this principle, how can you rely on Buddha's magnetic power to guide you? Regarding the disease of the commandment, you should advise people to give up everything to pray for rebirth. If the life span has not ended, the person who prays for rebirth will recover quickly, because he uses a sincere mind and is supported by the Buddha's power.

You should use the above words to advise yourself, do not follow common sense and say unhelpful things.

4.Receiving poetry, knowing the command from not yet truly developing the mind to seek the birth of Ultimate Bliss. Right now you're still sick, so let's postpone it and not mention it. We should only advise people who sincerely recite the Buddha's name, so that thanks to the power of the family, their body and mind will be happy. Wait until the command has recovered, then use skillful words to explain clearly, making people truly develop the mind to seek rebirth, only then will it be beneficial. I ask you to convey my words and orders, telling me to visit you and keep you safe. And it should be said again: I advise people to let go of all conditions and recite Buddha's name single-mindedly, which is essential for self-salvation. Other than that, leave it to your children and grandchildren to worry about. If you still think about it, it's harmful to your practice of reciting Buddha.

5.Chau Quan Tranh see clearly:

Order Tu is currently sick and is determined not to be away while he is still recovering. But when I look at the situation, I'm afraid he won't be able to live long. Therefore, we must use Manh Do and Tri Chieu to take turns every day at the bedside to recite Buddha's name, making the person chant along. If they cannot recite, then advise them to listen quietly. By doing so, if the order to give up one's lifespan has expired, one will decide to rebirth, if one's fate is not yet fulfilled, one will also eliminate karma obstacles and increase good roots.

As for you, it would be better to change your mind about going to Putuo Mountain by obeying my words and practicing. That way it will be completely harmless. Right now, your physical illness is not yet strong. You should not make a wish to leave the home life. If you do, it will be contrary to life and religion. People who are about to die, if they are supported by chanting, will probably have a part in rebirth; If you lack supporting thoughts, or use crying to trigger thoughts of love and anger, it will be difficult to avoid falling. This is very important and dangerous, so remember carefully. If you can achieve rebirth for your mother, that is also the pure karma of all Buddhas in the three lifetimes. And that is the work of being a Buddha in the midst of worldly hardships. That merit is comparable to ordinary jobs and is infinitely greater. You must discuss with Manh Do, practice the chanting method, and advise him to listen to my words. As for explaining the Buddha Dharma for your mother, it's a very good thing, but concentration and consolation should also be given much attention.

6.The command from making vows sends money to me to do arbitrary merit work and help with the printing of the Literature Sao series. In my opinion, doing meritorious deeds must take advantage of the intellectual expansion of the person doing the work, so I intend to use that money to print the book Avalokitesvara Chant to disseminate far and wide. This has the purpose of letting everyone know that Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara is the refuge of sentient beings in the dharma realm. The great man manifests according to his type, seeks to save suffering, and assists Amitabha in leading those who recite the Buddha's name to be reborn in Ultimate Bliss. Currently, humanity is in trouble and does not know how to prevent it. If everyone sees that book, they will appreciate the Great Master's kindness and want to rely on His power to escape disaster. And, once you have developed the heart to believe and rely on the Great Master, you will always be charitable and make amends, hoping to sympathize with him and ask for his protection and help. The world is not at peace, because people's hearts are cruel. If everyone admired the compassion of the Great Master, the world would gradually change into a peaceful and happy state. Therefore, if this book is circulated, the benefits will be immense, compared to other temporarily useful books, which are very far apart. Moreover, the benevolence also depends on that merit, eliminating karma, adding blessings, being happy in life, and being reborn in Ultimate Bliss. When it comes to the book Van Sao, people read it and develop the mind to do good and recite Buddha's name so much that it is impossible to say it all here.

7.Command from why the disease is not cured? Is this evil caused by sufficient karma, changing heavy consequences into light ones, turning consequences into present retributions, to pay for all that? In the past, when Dharma Master Xuanzang was about to die, he was also suffering from some illness. He suspected that the sutras he had translated were mistaken. While thinking like that, I saw a Bodhisattva comforting me saying: "Due to this small suffering, all your previous life's sins will be eliminated. Don't be skeptical."So you should use this fate as a consolation and benevolence, advising people to be happy and not to be sad or angry. Thus, deciding that we can ask the Buddha for help, our life span will soon be peaceful, and our fate will be fulfilled and we will be born in Ultimate Bliss. People in the midst of illness and suffering should think that if they take a step back, they will find endless happiness! Recently, there has been constant fire and war. We are fortunate to not have encountered such an accident. Even though we are suffering from illness, we can still awaken ourselves to find a way to liberation. In that case, you should only be encouraged to practice diligently, and you will naturally benefit. Is that better than resenting heaven and blaming others to cause more karma for yourself? You should advise your mother not to hold grudges in her heart, and try to concentrate on reciting Buddha's thoughts, then karma will disappear as quickly as snow in boiling water.

Since I returned to the mountain, every day during the chanting session I have been dedicating merit and praying to the Three Jewels family for blessings, if my life span has not yet ended, I will quickly be at peace, as my fate has been fulfilled, and I will soon be born in the Pure Land.

8.Receiving the poem, knowing the order, he recited Buddha's rebirth on the second day. As disciples of the Buddha, you must follow the Buddha's teachings to benefit the consciousness of the body. You should not be too sad and sad, so that those who are still alive and those who have passed away will be in vain. As for funerals, we must use only vegetarian food, not depending on custom. Even if there are people who do not understand Buddha's teachings and criticize them as wrong, let them laugh at them. At the funeral, one should not be too ostentatious or show off, and as Buddha one should only recite Buddha's name. Your brothers and sisters must urge all family members to earnestly recite the Buddha's name, then the spirit of benevolence, both in the family and among relatives and friends, will be beneficial and true. If you have enough resources, you should also do meritorious deeds; As for just enough use, just taking care of the burial is enough. Don't do it too solemnly, otherwise you will have to be in need later which is not good.

9.It is very good to receive poetry and see orders from the time of death. That is also the effectiveness of the person's original vow, and the support of your brothers and relatives. During life, people can hide things, but when they are about to die, they cannot lie. If the pure karma is not mature, how can it be like that? I hope your brothers and all your family members should recite Buddha's name to pursue your legacy. In this way, not only will your mother benefit, but your own merit of reciting the Buddha will also increase. the Buddha taught: “When chanting sutras, reciting mantras, reciting Buddha or making merits, one should dedicating merit to the dharma realm of sentient beings.”In normal times, we still dedicating merit because sentient beings do not interfere with us. What's more, when our dead mother can't bear to wholeheartedly recite Buddha's name and pray for others? If it is possible to dedicating merit for sentient beings, that is, in accordance with the Bodhi vows of all Buddhas, like putting a drop of water into the ocean, then that drop of water will be as deep and wide as the ocean. As if not yet merged with the sea, let alone a drop of water, even if the river is long and the lake is wide, the sea is still as separate as the earth and the sky. Then, when you give merit to your parents and all sentient beings, you are accumulating blessings for yourself. Knowing this meaning, filial people's filial piety increases, and those who are less filial also develop filial piety.

Invite the Sangha to recite for seven weeks, that is very good, but at that time, you brothers must also have someone to chant with you. The women in the house do not necessarily have to follow the class and stand behind the Sangha to chant, because they are afraid that if they are friendly with each other for a long time, it will cause suspicion to outsiders. If a row of women chants, they should stay behind a curtain or set up a separate place where the doors on both sides cannot see each other. That is to set rules and open up rituals for people in the hamlet. If you are indifferent without boundaries, others will follow suit, causing bad relationships later. The ancient people's way of legislating, even though the superiors also took the dharma of the lower ones as the scope, so there were no bad things. If you can recite the Buddha's name in the same way for your mother, and at the same time give away the books Avalokitesvara Chanting and Literature, then not only will your lotus body quality increase, but your grandparents and father will also be able to benefit from the Dharma, and attain the ultimate birth of Ultimate Bliss. What I say is still based on reason, not just fluff to please you!

10.Regarding cremation, during the Tang, Song, and Buddha dynasties, the method was still practiced, and most cremation people also used it. But for now, it is better to bury the body according to tradition, for fear that there will be attachments that will give rise to many discussions. In fact, burning the body dissipates more quickly, and after forty-nine days the burning is even more convenient. Also buried, or when the remains are exposed after many years. After three years of mourning without performing music, that should still be observed. In this day and age, filial piety has been put aside, so why are the rules preserved during mourning worth discussing? However, you should also follow the ancient teachings and principles, don't be too hasty in making changes or being too attached. The way to probe the heat to determine which realm the consciousness is reborn in is worth following. But I'm afraid of those who don't know and keep probing, so it says: "Those who have enough faith in their vows, when they die with clear mindfulness, can be reborn, without having to follow a rule, using cold and heat as evidence."This should be paid attention to, because if you keep touching the heat, it will trigger the attachment and anger of the dying person, ruining the rebirth.

Theories"birth, doubt"In the Great Treasure Sutra, where the Dharma assembly of Infinite Life Tathagata said, it is to show people who recite Buddha's name falling into the error of regret and doubt. This is a wish in the sense of being obstructed, afraid, and established"birth, doubt", because being in a lotus flower for five hundred years and not being able to see the Buddha and hear the Dharma, doesn't that mean there is truth? Why do you keep clinging to the words to explain the meaning, thinking that that type of person does not belong to the nine lotus classes? You should know that in the West, there is no birth and no citadel, which is a wish in the sense of: Shouldn't they immediately leave the intercellular space and be separated from the Buddha, just to give an example of pregnancy and becoming like that? Because you are attached to the noun, you think it is beyond the nine levels. If that is true, then the middle and lower levels are separated by six lifetimes and twelve lifetimes, and how much denser is the city? Those twelve kalpas still belong to the nine levels, what's more, are there only those five hundred years? Why don't you read the next eight words: “In the lotus flower, do not appear…”Isn't that lotus flower listed in the nine-level lotus?

The meaning of Buddha's teachings is extremely broad. If you accept it, there will be no work, so it will be a waste of pen and ink. That's all because I put my feet inside the city of doubt, that city is thicker than Thiet Vi prison. If we understand clearly, naturally the earth will sink in silence and Thiet Vi prison will completely disappear. Master Mencius said: "Using your will to oppose your will is called gaining"; The word "inverse" is also doubtful. If you know that discord is the meaning of respect, then your doubts will disintegrate. tieu_de: 36/ Response Poem to Layman Sheep Boi Khanh (1 - 2)
tom_tat: 1. Such anger is due to habit from previous lives. Now that you know that it is only useless and harmful, you should be tolerant towards all things that are against your will. That is the method used…
noi_dung:
36/ Response Poem to Layman Sheep Boi Khanh (1 - 2)

1.Such anger is due to habit from previous lives. Now that you know that it is only useless and harmful, you should be tolerant towards all things that are against your will. That is the method of using generosity to transform narrow-mindedness. If not treated, the habit of anger will increase more and more, causing no less harm.

When it comes to reciting the Buddha, depending on your mental health, you can recite loudly, softly, silently, or recite in the Vajrayana style (only moving your lips, reciting with sound but outsiders cannot hear), why do you use too much force to cause illness? That too intense mind also has that fault of lust! Now that I can't recite it out loud, I can also recite it silently in my mind. Why is there a limit of ten? Besides, when sick in bed, the heart cannot be as quiet as space. If you think about other things, it is better to think only of Buddha! You should entrust essential matters to family members, often thinking that you are about to die or fall into Hell, with absolutely nothing in mind. Then use that pure mind to remember the Buddha statue, silently chant the name, and also commemorate the Holy image and the name of Avalokiteshvara. As a result, karma obstacles will be eliminated, good roots will grow, illnesses will quickly subside, and body and mind will be at peace. Your illness still belongs to karma. Because of the strong Buddha recitation, it was discovered that it was not entirely caused by using too much force. Assuming we don't encounter that overwhelming cause of reciting the Buddha, it will still be discovered through another cause and effect. In life, there are many people who do not recite Buddha's name. Are they not all sick and healthy all their lives? Understanding this clearly, you will no longer mistakenly believe that reciting the Buddha makes you sick, in the end there will only be harm and no benefit.

An Quang and you have never met each other before, but today we have very sincere words because we consider you as relatives. Because practitioners still follow Buddha's compassion and want those who are predestined to be reborn in this present life. The method of reciting Buddha's name, if you are not familiar with it, you should look at a few Astronomical Stars every day to guide your practice. That way it won't be a waste of time to get to know each other in poetry back and forth.

2.You have faith in me, so doing as I say will only be beneficial. Otherwise, even if you have faith, you will only sow good karma later on. We are in the samsara cycle of life and death, going through many lives, causing limitless and boundless evil karma. If you only rely on your own practice, hoping to end all afflictions, or karma to escape the path of samsara, that is even more difficult than going to heaven. As one can believe in the Buddha's Pure Land teachings, using sincere faith and prayer to chant the name of Amitabha Buddha to seek rebirth in the West, no matter how big or small the karma force is, it all depends on the force of rebirth Ultimate Bliss. For example, if a small grain of sand is placed in water, it immediately sinks. On the contrary, even if a rock weighs thousands of pounds, carried on a big boat, it can be taken to another place. The rock is an example of the deep karma power of living beings, and the big boat is an example of the vast magnetic power of Amitabha. If you don't recite the Buddha's name, you can only rely on your own practice to escape birth and death. You have to wait until the karma state to end love and emptiness. Otherwise, even if troubles can be eliminated or reduced to just a thread, liberation will not be possible. That's an example of a grain of sand, no matter how small, if it doesn't have anything to carry it, when placed in water, it will definitely sink. You should have faith, chant the Buddha's name and pray to be born in the West, and don't have any other thoughts. If it is like that, then the illness will heal quickly in the long life, because of the merit of reciting the Buddha with sincerity, one can eliminate the evil karma of the previous life, just like the pink halo appears, the snow and frost immediately melt. If one's fate is fulfilled, one will certainly be reborn, because due to one's single-minded thoughts, the path will touch the path, thanks to Buddha's mercy and guidance. If you believe that you thoroughly understand the above words, you will have much peace and joy in life, and you will also have great benefits in death.

Anger is a habit from a previous life. If you want to deal with it, you think you are dead. So no matter who puts the incense on the bottle, what can we do? No matter how heart-breaking scenes you encounter, you still think that you are dead, naturally your anger cannot arise. This is the dish“water magic nectar”taught by the Tathagata, to wash away the karma of all living beings. Now I'm telling it for you guys, not from my own theory. If you do not recite Buddha's name and pray to the West, even though you will be born in an extremely noble place like the Phi Phi Phien heaven, when the blessings have ended, you will still be rotated in the six paths. If you recite the Buddha's name with all your heart, even if you are about to fall into Avici Hell, you can still ask the Buddha to guide you. So please don't consider yourself inferior, thinking that your karma is so heavy that you won't be able to be reborn. If you try to keep that concept, you will definitely not be born in the West, because because you lack sincere faith and prayer, you have no reason to feel about Buddha.

Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva became Buddha a long time ago. Because of his deep compassion, he manifested himself in the nine dharma realms, using all means to save sentient beings. (Nine dharma realms: Bodhisattva, Pratyekabuddha, Sravaka, God, Human, Asura, Animal, Hungry Ghost, Hell). As for the dharma realm of the human world, Bodhisattva appears in many different incarnations, either as a king, a mandarin, or a recluse commoner, or as a woman, or as a beggar... not certain. Bodhisattva's true image is beautiful and mysterious, people cannot imagine it, so when drawn, most of it resembles a woman, not that Bodhisattva was originally a female body. If you want to make offerings, you should go to Beijing Road, Truong Khang Hamlet, where Buddha Sutras are circulated, ask for a stone version of the Western Three Saints statue, buy a glass frame and put it in. That is complete, because there are enough Amitabha Buddha, Avalokiteshvara and Theravada Buddha. If the bedroom is not pure, you should worship the Buddha statue in a quiet room. Every day, bow and admire it a couple of times, then you can remember it in your mind!

Although reciting the Buddha's name is precious in its purity, there are many inconvenient things for sick people. Just recite it wholeheartedly silently or out loud, the merit is the same. Because the Buddha is still merciful, like a parent is to a child. When the child is sick, he does not reprimand him with normal rituals, but also rubs his body to wash away the dirty areas. If, when the child is already sick, he still forces his parents to serve him as if he were sick, it is illegal and heaven and earth will not tolerate it. So you should not think that lying on your hospital bed silently chanting Buddha is a sin. Healthy people should recite silently when lying down to rest, let alone sick people?

tieu_de: 37/ Poetry of Advice to a Bhikkhuni
tom_tat: Day and night pass by, seasons change, time changes silently, without a moment of rest! Is it true that creatures manifest a wide and long tongue, speaking colorful Dharma, allowing sentient beings to see the impermanence, glory...
noi_dung:
37/ Poetry of Advice to a Bhikkhuni

Day and night pass by, seasons change, time changes silently, without a moment of rest! Is it true that the creature appears with a long and wide tongue, speaking miraculous Dharma, letting sentient beings realize the impermanence and temporary glory of human life, and quickly find a way to liberation to avoid being condemned to that damnation? You are tired of the smell of wealth, seek to learn the magic, you must try your best to practice, do not choose day by day, because life is only fragile in the breath. You should consider that even though you yourself have the five hindrances, your mind still has the three virtues of Nirvana, try to cleanse your female nature and diligently uphold the holy name of Amitabha. Often think that the Saha world is very filthy and evil, the Ultimate Bliss is the place of home, do not wish for blessings in the present or the next life, only pray when you die to return to Ultimate Bliss. If you are earnest in the morning and evening, each thought is inseparable, your thoughts are matured with effort, and the path will naturally connect with each other, and when you die, you will surely be satisfied. When you return to the Pure Land, you will realize the principle of No Birth, look back at the Saha world, and see the glory and wealth like sunlight, empty flowers, prisons, and poisonous seas! But if you want to achieve your aspiration, it is necessary to first eliminate the habitual infection to easily achieve rebirth. The Buddha Sutra often says: “It is difficult for rich people to learn Dharma, and it is also difficult for women to learn Dharma.”Because rich people are often accustomed to arrogance and luxury, and are less willing to humble themselves to examine themselves and entertain others. So, is it easy to stop worrying, clear away mundane thoughts, and let the heart be empty to seek the Dharma? Women like to be prepared and comfortable, and are often jealous, not knowing that even though the sky is fragrant and watery, it is still a dirty bag of feces; Having fallen in love with illusion, how can one attain enlightenment? Tathagata, in order to cure these diseases, only teaches the practice of contemplation on the Four Foundations of Mindfulness, contemplation of the body as unclean, feelings as suffering, the mind as impermanence and the dharma as non-self. If you can achieve this contemplation, then your heart that is tainted with attachment to the physical body and relying on power and authority will be destroyed like a spot of snow in the middle of a furnace.

Even though you are a virgin woman leaving the home life, you need to get rid of your arrogant and makeup habits, so that not even a single trace remains, then you will be able to escape suffering. Nowadays, the Dharma is weak, foreign demons are rampant, it is difficult to meet good teachers or friends, we must find teachers and friends in the example of the ancients. You should read these books carefully: The Story of the Bhikkhuni, the Story of the Good Woman, the Ten Essentials of Pure Land, the Pure Land of Sages and Sages, have just found bright examples, no longer afraid of straying into the wrong path. Recently, there are few monks and nuns practicing, most of them are disobedient people, they should not abuse their disciples, to avoid confusion in Buddhism. Again, keep yourself according to the rules, try your best to cultivate Pure karma, so that when you live, you will become a model person, when you fall, you will attend the Lien Tri meeting. Only then will we not be disappointed in our will to go beyond the fiery pit, and we will not be a child of the Buddha in vain.

You must resolutely try, don't forget my words!

tieu_de: 38/ Response Poem to Layman Pham Co Nong
tom_tat: The intermediate state is mental consciousness, not the spiritual consciousness transformed into the intermediate body. This is the soul that secular people often call it. The theory that the intermediate body lives and dies once every seven days and after forty-nine days must come first...
noi_dung:
38/ Response Poem to Layman Pham Co Nong

The intermediate state is mental consciousness, not the spiritual consciousness transformed into the intermediate body. This is the soul that secular people often call it. The theory that the intermediate body lives and dies once every seven days and must be reincarnated after forty-nine days, should not be attached to it. Talking about the bardo of life and death is to point out that in the ignorant mind of the other person, the appearance of birth and death appears. Don't be too familiar with the real life and talk about the state of life and death of people in the world.

The birth of an intermediate body in the six realms and three realms can be as quick as the span of a finger, or as long as forty-nine days or more, but it is not certain. Newly deceased souls can appear before familiar people, or talk to each other during the day or at night. It is not only the intermediate body that can be like that, but people who have been reborn in the evil or good realms can sometimes appear for familiar people to see. Although this is the person's idea that appears, in reality the mechanism of change is arranged by the miraculous creator, to show the world: The soul of a dead person is not lost and the retribution for good and evil is not wrong. If it weren't so, then people on earth wouldn't be able to know about the underworld, and therefore blind evil theories would arise, saying that death is loss, there is no cause and effect, in the afterlife, causing good people not to try to cultivate virtue, and evil people to be even more dangerous. So even if there is Buddha's teaching, where can we prove it, and who will believe it? Therefore, these apparitions proved that Buddha's words were not wrong, that cause and effect are real, good people see this and do good things, and evil people are also overcome by that sentiment, not so fiercely. Heaven and earth, demons and gods want people to know this clearly; That's why there are incidents where the dead appear in the earthly world, and the mortals judge punishment in the underworld, to serve the Buddha's Dharma and help the Dharma govern peace. This time is very magical and the relationship is also very great. Many books have written about such things in the past, but they have not clearly stated where the mechanism for this change comes from, and what are the beneficial relationships?

Even though the soul leaves the body, it still has the same attachment to the body as before. Having that attachment, it is necessary to use food and clothing to take care of yourself. The reason for this is because ordinary people have deep karma and do not know that the five aggregates are inherently empty, so they are still no different from other people. If you are a person of great wisdom, you will immediately escape from your physical body and have nothing to rely on, all suffering will be destroyed, the five aggregates will be empty, all virtues will be fully revealed, and your true body will be revealed. The realm of the intermediate state is not certain, so the enjoyment depends on each person's attachment. Like burning paper clothes, for the living, there is only the concept of giving clothes, but the width, narrowness, and length, cannot be suitable for everyone. But due to the attachment between the living and the dead, those clothes still fit as well as usual. This can show us the meaning: “All dharmas are transformed by the mind.”

A person who has died and has not yet been born is reborn in the six realms called the intermediate body. If you are born, you will no longer be an intermediate body, and relying on others to talk about suffering and happiness is all the effect of your consciousness. Reincarnation is due to the harmony between the consciousness and the parents' blood, so when a woman becomes pregnant, the consciousness is already in the fetus. But why is it that sometimes when a mother is in labor, she sees someone entering the house before giving birth? This is the case when the parents have sex, another soul comes to take their place to conceive the child. When the pregnancy is complete, the main soul comes and the replacement soul immediately goes. In the set“Duc Hai Hoi Cuong”The third volume, pages 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 also has this question but the original answer is not reasonable; I ask that for the sake of reform, you should look it up later and it will be clear. Nguyen replied in it gave an example like this: "For example, chicken eggs, some eggs are empty, some eggs are not empty..."At no time does consciousness enter the womb like an empty chicken egg. Because an egg that is not empty is a damaged egg and cannot hatch a child, but in the above case, the mother still gives birth as usual. Now I use reason to justify it, not afraid of making mistakes, so I present it for you. In the past, Mr. Vien Trach's mother was pregnant for three years, perhaps also belonging to the above-mentioned substitution situation. But this is the conventional way of thinking, we must know that the karma of living beings is inconceivable! As a practitioner of Pure Karma has achieved, although the body has not died, the consciousness has appeared in the Pure Land. And the person with heavy evil karma, his body is still lying on a hospital bed but his soul has already suffered punishment in the realm of darkness. So, even though the life has not ended, the consciousness has been reincarnated. Waiting until the moment of birth, the entire consciousness depends on the fetus. This principle is not impossible, but usually, the substitution of conception is still greater.

In the three realms, all dharmas appear in the mind only. Even though sentient beings are ignorant, it is the inconceivable force of karma, the inconceivable force of the mind, and the inconceivable power of all Buddhas. My An Quang, over the past ten years, because my eyesight is weak and I can't see much, I can't extensively cite scriptures to prove it. However, that reason is still true, it is not that I dare to bring up negative opinions to incur guilt. Life and death are big matters for living beings, cause and effect are the great powers in Christianization. I hope that you will not spare any words of criticism, and will once again use cause and effect to help everyone transform the afflictions of birth and death into Bodhi Nirvana. Thus, the Dharma practice and sentient beings are so blessed!!
