tieu_de: 39/ Poetry Advising Newcomers to Study Buddha
tom_tat: 1. I often say: If you want to gain the true benefit of Buddha's teachings, you must look for it in awe. There is one part of respect, one part of sin karma, and one part of blessings and wisdom. There is ten points of respect, ten points of sin karma, ten points more...
noi_dung:
39/ Poetry Advising Newcomers to Study Buddha

1. I often say: If you want to gain the true benefit of Buddha's teachings, you must look for it in awe. There is one part of respect, one part of sin karma, and one part of blessings and wisdom. There are ten parts of respect, ten parts of sin karma, and ten parts of blessings and wisdom. If you don't have the slightest respect, then chanting Buddha's sutras is not completely without benefit, but due to the sin of disrespect, you will have to fall into the three realms many lifetimes ago. When the sins are gone, can we take refuge in that goodness, listen to the Dharma and practice, eat vegetarian, recite the Buddha's name, and pray to the West to escape the path of birth and death? If this life is wholeheartedly devoted, then the present life can rely on the Buddha's grace to bring about karma rebirth. And once you are reborn, you will transcend mortals to Sainthood, escape samsara, stay away from suffering, and only enjoy happy things.

2. People cultivate blessings and create karma, in short, there are only three karmas and six senses. The six bases are: eyes, ears, nose, tongue, body, mind. The previous five senses belong to the body karma, the last one mind sense belongs to the mind, that is, the mind karma. The three karmas are the karma of body, speech, and mind.

The karma body has three: killing, stealing, adultery. These three things are very serious sins, Buddhist students must pay attention to them. Regarding killing: All animals are greedy for life and afraid of death. We should not kill them. If we kill them and eat them, they will cause karma and will have to be killed by them in the next life. So Buddhists should be vegetarian and love life. Regarding theft: No matter how big or small something belongs to others, we should not take it when they don't give it to us. Stealing small things will lose your dignity, stealing large things will harm people's lives. Stealing things may seem beneficial to others, but in reality, you will have your blessings reduced, and you may even lose your life. Compared to what you steal, the loss is much greater. If you use a plan to take it, or use force to take it, or take it secretly, it is all theft. People who steal will inevitably give birth to vagabond children, whereas honest people will give birth to virtuous children. This is a certain cause and effect according to natural logic. Regarding adultery: If they are not their concubines, no matter whether they are rich or poor, they are not allowed to commit adultery together. Adultery is something that goes against human morality, that is, using a human body to act as an animal being. Since this life is like that, in the next life it will be difficult to avoid falling into the animal race. People think it's a shame for a girl to be promiscuous, but don't they think it's any different than a boy's promiscuity? Adulterers are bound to give birth to impure children. Who would want their children to be impure? It's also because you yourself have done it before, your children inherit your own temperament, it will be difficult for them to be pure. Furthermore, not only is it forbidden to commit adultery based on appearance, but there must also be limits on how husband and wife have sex with each other; Otherwise, people will easily decline or die prematurely. It is very difficult for a person who is greedy for housekeeping to give birth to children, even if he is born, it is difficult to become a human being, and even if he becomes a human being, he is still a weak person who cannot achieve anything. The world's love for sex is happiness, not knowing that it's fun for a moment, but suffering for the rest of your life, sometimes even causing harm to your children and grandchildren! If you don't do the above three things, you will have good karma, if you do them, you will have bad karma.

The karma speech has four: lie, elaborate words, double talk, cruel words. Lying is speaking insincere words. If the words are insincere, the heart is also insincere, so the personality is greatly damaged. To speak elaborately is to say frivolous and sentimental words, causing people to give birth to lustful thoughts. Young teenagers who listen to that for a long time, if they don't commit adultery to lose their personality, will also masturbate to harm their body. A person who speaks harmful words like that, even if he does not commit adultery, must fall into the Great Hell, come out of Hell, or become a female among animals. If she were born in the human race, she would be a prostitute. Initially, when she was still young and beautiful, she would not suffer much. Gradually, the venom of her love would erupt, and her suffering would not end. If you have a skillful mouth, why wouldn't you utter evil and elaborate words to cause harm to yourself and others for the sake of someone else? Double talk is provocative talk that teases out the rights and wrongs of both sides. Small things mislead people, big things damage the family and the country. To speak cruelly is to say cruel words like a sword, making people who have difficulty enduring it, causing sadness. If you don't do these four things, you will have good karma, if you do them, you will have bad karma.

Karma has three meanings: greed, anger and ignorance. Lust is for money, land, objects, etc. Everyone wants to return to their place, even though they have much, they still feel little. Anger is: Regardless of whether one is right or wrong, if anyone does not follow their own will, anger arises, even if others use common sense to advise them, they will not listen. Stupidity is not absolutely not knowing anything. It is like someone who reads all the world's books, the words are immediately familiar with the eyes, the mouth opens into poetry, but does not believe in the cause and effect of the three lives and the six realms of samsara, thinking that the dead are lost, there is no afterlife, etc. are all called stupid. Such knowledge damages the country and harms the people more than floods and wild animals. If you don't do these three things, your karma will be good, if you do it, your karma will be bad. A person with three karmas of body, speech, and mind are all good. When chanting sutras and reciting the Buddha's name, the merit is a hundred thousand times greater than a person with three evil karmas.

3. People who study Buddhism need to maintain kindness, speak good words and do good deeds. Maintaining a good heart means not giving rise to evil thoughts that are contrary to reason and harmful to yourself and others. If that thought suddenly arises, shame must immediately arise, causing it to immediately disappear. You must also keep these thoughts: Filial piety, kindness, loyalty, trust, politeness, righteousness, integrity, shame, benefiting people. For good things, whatever your strength can do, you should do it honestly; If you can't do it, you should always think about it. Saying good words means saying words that are beneficial to people and things, not saying mean words just to make people happy is a good word. This is speaking words of advice to children, advising people to do good, avoid evil, keep morality, and strive to practice blessings and wisdom. To do a good deed is to practice filial piety to one's parents, respect one's teacher, be harmonious with brothers, and encourage everyone. And with repentance ceremonies, reciting Buddha's name, chanting sutras, body and mind must be sincerely respectful.

4. People who study Buddhism should not sleep naked or wear shorts at night. Because a Buddhist must always guard his heart as before the Buddha. At mealtimes, you should not overeat. Even if the food is delicious and delicious, you should only eat eight or nine portions. If you eat all ten portions, others will be deprived, and your internal organs will also be injured. The merits and blessings of ordinary people are not many. If you often eat like that, your blessings will decrease. Besides, when you eat too much, your body and mind feel tired. If the food is not digested, you will definitely feel lower. This is very inelegant, a very big sin. Just like the burning of incense at the Buddha Palace is just to represent reverence, considering how much fragrance there is? If you eat too much to get gas under... If the foul smell reaches the Three Jewels, then in the next life you will definitely be punished as a maggot. So if you want to avoid that mistake, it's better to eat in moderation. If you have a weak stomach and have a cold, the food is difficult to digest, and you feel like you want to let out steam, you should step outside, go to an empty place, and wait for the steam to dissipate and go back inside. If there's something you can't get out, you have to use force to compress it, and within seconds the breath will dissipate in your stomach. There are people who think that doing so will cause illness, this advice should not be followed, because if you keep a little bit of hygiene that is not worth it and let it leak under the Buddha's palace, the Sangha's house, the suffering of the sin will be much more severe. In Buddha's precepts, not to mention this, perhaps the ancients had healthy bodies, were not greedy for food, and did not have such rude things, so Buddha did not say it. If there was, Buddha would have said it! So don't think that the Buddha did not impose precepts to prohibit that, but allowed it to be done at will. To do so would be to bring on self-destruction. If Buddha wanted to save him, he wouldn't know what to do? In ancient times, Confucius took the position of a Saint to visit the king. When he was still on the steps and about to enter the court, he held his breath, let alone when facing the king? Therefore, the book Analects says: "So he walked up to the temple, his body bent down, his breath was light as if he couldn't breathe."We are ordinary people full of karma, while we are in the Buddha's palace, a god among heavens, a Saint among Saints, a place full of the Three Jewels, but we do not let our minds restrain us, letting out the stinking breath below, how big is that sin? Please don't think that what I say here is inelegant, I have no qualms about being inelegant, I'm just afraid that those who are rude and mistakenly cause the fall to become maggots.

5. People who study Buddhism, when they wake up early in the morning and after defecating and urinating, must wash their hands. When you use your hands to scratch your body, rub your feet, and touch other unclean places, you must also wash them. Even if it's a hot month, you should not freely unbutton your shirt to expose your breasts or lift your pants to expose your calves. Casually coughing up phlegm and blowing your nose is a very bad thing. Not only in the Buddha hall or Sangha hall, one should not spit happily, but outside the hall on clean ground one should also not do so, because spitting on clean ground will immediately show a dirty appearance. There are people who are rude and unscrupulous. They happily spit indiscriminately in the room, on the ground, on the walls, so there is phlegm everywhere in the house. That person thinks that spitting phlegm clears stagnation and removes impurities, but does not know that if he spits like that every day, all the essence of food and drink will turn into phlegm, leading to illness after many days. If there is anything pure in the human body, it is better to swallow it, after a long time there will be no more phlegm. This is a very magical method of using phlegm to eliminate phlegm. If you can't swallow, you should spit into a handkerchief and do it carefully so that no one sees it. But this is also laborious and unclean, it is better than swallowing it, it is not laborious and does not show the filth; Moreover, it also cures phlegm. Some of the above things seem not worth mentioning, some people think they are small and don't pay much attention. But those who study Buddha must maintain proper etiquette and be afraid of sin. Otherwise, they will become rude and rude people. Blessings in this life will reduce their sins more, and in the next life they will be doomed to fall.

6. People who study Buddhism must pay attention to every move. While reciting the Buddha's name, you need to be sincere. If at times you see a feeling of compassion arising in your heart, it is a sign of good roots being discovered. However, we also need to be cautious, do not let the source of ordinary compassion reveal itself, otherwise it will inevitably be possessed by the ghost of compassion. Whenever something pleases you, you should not be too happy. If you are too happy, you will be possessed by the demon of joy. When reciting Buddha, the eyelids must droop and should not be too spiritual, causing the heart to flare up. When you feel a tingling and tingling sensation on the top of your head, it is a phenomenon of using a lot of mental concentration, which needs to be moderated. When reciting out loud, you should not use too much force to avoid getting sick. Reciting the rosary can eliminate laziness, but when sitting still, you should not pray. If you repeat it, your hands will move and your mind will feel tired and uneasy, and over time you will definitely get sick.

7. People who study Buddhism, when reading the sutras and books, should not be too hasty. Being in a hurry will cause mental confusion and make it difficult to understand the meaning. Nowadays, many people who are a little intelligent, when they receive a set of scriptures, immediately forget to eat or sleep and read it all at once. After the second time, I was no longer interested in watching it, even if I watched it, I felt lethargic. It is difficult for this type of person to accomplish anything, so we must try to guard against it. Mr. To Dong Pha said: “Old books don't get boring after reading them a hundred times. Read carefully and understand the deep meaning!” Confucius was a Saint, and he also read the I Ching so many times that the string of the book was worn out three times. With qualities like His, the text is immediately familiar at a glance. Why do we need to look at the text to read? You should know that reading the text is very good, because reciting it is mostly oral proficiency. Reading the text makes it easy to know the interesting meaning of each word and each sentence. So let's take that as an example, don't pretend to recite by heart to show that you're smart and remember well...

---o0o---

tieu_de: 40/ Response Poem to Layman Chau Tung Nghieu (Phu Nguyen Tho)
tom_tat: The disciple who has been a vegetarian and chanted Buddha's name for many years has heard teachings that: Those who believe in Buddha will be protected by all Buddhas in the ten directions and three generations. The Heavenly Dragons of the Bat-Buddha and the Great Power God King will often follow and protect the evil karma of previous lives...
noi_dung:
40/ Response Poem to Layman Chau Tung Nghieu (Phu Nguyen Tho)

Now I have a question, I ask the Compassionate Dharma Master to answer:

The disciple who has been a vegetarian and chanted Buddha's name for many years has heard teachings that: Those who believe in Buddha will be protected by all Buddhas in the ten directions and three generations. The Heavenly Dragons of the Eight Bodhisattvas and the Great Power Divine Kings will often follow and protect them. The evil karma of previous lives will gradually be eliminated. Even if there is an unjust confrontation, they will not be able to harm them. The above things are based on the Buddha Sutra and are definitely not empty words. But around this March, I received news from a relative from Shanghai, which made me extremely surprised! According to that news: Ms. Truong Thai Thai is a person who believes in Buddha very much, has been a vegetarian for more than twenty years, and often comes to Lay Si Lam to listen to Dharma lectures. She is kind and virtuous, loves to do good, and advises everyone she meets to eat vegetarian and recite Buddha's name. Unexpectedly, one day while walking on the road to bring vegetarian food to a monk, she was run over and killed by a car. At that time, because no one was looking, the patrol officer took it away. It was not until three days later that the descendants heard about it and asked to take it back for burial. When the disciple heard that news, he was extremely surprised and still had doubts and did not understand. If people in the Buddhist Association heard about this, they would certainly be shocked and uneasy. Therefore, the disciple presented this letter, begging the old Master to teach and explain clearly the reason why Mrs. Truong suffered such a tragic death. And in the end, will she be reborn to the West?

Please, old Dharma Master, give clear instructions so that many people can rest assured and recite Buddha's name. The disciple's gratitude is endless!

After receiving the poem, I know that you still do not understand the Buddha's teachings clearly. From beginningless time until now, we have created limitless and boundless evil karma! Avatamsaka Sutra says: “Suppose evil karma has a form, the emptiness of the ten directions cannot contain it all.”You should know that the practice of the practitioner, if the results are sincere and not false, then you can turn heavy and late retribution into present retribution and light retribution. Ordinary people only see the bad luck in front of their eyes, they do not know the cause and effect in previous and future lives.

That woman named Truong practiced diligently for many years, but one day she died miserably, or because of that suffering, she was able to eliminate the three evil retributions and be reborn in the Heavenly realm. If in this life she believes deeply and vows, she can also be born in the West. But we don't have the eyes of others, so we don't dare to speculate whether she will be reborn or not? What can be decided is: Doing good will bring good results, doing evil will bring evil. If you do good and receive bad results, that is the karma of evil karma in the previous life, not the karma of good karma in this life. When you see the old woman suffering such a miserable death, you mistakenly think that good deeds are not worth doing, because doing good does not receive blessings, so you are afraid and suspicious. Is that perception any different from someone who has not heard and understood Buddha's teachings? If you firmly believe Buddha's words, you will not show shock or horror because of that. Because cause and effect do not overlap, sometimes one cause has not yet been paid, the other has already ripened, for example, if you sow seeds early, you will reap early, or if you owe a debt, the strong creditor will pull you in first.

In ancient times, there was a person who did good things in his life, but when he was about to die, he died miserably to repay his previous karma, and in his next life he would be rich and glorious. During the Song Dynasty, a monk at A Duc Vuong Pagoda wanted to restore the Xa Loi temple tower, thinking that Can Than Vuong had power, so he came to donate the tomb. Unexpectedly, the amount of money raised was not much and his wish was not fulfilled. The monk was sad and used a hammer to cut off his hand in front of Xa Loi temple. He bled profusely and died. At the same time, Can Than Vuong gave birth to a child. From the moment he was born, the baby often cried endlessly. The nanny carried him out to play. When he got to the place where the map to build the Xa Loi tower was hung, the baby did not cry, she carried him around and cried loudly. The nanny didn't know what to do, so she took down the map and often held it in front of the baby. From then on the baby stopped crying. Hearing this story, Vuong was surprised and immediately sent someone to A Duc Pagoda to ask about the monk from before. Only then did he find out that he cut off his hand and died on the day his son was born. Because of that fate, Than Vuong alone stood up to repair the Xa Loi palace. When that child was twenty years old, at the time of King Ninh Tong's death, there was no crown prince to succeed him, so the decree established Can Than Vuong's son as king. The boy later became Emperor for forty-one years, that is, King Ly Tong of the Song Dynasty.

The monk's death was also a tragic death. If there had not been endless crying and when seeing the map of the Xa Loi tower, he would have remained silent, who would have known that the baby was the reincarnation of the monk who died miserably? This story is recorded in the book A Duc Vuong Son Chi, but in the twenty-first year of Quang Tu, when I went to pay homage to the Xa Loi tower for a few dozen days, I saw it. People who understand reason, no matter what their circumstances, are determined not to suspect that cause and effect is wrong or that the Buddha's words are false. People who don't understand reason, cling to a framework, don't know there are complex causes and effects, so they have doubts, which can all be traced to not having the right view. As you said: Those who recite Buddha's name have the Three Jewels' blessings and dragon heaven's protection. That is a certain reason that cannot be mistaken. But regarding the conversion of heavy retribution in the next life to light retribution in this life, you still do not know clearly, so you cannot help but have unreasonable doubts and discussions. In the past, in Tay Vuc, Gioi Hien Luan Su was a highly virtuous man for a time, and rumors spread throughout the four lands of Thien Truc. Due to lack of karma, the Commentator suffered from a terrible illness, was in immense pain, could not bear it, and was about to commit suicide. Just that night, the Commentator dreamed of three Bodhisattvas: Manjushri, Samantabhadra, Avalokitesvara came and said: “In your previous life, you were a king for many lifetimes. Because you harmed living beings, you will have to fall into evil paths for a long time. But because in this life you have merit in propagating Buddha Dharma, you should return to endure small sufferings in the human world to eliminate the great sufferings of many lifetimes in Hell. So try to be patient, don't be sad and think about anything else. In three years, in the land of Dai Tang, there will be a monk named Xuanzang who will come here to receive Dharma with you."After hearing it, Master Gioi Hien tried to endure the pain of repentance for a long time, and his illness gradually improved. Three years later, Huyen Trang came to Na Lan Da pagoda. Gioi Cong told his disciples to tell him about his illness. The narrator himself choked up and shed tears. That's enough to know how much suffering it is! If the three Bodhisattvas did not clearly state their past lives, people would say that Gioi Hien was not a highly moral monk. Or some people say: If a great practitioner still suffers from such a tragic illness, how effective is the Buddha's teaching?

In short, your understanding is still limited, so when you see something slightly different, you immediately become suspicious. Such behavior can cause people with few good roots to lose their spirituality. If you see people doing evil and receiving blessings in this life, you will probably also have similar misunderstandings. You should know that it is nothing more than the transformation of complex layers of causes and consequences that are not the same, to change the heavy fruit in the next life to a light one in the present, or to change the light fruit of the present into a heavy fruit in the next life.

---o0o---

tieu_de: 41/ Poem Responding to Layman Duong Duc Quan
tom_tat: Regarding Hoang Hau Giac, that phenomenon is very beneficial for Buddhist students. Let us put aside the outcome of your rebirth or your downfall; If the person reciting Buddha knew about his phenomenon at the time of his death,...
noi_dung:
41/ Poem Responding to Layman Duong Duc Quan

Regarding Hoang Hau Giac, that phenomenon is very beneficial for Buddhist students. Let us put aside the outcome of your rebirth or your downfall; If the person who recites the Buddha's name knows about his phenomenon at the time of his death, he will definitely not dare to be indifferent to the path of liberation.

Looking at his achievements, he seems to be a sincere person. But looking at the scene that appeared at his deathbed, we can see that in normal times he had not really put any effort into his practice. That phenomenon is mostly caused by the karma of being stingy with money or wrong words that harm people's lives. (Sparing words that harm people's lives is like knowing that there is an enemy there and knowing that there is another place where we can escape, but because we don't have compassion and like to see people bring disaster, we refuse to say anything. That behavior touched the anger of the demons and gods, causing the scene to appear at the time of death: Can't speak and hates hearing Buddha chanting). Furthermore, the manifestation of the appearance of a few hours of struggling and refusing to die, waiting until the people who helped recite the chant left, and not long after dying, is completely consistent with the karma scene of a person who wastes money and uses wrong words to harm people's lives. That state proves that even if it does not fall into the category of Hungry Ghosts, it is still a part of Hungry Ghosts. Someone based on the power of chanting by layman Diec Tu Tuan said that Mr. Giac was reborn, but in my opinion: Although the power of mantra is inconceivable, if the karma force is heavy, it will not be easy to get benefits. If Mr. Giac was reborn, there must have been some other form to confirm it, so we should not speculate wrongly. Some people asserted that he had fallen into the path of Hungry Ghosts. According to Mr. Giac's phenomenon, what he said later seems to have some basis. But either thanks to his sincere descendants and lay people supporting his recitation, or because of his own repentance in his heart, his crime may be reduced, not to the point of immediately falling into the realm of Hungry Ghosts.

At present, it is worth doing for the children and relatives of the deceased to think of the suffering of the deceased, to take advantage of themselves and others instead of the dead, to recite Buddha's name, and to pray for Buddha's mercy to guide rebirth. If the heart is sincere to the end, rebirth can be predicted, because father and son are related to each other, and the Buddha's mind immediately responds. If a relative is careless and careless in getting things done, the karma of the deceased cannot be eliminated and it is difficult to hope to be welcomed. This relationship is extraordinary because a mistake can lead thousands of miles.

The above incident reminds us that the person who recites the Buddha's name must sincerely correct his evil nature, and must use means to help others. Things that are worth saying, even if someone has grudges against us, should still be said for them, causing that person to receive blessings from disaster, freedom from suffering and happiness. In normal times, we must insist on doing samsara cause and effect for others, reciting Buddha's rebirth. You should also educate your children, because it lays a solid foundation for peace. We must ensure that our words are not ambiguous, our mind is like a straight bowstring, our actions are not contrary to the heavens, and our heart can show off to the gods and demons. If we do that, then when we are about to die, there will definitely not be that pitiful phenomenon. And so, Hoang Hau Giac is the teacher who advises those who recite Buddha's name; Thanks to him, you will receive great benefits in the future, and thanks to him, you will be freed from all sins and be born into Ultimate Bliss. An Quang, I say this is not a fluff, it is an unchangeable law. If anyone does not think it is right, please consult with a highly intelligent Dharma Master, or consult with a great Saint...

---o0o---

tieu_de: 42/ Poems Responding to Lay Buddhists Buddha Dictionary
tom_tat: The dark shadows, according to lay people, are not the shadows of all Buddhas, Bodhisattva, nor are they the image of the unjust person confronting them. Because if Buddha or Bodhisattva appear, they must clearly show their faces; And if he is an unjust person, he will...
noi_dung:
42/ Poems Responding to Lay Buddhists Buddha Dictionary

Receiving poetry and knowing that lay people recite diligently, makes my heart very happy!

The dark shadows, according to lay people, are not the shadows of all Buddhas, Bodhisattva, nor are they the image of the unjust person confronting them. Because if Buddha or Bodhisattva appear, they must clearly show their faces; If it is an unjust person, it will appear terrifying and terrifying. Those shadows are probably predestined souls from previous lives, wanting to rely on the power of chanting Buddha sutras of lay people to be reborn in a peaceful realm. So after the session of reciting dedicating merits, lay people should always pray for those ghosts to eliminate evil karma and increase good roots, thanks to the power of Buddha's rebirth to the West. That way, the other ghosts will benefit and won't have to suffer in vain.

People who practice their mind must have mastery. When they see a bad realm, they should not be afraid, and when they see a good realm, they should not be happy. If so, the realms experienced are all wonderful conditions that support enlightenment. If the mind is not intentional, all scenes are obstacles. Again, practitioners must take sincere reverence as the root, compassion and humility as their heart. Thus, even if the mind's conduct is not completely compatible with the Buddha's, it is not contrary to the Buddha's conduct. One can be called a true practitioner, a disciple of the Buddha.

---o0o---

tieu_de: 43/ Response Poem for Layman Hoang Tung Binh
tom_tat: Illness is born from the body, the body is born from karma. If you want the disease to heal quickly, you should earnestly repentance to eliminate all karma. With prevention, we must also restrain ourselves so that the disease will not increase. Regardless of the disease, if not treated...
noi_dung:
43/ Response Poem for Layman Hoang Tung Binh

Illness is born from the body, the body is born from karma. If you want the disease to heal quickly, you should earnestly repentance to eliminate all karma. With prevention, we must also restrain ourselves so that the disease will not increase. No matter what the disease is, if you do not prevent marital infidelity, of course it will be difficult to be cured.

There are many pagans, there are hundreds of thousands of sects, but their methods of practice are no more than luck and practice. Even if non-Buddhist people tell people to recite Buddha's prayers, it is only an external thing, and they themselves do not consider it to be religion. When preaching, pagans often choose at night, close the doors and windows, send people outside to patrol, only allowing one person to receive the teachings into the room. Before being initiated, the initiate must take a very cruel and cruel oath. If anyone goes against their teachings, they will have to suffer the consequences of that oath. After taking the oath, they only apply acupuncture points on the head, face, or body. The acupuncture points on the body need to be undressed to point. Doing something like that is really a trick to mesmerize people. They added that once passed, even if you don't practice, you can still attain results. Suppose we completely abolish the secret informing and swearing oaths, and instead announce them clearly for everyone to freely choose, we would no longer have a solid basis. In Buddha Dharma, there is no secret transmission between each other, nor does it teach people to make cruel oaths. Those who believe can follow it, those who don't believe can stop.

You have recited the Buddha's name but are still afraid of straying into paganism. That's because you don't clearly distinguish between the two sides, you only imitate those who develop faith, in fact you don't have true faith. If you have true faith, then just try your best to practice. Why do you need to worry about the large number of pagans and fear of going astray? You have admitted that you have too much karma so you have a serious illness, so you need to fast and recite Buddha's name and do deliverance for the injustices of previous generations. Speaking of transcendence, there is no need to invite the Sangha to do Buddhist work, just sincerely recite Buddha's name and Avalokitesvara by yourself. You should not think that; Just chanting a Buddha, a Bodhisattva, I'm afraid I won't be cured. You should know that reciting the Buddha's name is a very complete and quick dharma in the Buddha dharma, its benefits surpass all dharma methods. If there is a difference, it is due to our minds being sincere and not being sincere, not whether the dharma is effective or not effective.

---o0o---

tieu_de: 44/ Response Poem to Layman Trach Pham
tom_tat: When giving birth, women should recite Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva's name, because Avalokitesvara's heart to save suffering is very considerate. At that time, you should chant loudly, you should not chant silently, because the power of silent chanting is weak and the understanding is also weak. Furthermore, in…
noi_dung:
44/ Response Poem to Layman Trach Pham

When giving birth, women should recite Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva's name, because Avalokitesvara's heart to save suffering is very considerate. At that time, you should chant loudly, you should not chant silently, because the power of silent chanting is weak and the understanding is also weak. Moreover, while using force to force the child out, if you recite it silently, you will definitely lose your breath and get sick. Not only does the pregnant woman herself chant loudly, but those helping in the delivery room also chant loudly. And even though relatives stay at home, they still have to pray for the pregnant woman's name Bodhisattva.

It is highly undesirable to assume that: When giving birth naked and unclean, the thought of fear is sinful. You should know that although reason is fixed, things must depend on chance. You should only reason based on things. You should not focus on the side of reason for discussion. For example, when a child falls into a cesspool or into water or fire and calls for help from his parents, the parents immediately run to pull him out, never worrying that their child's body is not clean, his clothes are not neat, and they refuse to save him and let him die. Bodhisattva's compassion is thousands of times more profound than a parent's compassion for his or her child. While living beings are suffering and asking for help, Bodhisattva only has the thought of saving suffering, and has absolutely no thoughts of comparing the body. Besides, of course birth must be like that, when it is related to the vitality, not in the case of being able to show respect and cleanliness, so why still accept cleanliness and cleanliness? If you can do it but don't do it, it's a sin. On the contrary, in a situation where one cannot show respect, one should only focus on the direction and sincerity in the heart, and should not cling to rituals and ceremonies based on image. Bodhisattva has no suffering that cannot be saved, no accident that cannot help or mercifully help, is there any reason for pregnant women to be overlooked? Even though the sutras do not say this clearly, we must still follow the logic of understanding the mind to save suffering, to end the great suffering of human beings, and satisfy Bodhisattva's compassion. What's more, in the Medicine Buddha Sutra, Buddha once told women to recite the name of Medicine Buddha Tathagata during childbirth? That sutra text says: “Or there is a woman who is suffering a lot while giving birth. If she can wholeheartedly bow and praise and respectfully make offerings to the Tathagata (saying her name, the pregnant woman can do it, but bowing and respectfully praising making offerings belongs to relatives who do it on her behalf), then all the suffering will be eliminated. The child was born with a complete body, good appearance, good intelligence, good health, few illnesses, everyone who saw it was happy, the mother was not robbed of her essence by non-human beings..."Then we know that when giving birth and reciting the Buddha's name, Bodhisattva is not only not guilty, but mother and child are safe, has planted good roots, and has great benefits. Reciting Buddha Medicine Buddha is like that, so is reciting Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva. If pregnant women receive the above benefits, then others can infer that they can know.

In Hunan province, layperson Ma Shunqing and his wife and their five children are all my refuge disciples. In the 18th year of the Republic of China, Ma sent me a letter saying: His wife gave birth to five daughters. The first two times she gave birth safely, but the third time she was bleeding; The fourth and fifth times, even more. Now the wife is about to give birth. It seems like there is bleeding. It will probably be difficult for her to live. She begged me to show her the method of salvation and for the sake of the still-born child to give her a Dharma name. I immediately told my husband and I to sincerely recite Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva. Even if we give birth naked and unclean, we should still recite it, and we should recite it out loud and not silently. When I sent the letter, the husband and wife read it and obeyed. The next day, the wife gave birth. She still recited it while giving birth. In the end, mother and child were both healthy and peaceful. After his wife gave birth, Ma immediately replied to let me know; good results beyond the intention, Bodhisattva is truly a great and compassionate being.

Again, a refuge disciple of mine, a few years ago in Sichuan province, while visiting a friend, heard a woman in the house crying sadly, so he asked the reason. The friend confessed that his wife was in labor and wanted to give birth for two days but could not give birth, afraid that she would have difficulty living. My disciple said: "I advise you to quickly recite the Holy Name of Avalokitesvara, and I must set up a table in front of the house, burn incense and kneel to pray to the Bodhisattva for salvation."My best friend obeyed my words. As a result, at the moment his wife gave birth, he did not know that he had given birth until he heard the baby cry. After that, the pregnant woman reported: “When I wanted to give birth, I saw someone using a cloth to tighten my lower body so I couldn't give birth. When I recited the holy name of Avalokitesvara, I saw the cloth fall off, and the baby did not know when it was born."

Then you know, when a woman gives birth, reciting Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva is extremely beneficial. Because at that time, either because she was already sick, or because of the injustice of her previous family's assassination, the pregnant woman was in a situation of death and rebirth; If we do not earnestly pray for Bodhisattva's salvation, it will be difficult for mother and child to be safe. An Quang I, from the fall of the 15th year of the Republic of China onwards, when the Tang Quan Van Sao had already printed it, no matter what the text was, I did not keep the manuscript to avoid wasting money on printing costs. Recently, because I know clearly the worst attachment of women during childbirth, I often tell everyone about this harmful thing, hoping that it will be passed on to each other, to save the suffering and lives of pregnant women and their children. If anyone doesn't judge and thinks that I like to talk about women giving birth, I personally don't mind anything, I just hope that everyone will have righteous faith, abandon stubbornness, and be free from disaster.

---o0o---

45/ Answers to 20 Questions of Layman Khuc Thien Duong

1. Ask:The disciple believes in Buddhism, the reason being the study of hypnosis. A long time ago, a disciple heard a profane saying: “Cultivate heaven for nine lifetimes, cultivate Buddha for ten lifetimes”, always thinking that ten lifetimes is too long, and I'm afraid I'll miss out halfway and waste my previous efforts. If you had known early on that reciting the Buddha would bring liberation to your life, then you would have practiced it a long time ago. Looking back now, I am twenty-seven years old, thinking about how late I am!

Answer:That proverb is said wrongly by people who do not understand Buddhism. People who understand Buddhism never utter those words. Reciting the Buddha's name for a lifetime of liberation is due to deep faith and sincere vows, the decision to pray for rebirth in the West at the time of death, and thanks to the Buddha's power to guide him to the throne of Non-return. If it weren't for the Buddha's power to escape birth and death, I'm afraid it wouldn't be possible for thousands of lifetimes, let alone ten lifetimes!

2. Ask: According to what the disciple believes and understands: "If you have a pure mind, you will become a Buddha", just like people who learn hypnosis must first be calm and then have unthinkable phenomena?

Answer: Using a pure mind to recite the Buddha's name and visualize the Buddha, it is easy to be in harmony with the Buddha. If you add true faith and prayer to it, you will definitely be reborn, and then gradually practice until you become Buddha. Don't misunderstand that if you purify your mind in this life, you will immediately become a Buddha.

3. Ask:Regarding the reliance on Buddha's power, according to the disciple's understanding; Just as a hypnotist hypnotizes himself, it is more difficult to hypnotize others. Isn't that the same as self-reliance?

Answer:All other dharmas rely on one's own strength to stop or attain enlightenment, like a crippled person walking on his own, having difficulty walking a hundred miles each day. The Pure Land Dharma method relies on the power of Buddha's magnetism, so it can cause karma rebirth, like the cripple who relied on the wheel of the Holy King's wheel of rotation, and in one day traveled all over the four continents of the world. Using hypnosis as a comparison proves to be very unreasonable.

4. Ask: The mouth chants Buddha, the mind thinks Buddha, is that thought the same as the eighth method of contemplation in the Contemplation Sutra?

Answer:We should only earnestly remember Buddha. As for contemplation, you should follow the thirteenth method of contemplation and use effort. But the Buddha scene is subtle, the ordinary mind is coarse, fear of contemplation is difficult to achieve, sometimes using the mind incorrectly, demonic deeds arise.

5. Ask: In times of danger, it is impossible to recite mantras at once, so what method should be used?

Answer: If you encounter a very serious accident, you should only recite the holy name Avalokitesvara. This saves a lot of effort and the response is very quick.

6. Ask:Specializing in chanting Buddha's name, how is its effectiveness compared to reciting mantras?

Answer:Buddha's name and uncle's merit are the same, only one needs to be sincere to be appreciated. If in your mind you have a thought that despises the Buddha's name, you will certainly not get real benefit. That mistake is due to lack of enthusiasm and doubt.

7. Ask:Amitabha Buddha's self-nature, the idealistic Pure Land along with the pure land and Buddha in the West are two or one?

Answer:Only the idealistic Pure Land was born in the Western Pure Land. If your mind is not pure, you cannot be reborn. Even if an evil sinner uses ten thoughts to be reborn, it is still necessary to purify the Buddha's mind to be reborn in the pure land of the West. Most people think that: Being idealistic is not Pure Land. That is the understanding of foreign demons. This wrong view of right and wrong accounts for more than half, causing people to recite Buddha's name not being truly beneficial.

Because of Amitabha's own nature, practitioners need to recite Buddha Amitabha's name in the West to pray for rebirth, in order to gradually cultivate themselves and realize Buddha Amitabha's self-nature. If we only accept Buddha Amitabha's self-nature without reciting Amitabha Buddha in the West, even if we gain true enlightenment, we will not be able to immediately escape the path of birth and death, not to mention that the people who utter those words are mostly empty talkers?

Coming to the issue of homogeneity: One but two is before he has become a Buddha, two but one is after he has become a Buddha.

8. Ask:Sentence"When you are born, you decide to be born; when you return, you really don't return."What do you mean?

Answer: “When you are born, you decide to be born.”is to talk about the fact that "when you return, you really won't return" is to talk about the truth. But, those who do not understand the reason, should only follow the appearance and recite Buddha's name until they are mature. Otherwise, it will be the fault of foreign demons.

9. Ask:Someone recited Buddha's name when he was about to die and suddenly said: “Pure Land is in the corner of the front yard.”So is this realm the Pure Land?

Answer:That is the scene of discovery of Pure Land's idealism. But the other person's idealistic Pure Land is that person's own realm, everything else is impure idealism. So we shouldn't make decisions based on one's own view.

10. Ask:Is chanting sutras to make you happy according to the religion, bored with the worldly things, or have some other effect?

Answer:You chanting sutras only wish for your own happiness. It's a pity that the boundless and mysterious meaning is considered by you as not worth a single coin!

11. Ask: “Understanding the first meaning”What do you mean?

Answer:“Understanding the first meaning is to clearly understand the truth of true nature, the idealistic self-nature.

12. Ask:The Buddha taught that contemplation is to establish teachings for sentient beings who are suffering from the oppression of the five defilements in the future. If he follows the theory of discovering supernatural vision through hypnosis, then wanting to see the realm of Ultimate Bliss is not a difficult task. So hypnosis is also an essential part of Buddha recitation. Why do many people say that contemplation is difficult and do not want to advise people to practice?

Answer:Hypnosis is just a small power of magic, isn't it true heavenly vision? Those who truly have heavenly eyes wouldn't be willing to hypnotize someone? Now that you have studied Buddha, you should only concentrate on studying Buddha. If you want to manifest the realm of Ultimate Bliss, you should only have a pure mind and you will see it in a single thought. For example, cleaning a mirror, wiping it for extreme natural luminescence. If you use hypnosis to want to manifest, then your mind is not pure and your thoughts are not unified. For example, if you apply white powder on a mirror to get light, it will unexpectedly make the mirror darker.

13. Ask:Practicing contemplation of the dharma is contemplation, visualization, or even visualization. And should the visualization take a near or far scene?

Answer:The two words contemplation should not be divided into two, taking the mind and thinking is contemplation. You think it's two, but you only know one ten and not two five. Again, when contemplating, we should not differentiate between near and far!

14. Ask:Initially, when practicing contemplation, should one single-mindedly think of the sun or should one wear reciting the name?

Answer:The shop and reciting the name are still the same thing. Do you think that when contemplating, you cannot reciting the name and should not reciting the name?

15. Ask:When sitting, practice contemplation, and at other times, recite the name. Such simultaneous practice compared to the practice of one dharma, which is better or worse?

Answer:Pure, calm minds that want to meditate or specialize in contemplation or reciting the name are also good. If not, then specializing in reciting the name is somewhat more peaceful, because people's hearts are filled with excitement and contemplation will inevitably give rise to many demonic obstacles.

16. Ask:When you visualize the realm of Ultimate Bliss, is it a real scene or a fake phenomenon?

Answer:Visualize and see the realm of Ultimate Bliss as an ideal appearing. If you think it's fake, that's the person outside the door.

17. Ask:Contemplating the realm of Ultimate Bliss and being able to hear the Dharma, is that the power of the heavenly eye and the divine ear?

Answer:That is caused by the power of contemplation. If the celestial eyes and ears are not contemplative, they can still see and hear.

18. Ask:Someone said: “Seeing the Buddha is the Buddha of the mind, not the Buddha of the West.”So at rebirth, did the Buddha appear from his own mind or did Amitabha come to guide him?

Answer:When you see the Buddha when you are about to die, it is because of your own mind. You should not bring it back to your own mind and assume that there is no Western Buddha to take you there.

19. Ask:The rebirth of the higher level does not seem to be the rebirth of a cultivator. I wonder what the rebirth of a practitioner is like?

Answer:There are thousands of differences in the quality of rebirth. In the sutras, only nine classes are used to include photography. Why do you guess that the High Rank is not the reincarnation of a monk? You should know that the nature of living beings is not the same, just like in a practice, there are high and low differences. So we should not insist on discussing the dharma side alone, because it depends on each person's mental strength. Like Manjushri and Samantabhadra, do you think those two do not use contemplation?

20. Ask:The Dharma records the number of chanting Buddha, breathing in six sentences, breathing out four sentences, is that true? Having signed a number and chanting Buddha's name, should we still think of Buddha?

Answer:Reciting Buddha's Number is from one to three, from four to six, from seven to ten, where is it prescribed to the breath? You are a person who studies the magic of refining one's fortune, so as soon as you see one or two words similar to that magic, you immediately assume it is the other party's effort. The Buddha's Recitation Dharma was created for those who have difficulty stopping their delusions. If you can recite, remember and hear clearly like that, your mind will gradually be controlled. Who gave you two more words in there?“thinking of Buddha”in? This is still arbitrary mindfulness, should not be based on breathing. If you breathe in and out for too long, you will suffer from bad breath. This needs to be paid attention to and understood.

noi_dung:
46/ An Everywhere Response Letter

(Although the text is authentic, the meaning is still based on the scriptures. If anyone follows this and does it, the benefits will be immense! - An Quang Mage)

1. The Pure Land Dharma, covering all three senses, including the collection of all benefits, is the great Dharma of the Tathagata, to open the means for all Holy mortals to liberate life and death, to ascend to the throne of Non-return right in this life. If you don't believe in this special miraculous dharma and don't practice it, it's really pitiful and unfortunate!!

Pure Land Dharma practice takes faith, vows, and conduct as its guiding principles.

Faith means we must believe that the Saha world has immeasurable suffering; believe that the realm of Ultimate Bliss has countless joys; believe that we are ordinary people full of karma, determined not to rely on our own strength to stop or realize the truth, escape birth and death right in this life; believe that Amitabha Buddha has a vast oath, if any sentient being recites His name and prays to His kingdom, when they die, He will lead them to rebirth Ultimate Bliss.

I pray that I should quickly leave this world, and pray to be born in that happy land soon.

The virtue is that we must sincerely and earnestly recite Namo Amitabha Buddha, at every moment and every moment, do not forget it temporarily, depending on urgent circumstances, set up a course, morning and night, worship and recite in front of the Buddha's table. In addition to the chanting session, when walking, standing, lying, sitting and doing mindless work, you should recite Buddha's name. When sleeping, you must recite silently, do not make a sound, and only recite the four words Amitabha Buddha to easily gain concentration. Furthermore, whenever the clothes are not neat, or when washing, bathing, urinating, or even when passing by an unclean place, you must recite it silently. If you recite silently, merit is the same as reciting out loud. During those times, if you recite it out loud, it is not according to etiquette and you are guilty of not being respectful. Don't talk loudly or softly, chant Vajra or silently, you must remember it clearly and clearly in your mind, recite clearly and clearly with your mouth, and listen clearly and clearly with your two ears. By reciting like that, the mind will no longer wander after external scenes, false thoughts will gradually stop, reciting Buddha will gradually become pure, and the merit will be very great.

2. People who recite Buddha's name must be filial and nurturing to their parents, worship their elders, have a compassionate heart and not kill, and practice the ten good karma (the body must not kill, steal, or commit adultery; The mouth does not lie, embellish words, double talk, or cruel words; The mind is free from greed, anger, ignorance, and wrong views). Again need to: Good father, good son, respectful brothers, harmonious husband and wife, loyal master and servant, each one keeps his duty. We should only do our own duty, and not worry about blaming others on whether we are fulfilling or not. If a person fulfills his or her vocation to the family and society, that person is a good person. A good person who recites the Buddha's name will easily have the opportunity to feel inspired and decide when he dies that the Buddha will take him to the West because his mind is in harmony with the Buddha. On the contrary, those who recite the Buddha's words with their mouths, but their hearts are not infected with the Buddha's teachings, and those who do not fulfill their duties towards their parents, siblings, spouses, children, and friends in the village will have a mental attitude contrary to the Buddha's and will be difficult to be reborn. Why? Because that person's mind is not calm and pure, it creates worries and obstacles, so it is difficult to sympathize with the Buddha, that is also natural.

3. People who recite Buddha should advise their relatives and all fellow human beings to recite Namo Amitabha Buddha and Namo Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva. (Every day, if you recite Buddha's name 1,000 times, recite Avalokitesvara 500 times. If you recite Buddha's name 10,000 times, recite Avalokitesvara 5,000 times. Reciting more or less than following this will increase and decrease). We have found a peaceful path to liberation, but how can we let our ancestors, relatives and all fellow human beings lose great benefits and sink into the sea of ​​suffering? What's more, in the midst of many hardships in this world, it is difficult to avoid dangers like today. If you can often recite Buddha's name and Avalokitesvara, you will definitely be supported by compassion, and evil will turn into good. Even if there is no accident, if you sincerely recite it, you will receive karma, wisdom and wisdom, and many blessings. Furthermore, it is advised that people who recite the Buddha's name seek rebirth in the West, that is, to achieve ordinary people to become Buddhas, the merit is very great, dedicating that merit to rebirth will surely satisfy them.

4. People who chant Buddha's name when chanting sutras, reciting mantras, worshiping, repentance, saving accidents, helping the poor, all good merits must be dedicating Western rebirth merits, and should not seek blessings in heaven or human realm, in the present or in the next life. If you have that thought, you will lose your rebirth and have to be immersed in the sea of samsara suffering. You should know that the more blessings you enjoy, the greater your karma will be, and in the next life, it will be difficult to avoid falling into the realms of Hell, Hungry Ghosts, and Animals. At that time, wanting to return to a human body and listen to Pure Land's liberation dharma is even more difficult than going to heaven. Buddha taught sentient beings to recite Buddha's name and pray to the West, for the sake of sentient beings to solve the problem of birth and death in this present life. If only asking for blessings in the next life to receive blessings in the human and heavenly realms would be contrary to Buddha's teachings, like exchanging a priceless pearl for a sugar token to eat, wouldn't it be a pity? Those who recite Buddha's name in darkness do not seek rebirth but seek blessings, and this is no different.

5. People who recite Buddha's name should not practice the meditation practice of monks. Because most people who practice meditation do not pay attention to rebirth beliefs. Even if they recite Buddha's name, they only focus on the sentence“Who is that Buddha chanting?”just to pray for enlightenment. We should only recite Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West. When we see Amitabha, why are we worried about not being enlightened? If in this world one practices meditation, if one's karma ends, one can escape birth and death; Occasionally, if karma has not yet ended, we cannot rely on our own strength for liberation, and because we do not believe in our vows, we cannot rely on Buddha's strength to get us out of samsara. Neither self-power nor Buddha's power can be relied upon. How can that person escape the world of suffering? We should know that the Bodhisattva dharmakaya, when he has not yet become a Buddha, must rely on the power of the Buddha, not to mention that we, as ordinary people full of karma, like to talk about our own strength and do not pray for the Buddha's power? Although those words are high, the behavior is truly low! The superiority and inferiority of Buddha's power and self-power are as far apart as the sky. May this be achieved by the same people!

6. People who recite Buddha's name should not imitate foolish people, do things that bring about rebirth, or save lives. Because of rebirth, it is not mentioned in the Buddha Sutra, but was invented by later people. And sending it to the warehouse means you want it for yourself when you die and become a demon, so you buy money and things in advance for your demon body to use. Once you have the thought of wanting to become a demon, it is difficult to be reborn. As for those who have not done it, then stop. If you have done it, you must clearly declare it before the Buddha like this: “The disciple is... Just praying for rebirth, please bring the things sent by the treasury before, to bless her soul."Only then will there be no obstacle to being born in the Buddha realm.

Again the sutras: Tho Sanh, Blood Tank, Thai Duong, Thai Am, Nhan Quang, Kitchen God, Thai Cot, Phan Chau, Dieu Sa... These are all fake sutras, not Buddha's sutras, and should not be recited. Those who are ignorant, refuse to chant Mahayana sutras (like the sutras: Amitabha, Infinite Life, Avalokiteshvara of Infinite Life, Heart Sutra, Diamond Sutra, Dharma Flower, Medicine Master, Shurangama, Avatamsaka, Samantabhadra Vows, etc.) but only believe in those fake sutras, wanting to do things to restore one's life, destroy Hell, destroy the blood lake, to feel secure. If there are people who understand the Buddha's advice and say that these are fake sutras, they will not listen. You should know that when doing Buddha work, only reciting Buddha's name is a great merit, so use the money to return to life, destroy Hell, destroy that lake of blood, and ask monks who are mindful of Buddha to give it to you, then you will benefit a lot.

7. People reciting Buddha's name should be vegetarian. If that is not the case, it is reasonable to keep six or ten oysters, to gradually give up all kinds of meat from living beings. Six days are the days: 8th, 14th, 15th, 23rd, 29th, 30th; If we add a few days: The 1st, 18th, 24th, and 28th become ten days of the year. During lean months, you should eat it one day before. Again, January, May, and September are the three lunar months, so you should be vegetarian and do meritorious deeds. Even if you are not a vegetarian, you should buy pre-cooked meat and fish, and do not kill animals at home. If you kill every day, that house will become a slaughterhouse, a place where evil spirits gather, and there will be no peace. Therefore, killing at home is very taboo.

8. People who recite Buddha's name should advise their parents to recite Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West. If you want your parents to decide on rebirth when they are about to die, you must tell your relatives in advance how to support the chanting and not cry or draw useless things. Again, in normal times, we must clearly explain to our parents the benefits of Buddha recitation so that our parents often recite it and never forget it. Then not only will parents benefit, but current relatives or future descendants will also be affected by peaceful liberation. Regarding the method of supporting recitation when dying, regardless of age or child, everyone must do it exactly like that.

9. When a woman is about to give birth, she often suffers unbearably, sometimes she cannot give birth for several days, or she dies from childbirth. Although some people are able to give birth, they suffer from bleeding and many dangerous diseases. The child was born and suffered from acute illness, epilepsy, etc. Therefore, when a woman gives birth, she should sincerely recite Namo Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva. When reciting you need to speak loudly, you should not recite silently, because reciting silently is due to poor mental strength and therefore poor sensing power. At the same time, the pregnant woman is using force to give birth to the baby. If she recites it silently, she will be forced to hold her breath and get sick. If you recite with sincerity and earnestness, there will be no pain, difficulty in giving birth, or bleeding, and your child will be cured of epilepsy and other dangerous diseases. Even if there is a difficult birth or life-threatening situation, the pregnant woman and the birth attendants must chant Avalokitesvara loudly in unison. Even though relatives live elsewhere, they must pray for the mother's sake. Thus, in less than a second, the pregnant woman was able to give birth peacefully. Non-Buddhists do not understand this principle, clinging to a matter of reverence, not knowing how to reason based on the facts, causing the old women who recite Buddha's name to consider giving birth as a scary event, not even daring to come and take care of them when their daughters-in-law are born, let alone reciting Avalokitesvara? You should know that Bodhisattva takes the salvation of suffering as his heart. At the time of giving birth, even though he was naked and unclean, it was a natural thing, he did not indulge in it voluntarily, so his thoughts were not sinful, but caused the mother and child to plant good roots. This meaning is mentioned in the Medicine Buddha Sutra, it is not my opinion that I came up with this. This An Quang is just a proponent.

10. Women from twelve or thirteen years old to forty-eight or forty-nine years old all have menstruation. Someone said: During menstruation, you should not worship or chant. This statement is very unreasonable. The period of menstruation usually lasts for two or three days, but it takes up to six or seven days for it to end; Cultivators need to recite the Buddha's name without any interruptions. Why should we neglect the time to meditate because of a minor natural illness? When you have your period, you should only worship a little (but do not bow at all), and chanting Buddha's sutras is according to the usual rules. You should often wash dirty linen, wash your hands thoroughly, and don't use dirty hands to pray rosary, turn over prayers, and burn incense. In the Buddha Dharma, the Dharma is all Perfect, pagans only accept one side of the truth, most people like to believe in pagan words, do not understand the main principles of Buddhism, so they are not imbued with the benefits of the Dharma.

11. Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva vows widely and deeply, seeking to save suffering. When having an accident: swordsmen, water and fire, famine, locusts, pestilence, drought, robbery, injustice, wild beasts, poisonous snakes, demons, demons, karma warriors, harmed by small people, etc. If you develop the mind to correct your mistakes and do good, benefiting yourself and others, and sincerely reciting Avalokitesvara without any hesitation, then your decision will be supported by the power of compassion to avoid danger. If you still keep an unwholesome heart, even if you confess the thoughts, it is just sowing some good roots later, not receiving the present response, because all Buddhas and Bodhisattva achieve good thoughts for others, absolutely do not achieve evil thoughts for others. If you don't have the intention to correct your mistakes and do good, if you mistakenly want to use merit to recite Buddha, Bodhisattva, to pray for your evil deeds to be successful, then you will definitely not be inspired. You should not develop such a crazy mind.

When reciting Buddha's name, it is necessary to keep the morality, maintain respect, stop evil deeds, do good deeds, maintain kindness, speak good words, and do good deeds. Whatever you can do, do it honestly. If you can't do it, you should develop a good heart, or advise powerful people to do it, or see the person doing it, giving rise to a happy and beautiful mind. Saying praise for good deeds also belongs to the merit of the mind and mouth. If you can't do something that you can't do, and when you see someone else doing it, you feel jealous, that's the mentality of a petty person. Thus, if you decide to lose blessings, lose your life, and not get good results, you need to pay attention to precautions. You should not pretend to be a good person to gain fame and gain, such behavior is hated by ghosts and gods. If you have one, quickly change it. If not, you should try to do good.

12. There are many women who do not understand the truth, or are not filial to their husband's parents, despise their husbands, pamper their children too much, mistreat servants, or are stepmothers who bully and abuse their husband's stepchildren. Those people do not know that: Being filial to your husband's parents, respecting your husband, educating your children, showing favors to your servants, comforting and raising your husband's children, is the path of the Sages in the world and also the first rule of Buddhism. If you have enough merit and practice in the Pure Land, you will have more honor and lasting blessings. When you die, the Buddha will guide you to the nine levels of lotus. We should know that where there is a cause, there must be an effect. If we sow the cause of filial piety and kindness, we will naturally receive the result of filial piety and kindness. For others is for yourself, harming others is worse than harming yourself, so everyone must fulfill their duty, Buddha will surely understand.

13. As soon as children grow up, they must be taught the principles of filial piety, kindness, loyalty, trust, propriety, righteousness, integrity, shame, cause and effect in the three lifetimes, and the six paths of samsara. This is to make them understand that their mind and the minds of all Buddhas, Bodhisattva, heaven and earth, demons and gods, each breath are interconnected. If they start an unrighteous thought or do something that is not right, then they all know, like facing a bright mirror, the good and bad images appear clearly and cannot be hidden. Having understood that, of course they will be afraid and try to make peace. No matter who they are, even if they are children or servants in the house, they should not be beaten or scolded harshly. We must find ways to encourage and make them know how to serve their superiors, yield to those below them, respect paper and letters, not waste rice, clothes, or money, love the lives of ants, and not eat junk food to avoid getting sick. If we can teach them like that, then one day they will definitely become honest people. On the contrary, when their children are young, their parents do not teach them and let them go wild. When they grow up, if they are not stupid, they will also be scoundrels. Even if you repent then it will be useless. The old saying: "The early Father of the Church, the beloved son of the Church"(Teach your children when they are young, teach your wife when they first come home), personality is largely influenced by customs, so you have to be careful from the first step. Individuals are members of society, whether the world is peaceful or chaotic, the origin is all due to the kindness or cruelty of people. So the above things are related and essential, not that I'm discussing useless, far-fetched things...

14. This year, I An Quang is too old and weak, my spirit is getting weaker every day, and I no longer have the strength to respond to letters sent to me. Just because of convenient transportation, people from near and far mistakenly heard some false names and sent too many letters asking for guidance. If I don't reply, I still feel a bit betrayed by the sender; As for each response, it's actually not spirited enough. Therefore, I have printed this long letter to respond to everyone. Here, I will briefly discuss the things related to religious practice, how to establish oneself, worship one's parents, and teach children. In the future, when anyone brings news to ask about religion, I will use this poem to respond, or if there are some special things, I should only add a couple of lines to the letter sent. In this way, the two sides' religious thoughts can be communicated, and I also reduce fatigue. If anyone wants to fully understand the meaning of the sutra, please ask the Dharma masters who set up the dharma hall, the religion and religion. But you should know that even if you understand the Dharma thoroughly, you will not be able to escape birth and death. If you want to escape samsara from birth and death, you must pay attention to the faith and prayer of reciting the Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the West!

---o0o---

Appendix: Pure Land Poetry Garden

The world of karma is rampant,

Talking about the dream of Federation is also clear,

Breath does not enter a thousand lifetimes of hatred,

Dare to give up six famous times?

Like a chicken hatching an egg and immediately getting warm,

The fire burns gold to make it brand new

With one thought, all the roots of love are wiped away,

The true nature is fully revealed.

(Chau Quang Lay Si)

The scene is quiet, there are few people, in the middle of the clear sky,

Diligently guard your body and mind, dare to be arrogant?

Cutting off the bare thoughts of thick karma ropes,

Destroy the illusion of high mountains.

The pearl drops miss Buddha, the pearl has not ended yet,

Thinking about returning to the West, thinking about it again!

Those who love lotuses and jade petals,

Think about the names mentioned.

How hot is the end of summer?

In the midst of a burning fire.

An area of blue trees covers the upper floors,

Ten miles of bright lotus flowers.

Looking at the Western sky, my heart feels silly

Tears according to Buddha's language are desolate.

When will I be able to return to the cool pond?

The more naked you are, the more clean you are!

(Thon Huong Trai Owner)

When walking, it is easy to recite Amitabha,

A Buddha depends on a passing step.

Under the heel of always playing Pure Land,

In each mind, contemplate the Samadhi way.

Walking around the venereal trees but often remembering,

Up and down the river are still not far.

Wait for rebirth to Ultimate Bliss,

Traveling in ten directions is the same!

While lying down and chanting the Buddha's name silently,

Breathing depends on holding the title.

A cushion of clear wind for thousands of miles.
